```rust
// The invite identifier travels in one Wire message only: of the six kinds,
// `AdmissionRequest` alone has an `invite_id` field (LLR-g3wmen); no other
// kind, and no expected admission, holds one. Read from `wire.rs`'s enum,
// variant by variant, and from the `ExpectedAdmission` struct body.
// *Rewritten 2026-10-21 (T7 of docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md):*
// was `org_node_holds_no_invite_identifier` (LLR-ms8njy, LLR-48jakr), which
// found no `InviteId` in `wire.rs` at all.
// verifies: LLR-g3wmen
#[test]
fn only_the_admission_request_carries_an_invite_identifier() {
    let wire = code_of(&sources().into_iter().find(|(path, _)| path.ends_with("wire.rs")).expect("wire.rs").1);
    let start = wire.find("pub enum WireMessage {").expect("the WireMessage enum");
    let body = &wire[start..start + wire[start..].find("\n}").expect("its closing brace")];
    let mut variants: Vec<(String, String)> = vec![];
    for line in body.lines().skip(1) {
        let first = line.trim_start().chars().next();
        if line.starts_with("    ") && !line.starts_with("     ") && first.is_some_and(char::is_uppercase) {
            let name: String = line.trim_start().chars().take_while(|c| c.is_alphanumeric()).collect();
            variants.push((name, String::new()));
        }
        if let Some((_, text)) = variants.last_mut() {
            text.push_str(line);
            text.push('\n');
        }
    }
    let names: Vec<&str> = variants.iter().map(|(name, _)| name.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(
        names,
        ["OrgInformation", "Revocation", "Acknowledgement", "AdmissionRequest", "OrganisationRequest", "Organisation"],
        "the six kinds, in index order"
    );
    for (name, text) in &variants {
        let carries = text.contains("invite_id") || text.contains("InviteId");
        assert_eq!(carries, name == "AdmissionRequest", "{name}: only the admission request carries an invite identifier");
    }
    let store = sources().into_iter().find(|(path, _)| path.ends_with("store.rs")).expect("store.rs").1;
    let start = store.find("pub struct ExpectedAdmission {").expect("the ExpectedAdmission struct");
    let expectation = &store[start..start + store[start..].find('}').expect("its closing brace")];
    assert!(expectation.contains("org_id"), "the scan reads the struct body: {expectation}");
    for needle in ["invite_id", "InviteId"] {
        assert!(!expectation.contains(needle), "LLR-g3wmen: an expectation names the Organisation alone: {expectation}");
    }
    for kind in ["RevocationNotice {", "Acknowledgement {"] {
        let revocation = sources().into_iter().find(|(path, _)| path.ends_with("revocation.rs")).expect("revocation.rs").1;
        let start = revocation.find(&format!("pub struct {kind}")).expect("the struct");
        let fields = &revocation[start..start + revocation[start..].find('}').expect("its closing brace")];
        assert!(!fields.contains("invite_id"), "{kind} carries no invite identifier");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! The Wire message: its six kinds, its encoding and its bound. Pure values;
//! the length prefix the channel puts in front of a message belongs to the
//! transport, not here.
use org_members::{DevicePublicKey, Handle, Name, PersonPublicKey, Surname};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::envelope::Envelope;
use crate::error::OrgNodeError;
use crate::ids::{InviteId, OrgId};
use crate::revocation::{Acknowledgement, RevocationNotice};
use crate::types::{Epoch, OrgPrivateKey};

/// The largest encoded Wire message accepted or produced (a defensive cap
/// against a hostile peer): 1 MiB, generous for a delta, a record snapshot
/// and a key (LLR-8kh3zf, LLR-sc6zuh).
pub const MAX_MESSAGE: usize = 1024 * 1024;

/// The variant index of an admission request (LLR-xr88a8, LLR-g9n9w9).
const ADMISSION_REQUEST_INDEX: u8 = 3;

/// One message over the org-node channel, of one of six kinds (LLR-xr88a8),
/// encoded by postcard as the variant index followed by its fields in
/// order. No field is optional. Only `AdmissionRequest` carries an invite
/// identifier (LLR-g3wmen). `Debug` is derived: the only secret any kind
/// holds is an `OrgPrivateKey`, whose own `Debug` redacts it (LLR-4ces44).
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum WireMessage {
    /// Index 0: the Envelope of an adopted epoch; the record it extends,
    /// postcard `Vec<MemberSnapshot>`; and the Organisation private key of
    /// that epoch. A body without either does not decode (REQ-zxgd46).
    OrgInformation { envelope: Envelope, record_snapshot: Vec<u8>, org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey },
    /// Index 1: the revoked Device's identity and an absence proof, no
    /// Envelope (LLR-dc45ur).
    Revocation(RevocationNotice),
    /// Index 2: a revoked Device's signed acknowledgement (LLR-378cj4).
    Acknowledgement(Acknowledgement),
    /// Index 3: a joining Device's request to be admitted under an Invite:
    /// the Invite's identifiers first, the sending Device's own endpoint
    /// addresses last (as given; parsed on receipt, LLR-h4gwns).
    AdmissionRequest {
        org_id: OrgId,
        invite_id: InviteId,
        name: Name,
        surname: Surname,
        preferred_handles: Vec<Handle>,
        member_key: PersonPublicKey,
        device_key: DevicePublicKey,
        addresses: Vec<String>,
    },
    /// Index 4: a Device behind asks for the Organisation, giving its own
    /// endpoint addresses (as given; parsed on receipt, LLR-h4gwns).
    OrganisationRequest { org_id: OrgId, addresses: Vec<String> },
    /// Index 5: the answer to an organisation request from a listed Device:
    /// the current record's epoch, its members as a record snapshot and its
    /// Organisation private key (LLR-7kdhst).
    Organisation { org_id: OrgId, epoch: Epoch, record_snapshot: Vec<u8>, org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey },
}

impl WireMessage {
    /// The Organisation any kind names (LLR-xr88a8).
    pub fn org_id(&self) -> OrgId {
        match self {
            Self::OrgInformation { envelope, .. } => envelope.org_id,
            Self::Revocation(notice) => notice.org_id,
            Self::Acknowledgement(acknowledgement) => acknowledgement.org_id,
            Self::AdmissionRequest { org_id, .. }
            | Self::OrganisationRequest { org_id, .. }
            | Self::Organisation { org_id, .. } => *org_id,
        }
    }
}

/// Encode a Wire message as its postcard body, with no length prefix
/// (LLR-er2x8n). An encoding over [`MAX_MESSAGE`] is refused (LLR-sc6zuh).
pub fn encode_message(message: &WireMessage) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OrgNodeError> {
    let body = postcard::to_allocvec(message).map_err(|_| OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage)?;
    if body.len() > MAX_MESSAGE {
        return Err(OrgNodeError::MessageTooLarge { length: body.len() });
    }
    Ok(body)
}

/// Decode a Wire message from its postcard body. A body over [`MAX_MESSAGE`]
/// is refused before decoding (LLR-8kh3zf); a body that is not a Wire
/// message — an unknown variant index, a body that ends early, a key field
/// that is not 32 bytes — or has bytes left over after one of any kind, is
/// `MalformedMessage`, without a panic (LLR-xr88a8).
pub fn decode_message(body: &[u8]) -> Result<WireMessage, OrgNodeError> {
    if body.len() > MAX_MESSAGE {
        return Err(OrgNodeError::MessageTooLarge { length: body.len() });
    }
    match postcard::take_from_bytes(body) {
        Ok((message, [])) => Ok(message),
        _ => Err(OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage),
    }
}

/// The Organisation and invite identifier of an admission request, read
/// from the variant index and the next twenty and thirty-two bytes alone;
/// `None` for any other index or a shorter body. No byte after the invite
/// identifier is read (LLR-g9n9w9).
pub fn peek_admission_request(body: &[u8]) -> Option<(OrgId, InviteId)> {
    let (&index, rest) = body.split_first()?;
    if index != ADMISSION_REQUEST_INDEX {
        return None;
    }
    let org_id: [u8; 20] = rest.get(..20)?.try_into().ok()?;
    let invite_id: [u8; 32] = rest.get(20..52)?.try_into().ok()?;
    Some((OrgId::new(org_id), InviteId::new(invite_id)))
}
```

   `org-node/src/service.rs` — `check_received` refuses the three new kinds as `MalformedMessage` until T11 and T22 give them arms. Edits:

Replace `fn check_received` in `impl OrgService` with:

```rust
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // The receive path (chain-free).
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    /// The check of a received body: `sender` is the Device the transport
    /// authenticated for it. The body is bounded and decoded first
    /// (`MessageTooLarge`, `MalformedMessage`); then an acknowledgement is
    /// decided against the store holding its Organisation's record, only
    /// from the Device it names (LLR-5azhry); a revocation notice passes
    /// `check_notice` (LLR-r7zm39) and the sender rule; Organisation
    /// information about a held Organisation passes the sender rule
    /// (`SenderNotListed`). Writes nothing.
    ///
    /// *Transitional (T5 until T11/T13):* Organisation information and a
    /// revocation notice that pass these refusals are refused as
    /// `MalformedMessage`: the arms that keep them come with T11's
    /// `check_received`.
    pub fn check_received(&self, sender: DevicePublicKey, body: &[u8]) -> Result<Checked, OrgNodeError> {
        match decode_message(body)? {
            WireMessage::Acknowledgement(ack) => self.check_acknowledgement(sender, ack).map(Checked::Acknowledged),
            WireMessage::Revocation(notice) => {
                let index = self.notice_index(&notice)?;
                if let Some(record) = &self.stores[index].data().record {
                    sender_listed(record, notice.org_id, &sender)?;
                }
                Err(OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage)
            }
            WireMessage::OrgInformation { envelope, .. } => {
                let org_id = envelope.org_id;
                if let Some(index) = self.record_index(org_id) {
                    if let Some(record) = &self.stores[index].data().record {
                        sender_listed(record, org_id, &sender)?;
                    }
                }
                Err(OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage)
            }
            // *Transitional (T7 until T11/T22):* the three kinds T7 adds have
            // no arm yet.
            WireMessage::AdmissionRequest { .. }
            | WireMessage::OrganisationRequest { .. }
            | WireMessage::Organisation { .. } => Err(OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage),
        }
    }
```

Replace `fn main` with:

```rust
fn main() {
    let envelope = Envelope { org_id: OrgId::new([5u8; 20]), parent_seq: SequenceNumber::new(1), delta_bytes: vec![1, 2, 3] };
    // Organisation information's index, then a well-formed Envelope.
    let mut info_prefix = vec![0u8];
    info_prefix.extend(postcard::to_allocvec(&envelope).expect("encode"));
    check!().for_each(|bytes: &[u8]| {
        // Shape 1 — the bytes are the whole body.
        if let Ok(msg) = decode_message(bytes) {
            let body = encode_message(&msg).expect("a decoded message re-encodes");
            assert_eq!(&body[..], bytes, "to the bytes it was decoded from");
            assert_eq!(decode_message(&body).expect("and decodes again"), msg);
        }
        // Shape 3 — the peek, on the same bytes, never panics and agrees with
        // the full decode of an admission request.
        let peeked = peek_admission_request(bytes);
        if let Ok(WireMessage::AdmissionRequest { org_id, invite_id, .. }) = decode_message(bytes) {
            assert_eq!(peeked, Some((org_id, invite_id)), "the peek agrees with the decode");
        }
        // Shape 2 — the bytes follow an Organisation-information prefix.
        let mut body = info_prefix.clone();
        body.extend_from_slice(bytes);
        match decode_message(&body) {
            Ok(WireMessage::OrgInformation { org_private_key, .. }) => {
                assert_eq!(org_private_key.expose_secret().len(), 32);
            }
            Ok(other) => panic!("variant index 0 decoded as {other:?}"),
            Err(OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage) => {}
            Err(other) => panic!("refused as {other:?}, not as Malformed"),
        }
    });
}
```

```rust
#![cfg(all(feature = "app", feature = "test-support"))]
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]
//! The Invite (SDD-xexu3k): the Blob, built and parsed here, naming the field
//! that fails (LLR-9jxwq4), and its bookkeeping in the sealed store — the
//! outstanding invite `build_invite` records with the invitee name the

//! *Rewritten 2026-10-21 (T8 of docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md):*
//! the Invite names its one issuing Device and its endpoint addresses; the
//! reply and its bookkeeping went in T5.

mod support;

use org_node::error::OrgNodeError;
use org_node::ids::OrgId;
use org_node::invitation::{EndpointAddresses, Invite, InviteId};
use org_node::store::OutstandingInvite;
use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, ChainSlots};
use org_node::{DevicePublicKey, PersonaId};
use rand::rngs::OsRng;
use support::*;

/// The `field` of an `InvalidField` refusal.
fn refused_field(error: OrgNodeError) -> &'static str {
    match error {
        OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field, .. } => field,
        other => panic!("expected InvalidField, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

/// Each Persona store's plaintext, in store order: what "byte-identical"
/// compares.
fn plaintexts(node: &Node) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
    node.list_personas()
        .iter()
        .map(|persona| postcard::to_allocvec(node.store_data(&persona.device_key).unwrap()).unwrap())
        .collect()
}

/// A node over a fresh storage whose one Persona, alice, founded an
/// Organisation on `chain`; its Device key.
fn founder(tag: &str, chain: &ChainSlots) -> (Node, PersonaId, OrgId, DevicePublicKey) {
    let mut node = Node::new(open_store(tag, "a"), chain.clone());
    let pid = node.create_persona(&mut OsRng, h("alice"), nm("Alice"), sn("Smith")).unwrap();
    let org_id = found(&mut node, chain, &pid);
    let device = persona_of(&node, &pid).device_key;
    (node, pid, org_id, device)
}

/// `node`'s Invite from `device`'s store, its change kept on the disk.
fn build_invite(node: &mut Node, device: &DevicePublicKey, invitee: &str) -> Invite {
    let (invite, change) =
        node.svc.build_invite(&mut OsRng, device, invitee.into(), vec!["192.0.2.1:7000".into()]).unwrap();
    node.disk.apply(change);
    invite
}

/// A Blob of these raw fields, valid or not.
fn blob(
    org_name: &[u8],
    org_id: &[u8],
    invitee: &[u8],
    issuer: &[u8],
    addresses: &[&str],
    invite_id: &[u8],
) -> String {
    Invite::wire_for_test(org_name, org_id, invitee, issuer, addresses, invite_id)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// The Blob (LLR-9jxwq4).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

// Normal: a Blob `Invite::encode` wrote parses back to an equal Invite, and
// a Blob of valid fields parses and encodes back to the same Blob.
// *Rewritten 2026-10-21 (T8):* was
// `an_invite_and_a_reply_that_parse_encode_back_to_the_same_blob`.
// verifies: LLR-9jxwq4
#[test]
fn an_invite_that_parses_encodes_back_to_the_same_blob() {
    let dk = *device_key(7).as_bytes();
    let text = blob(b"Acme", &[1; 20], b"Bob", &dk, &["192.0.2.1:7000", "[2001:db8::1]:7000"], &[3; 32]);
    let invite = Invite::parse(&text).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(invite.encode().unwrap(), text);
    let built = Invite {
        org_name: "Acme Co-op".into(),
        org_id: OrgId::new([2; 20]),
        invitee_name: "Bob Builder".into(),
        issuer: device_key(8),
        issuer_addresses: EndpointAddresses::parse(vec!["198.51.100.7:7000".into()]).unwrap(),
        invite_id: InviteId::new([4; 32]),
    };
    assert_eq!(Invite::parse(&built.encode().unwrap()).unwrap(), built);
}

// Abnormal: a Blob with one field its type refuses is refused naming that
// field. *Rewritten 2026-10-21 (T8):* was
// `an_invite_or_reply_that_does_not_parse_is_refused_naming_the_field`.
// verifies: LLR-9jxwq4
#[test]
fn an_invite_that_does_not_parse_is_refused_naming_the_field() {
    let dk = *device_key(7).as_bytes();
    let long = "a".repeat(257);
    let many = ["x"; 17];
    for (text, field) in [
        (blob(&[0xff, 0xfe], &[1; 20], b"N", &dk, &[], &[3; 32]), "invite.org_name"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 19], b"N", &dk, &[], &[3; 32]), "invite.org_id"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 20], &[0xc3], &dk, &[], &[3; 32]), "invite.invitee_name"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 20], b"N", &[0xff; 32], &[], &[3; 32]), "invite.issuer"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 20], b"N", &dk[..31], &[], &[3; 32]), "invite.issuer"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 20], b"N", &dk, &[long.as_str()], &[3; 32]), "invite.issuer_addresses"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 20], b"N", &dk, &many, &[3; 32]), "invite.issuer_addresses"),
        (blob(b"O", &[1; 20], b"N", &dk, &[], &[3; 31]), "invite.invite_id"),
    ] {
        assert_eq!(refused_field(Invite::parse(&text).unwrap_err()), field);
    }
}

// Abnormal: with every field invalid at once, the first in order is named;
// then, field by field made valid, the next.
// verifies: LLR-9jxwq4
#[test]
fn invite_parse_refuses_the_first_failing_field_naming_it() {
    let dk = *device_key(7).as_bytes();
    let long = "a".repeat(257);
    let bad = (vec![0xffu8], vec![1u8; 19], vec![0xffu8], vec![0xffu8; 32], vec![long.as_str()], vec![3u8; 31]);
    let good = (b"O".to_vec(), vec![1u8; 20], b"N".to_vec(), dk.to_vec(), Vec::<&str>::new(), vec![3u8; 32]);
    let order = ["invite.org_name", "invite.org_id", "invite.invitee_name", "invite.issuer", "invite.issuer_addresses", "invite.invite_id"];
    for (valid_so_far, expected) in order.iter().enumerate() {
        let pick = |i: usize| i < valid_so_far;
        let text = blob(
            if pick(0) { &good.0 } else { &bad.0 },
            if pick(1) { &good.1 } else { &bad.1 },
            if pick(2) { &good.2 } else { &bad.2 },
            if pick(3) { &good.3 } else { &bad.3 },
            if pick(4) { &good.4 } else { &bad.4 },
            if pick(5) { &good.5 } else { &bad.5 },
        );
        assert_eq!(refused_field(Invite::parse(&text).unwrap_err()), *expected, "{valid_so_far} fields valid");
    }
}
```

```rust
//! The Invite and the endpoint addresses (SDD-xexu3k): the Invite a Member
//! sends, as a Blob (Base64 of postcard), parsed here, naming the field that
//! fails; and the endpoint addresses one Device keeps for another
//! (`EndpointAddresses`, LLR-h4gwns). The Invite reply is gone: an admission
//! request takes its place (LLR-96z2k5).
//! org-io runs the exchange, and the service
//! keeps the outstanding pairs in the sealed store (`OrgService::build_invite`
//! and the operations beside it). Nothing here is verified: an Invite's
//! sender and its Organisation name are whatever the sender chose.

use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, Engine};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use org_members::DevicePublicKey;

pub use crate::ids::{
    EndpointAddresses, EndpointAddressesError, InviteId, MAX_ENDPOINT_ADDRESSES, MAX_ENDPOINT_ADDRESS_BYTES,
};
use crate::ids::OrgId;
use crate::store::parse_field;
use crate::OrgNodeError;

/// An Invite as parsed (LLR-9jxwq4, LLR-h9f5c9): the Organisation name the
/// issuing store holds, the Organisation, the invitee name the inviter
/// typed, the one issuing Device and its endpoint addresses, and the
/// identifier an admission request must carry.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Invite {
    pub org_name: String,
    pub org_id: OrgId,
    pub invitee_name: String,
    pub issuer: DevicePublicKey,
    pub issuer_addresses: EndpointAddresses,
    pub invite_id: InviteId,
}

/// The Invite as the Blob holds it, every field in the form it is parsed
/// from, so each can be refused by name.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct WireInvite {
    org_name: Vec<u8>,
    org_id: Vec<u8>,
    invitee_name: Vec<u8>,
    issuer: Vec<u8>,
    issuer_addresses: Vec<String>,
    invite_id: Vec<u8>,
}

/// UTF-8 text, else `InvalidField` naming `field`.
fn text(field: &'static str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Result<String, OrgNodeError> {
    parse_field(field, String::from_utf8(bytes))
}

/// Exactly `N` bytes, else `InvalidField` naming `field`.
fn exact<const N: usize>(field: &'static str, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<[u8; N], OrgNodeError> {
    bytes.try_into().map_err(|_| OrgNodeError::InvalidField {
        field,
        reason: format!("expected {N} bytes, got {}", bytes.len()),
    })
}

/// The value inside the Blob `blob`, else `InvalidField` naming `what`
/// (`invite`).
fn unarmour<T: for<'de> Deserialize<'de>>(what: &'static str, blob: &str) -> Result<T, OrgNodeError> {
    let bytes = STANDARD
        .decode(blob.trim())
        .map_err(|error| OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field: what, reason: format!("not a Blob: {error}") })?;
    postcard::from_bytes(&bytes)
        .map_err(|error| OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field: what, reason: format!("does not decode: {error}") })
}

fn armour<T: Serialize>(value: &T) -> Result<String, OrgNodeError> {
    postcard::to_allocvec(value)
        .map(|bytes| STANDARD.encode(bytes))
        .map_err(|error| OrgNodeError::Chain(format!("blob encode: {error}")))
}

/// `bytes` armoured as a Blob, whatever they hold, so a fuzz target reaches
/// the decode behind the armour (test builds only).
#[cfg(feature = "test-support")]
pub fn armour_for_test(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    STANDARD.encode(bytes)
}

impl Invite {
    /// Parse an Invite Blob (LLR-9jxwq4): text that is not a Blob of an
    /// Invite is refused naming `invite`; then each field is parsed by its
    /// type in order, the first that fails refused naming it —
    /// `invite.org_name` and `invite.invitee_name` (UTF-8 text),
    /// `invite.org_id` (twenty bytes), `invite.issuer`
    /// (`DevicePublicKey::parse`), `invite.issuer_addresses`
    /// (`EndpointAddresses::parse`), `invite.invite_id` (thirty-two bytes).
    /// Pure: a refused Invite acts on nothing.
    pub fn parse(blob: &str) -> Result<Self, OrgNodeError> {
        let wire: WireInvite = unarmour("invite", blob)?;
        Ok(Self {
            org_name: text("invite.org_name", wire.org_name)?,
            org_id: OrgId::new(exact("invite.org_id", &wire.org_id)?),
            invitee_name: text("invite.invitee_name", wire.invitee_name)?,
            issuer: parse_field("invite.issuer", DevicePublicKey::parse(&exact("invite.issuer", &wire.issuer)?))?,
            issuer_addresses: parse_field("invite.issuer_addresses", EndpointAddresses::parse(wire.issuer_addresses))?,
            invite_id: InviteId::new(exact("invite.invite_id", &wire.invite_id)?),
        })
    }

    /// This Invite as a Blob; it parses back to an equal Invite.
    pub fn encode(&self) -> Result<String, OrgNodeError> {
        armour(&WireInvite {
            org_name: self.org_name.clone().into_bytes(),
            org_id: self.org_id.as_bytes().to_vec(),
            invitee_name: self.invitee_name.clone().into_bytes(),
            issuer: self.issuer.as_bytes().to_vec(),
            issuer_addresses: self.issuer_addresses.as_slice().to_vec(),
            invite_id: self.invite_id.as_bytes().to_vec(),
        })
    }

    /// A Blob from raw parts, so a test can present one this software never
    /// writes (test builds only).
    #[cfg(feature = "test-support")]
    pub fn wire_for_test(
        org_name: &[u8],
        org_id: &[u8],
        invitee_name: &[u8],
        issuer: &[u8],
        issuer_addresses: &[&str],
        invite_id: &[u8],
    ) -> String {
        armour(&WireInvite {
            org_name: org_name.to_vec(),
            org_id: org_id.to_vec(),
            invitee_name: invitee_name.to_vec(),
            issuer: issuer.to_vec(),
            issuer_addresses: issuer_addresses.iter().map(|address| address.to_string()).collect(),
            invite_id: invite_id.to_vec(),
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! OrgService: one sealed Persona store per Persona (LLR-f9x3vf), each one
//! Persona's view of one Organisation (SDD-undd7q).
//!
//! It reads no chain: the one operation that judges against the chain takes
//! the Organisation's state as a value (LLR-7en38k). It binds no endpoint and
//! sends and receives nothing: org-io receives a body and its sender and
//! hands them to `check_received`, and sends the messages org-node builds.
//!
//! It writes no file: every operation that changes a store returns at most
//! one `StoreChange` for org-io to write (LLR-ay8nvu). A refusal changes
//! nothing: each change is made on a copy of the store's data, sealed, and
//! only then adopted.
//!
//! *Stripped 2026-10-21 (T5 of docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md):*
//! the commit path and every operation this change supersedes are removed;
//! the proposal, verification and receive operations that replace them come
//! in the tasks after T5.

use org_members::trie::OrgTrie;

use rand_core::{CryptoRng, RngCore};

use crate::invitation::{EndpointAddresses, Invite, InviteId};

    parse_field, parse_members, ExpectedAdmission, MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord, OutstandingInvite, PersonaRecord,
    PersonaStore, RawMemberSnapshot, StoreData, StoreWrite,
};
```

Replace `fn build_invite` in `impl OrgService` with:

```rust
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // The Invite (SDD-xexu3k).
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    /// An Invite from the store of `device_key` (LLR-h9f5c9): a store with
    /// no current record is refused (`OrgNotHeld`, or `FoundingNotWritten`
    /// for a founding not yet written), as are issuer addresses
    /// `EndpointAddresses::parse` refuses (`InvalidField
    /// invite.issuer_addresses`), nothing written; otherwise a fresh 32-byte
    /// `InviteId` is drawn, `OutstandingInvite { org_id, invite_id,
    /// invitee_name }` appended, and the Invite returned with the stored
    /// Organisation name and the Persona's DevicePublicKey as its issuer,
    /// with the store's one change.
    pub fn build_invite<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
        &mut self,
        rng: &mut R,
        device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
        invitee_name: String,
        issuer_addresses: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<(Invite, StoreChange), OrgNodeError> {
        let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
        let data = self.stores[index].data();
        let org_id = current_record(data)?.org_id;
        let issuer_addresses = parse_field("invite.issuer_addresses", EndpointAddresses::parse(issuer_addresses))?;
        let mut bytes = [0u8; 32];
        rng.fill_bytes(&mut bytes);
        let invite_id = InviteId::new(bytes);
        let invite = Invite {
            org_name: data.org_name.clone(),
            org_id,
            invitee_name: invitee_name.clone(),
            issuer: data.persona.device_key,
            issuer_addresses,
            invite_id,
        };
        let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
            data.outstanding_invites.push(OutstandingInvite { org_id, invite_id, invitee_name });
            Ok(())
        })?;
        Ok((invite, StoreChange::Sealed(write)))
    }
```

```rust
    /// The index of the store of `device_key`'s Persona, else
    /// `PersonaNotHeld` (LLR-f9x3vf): the lookup of every per-store operation.
    fn store_index(&self, device_key: &DevicePublicKey) -> Result<usize, OrgNodeError> {
        self.stores.iter().position(|store| &store.device_key() == device_key).ok_or(OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld)
```

```rust
/// The current record of `data`'s store, else `OrgNotHeld` naming the
/// Persona's Organisation, or `FoundingNotWritten` for a founding store whose
/// Organisation identifier is not yet recorded.
pub(crate) fn current_record(data: &StoreData) -> Result<&OrgRecord, OrgNodeError> {
    match (&data.record, data.persona.org_id) {
        (Some(record), _) => Ok(record),
        (None, Some(org_id)) => Err(OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id }),
        (None, None) => Err(OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten),
    }
}
```

```rust
// puts back a Persona's store as its file holds it after a failed write, and
// takes one out when the keychain refused its new Persona; one store per

// the store that ran ahead of its file did so by `build_invite`.
// verifies: LLR-f9x3vf
#[test]
fn restore_store_replaces_or_adds_one_store_and_drop_store_removes_one() {
    let chain = ChainSlots::new();
    let mut svc = OrgService::new(vec![]).unwrap();
    let (_, alice_seed, alice_created, _) = new_founder(&mut svc, &chain, "alice");
    let (_, bob_seed, bob_created) = new_persona(&mut svc, "bob");
    let (alice, bob) = (alice_created.device_key, bob_created.device_key);
    let _ahead = svc.build_invite(&mut OsRng, &alice, "Carol".into(), vec![]).unwrap();
    let bob_before = format!("{:?}", svc.store_data(&bob).unwrap());

    // The store as its file held it replaces the one that ran ahead.
    let alice_on_disk = PersonaStore::unseal(&alice_created.sealed, alice, from_keychain(&alice_seed)).unwrap();
    svc.restore_store(alice_on_disk);
    assert_eq!(svc.list_personas().len(), 2, "replaced, not added");
    assert!(svc.store_data(&alice).unwrap().outstanding_invites.is_empty(), "the store is the file's again");
    assert_eq!(format!("{:?}", svc.store_data(&bob).unwrap()), bob_before, "another Persona's store is untouched");

    // Dropped, and dropped again: the second finds nothing.
    assert!(svc.drop_store(&bob));
    assert!(!svc.drop_store(&bob));
    assert_eq!(svc.store_data(&bob).err(), Some(OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld));
    assert_eq!(svc.list_personas().len(), 1);

    // A store the service does not hold is added back.
    let bob_on_disk = PersonaStore::unseal(&bob_created.sealed, bob, from_keychain(&bob_seed)).unwrap();
    svc.restore_store(bob_on_disk);
    assert_eq!(svc.list_personas().len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(format!("{:?}", svc.store_data(&bob).unwrap()), bob_before);
}
```

```rust
// Nonce freshness. The falsifiability sweep of 2026-10-03 replaced
// `rng.fill_bytes(&mut nonce)` with nothing — a fixed all-zero nonce on every
// save — and the whole suite stayed green: nothing here was asserting that the
// nonce ever changed. XChaCha20-Poly1305 does not survive nonce reuse under
// the same key, and the key is derived from the Persona's device secret, so
// it IS the same key across seals of one store. This case is what makes that
// mutation red.
// *Moved 2026-10-15 (S4 TEST review round 1, finding-5):* the seals are the
// writes four calls of one operation return on one open store, not
// `seal_for_test`'s. *2026-10-21 (T5):* the operation is `build_invite`.
// verifies: REQ-hzm4kt, LLR-8mfjey
#[test]
fn each_save_draws_a_fresh_nonce() {
    let mut data = empty_store(persona([1u8; 32], [2u8; 32]));
    data.record = Some(org_record([0x7d; 32]));
    let device_key = data.persona.device_key;
    let mut service = OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&device_secret([2u8; 32]), data)]).unwrap();

    let mut nonces = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..4 {
        let (_, StoreChange::Sealed(write)) =
            service.build_invite(&mut OsRng, &device_key, "Carol".into(), vec![]).unwrap();
        nonces.push(write.sealed.as_bytes()[..24].to_vec());
    }

    for (i, a) in nonces.iter().enumerate() {
        for (j, b) in nonces.iter().enumerate() {
            if i != j {
                assert_ne!(a, b, "saves {i} and {j} reused a nonce");
            }
        }
    }
    // And none of them is the all-zero nonce a dropped draw would leave.
    assert!(nonces.iter().all(|n| n.iter().any(|b| *b != 0)));
}
```

```rust
#![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]
//! The proposal operations (SDD-hwax8v): a founding and its proxy (T9), a
//! Member (T10), the Admin's provisional changes (T15) and the updated
//! Organisation (T16) — epoch state, never a chain write. T9 onwards of
//! docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md.

use org_members::OrgMembersError;
use org_node::service::StoreChange;
use org_node::store::{PersonaStatus, PersonaStore, StoreData};
use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, device_secret, persona_record, store_for_test};
use org_node::{
    ChainAccount, DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, Epoch, OrgId, OrgNodeError, OrgService, PersonaId,
};
use rand::rngs::OsRng;
use zeroize::Zeroizing;

/// A service with no store.
fn service() -> OrgService {
    OrgService::new(vec![]).unwrap()
}

/// `secret`'s seed bytes, as org-io's keychain would hold them, made into a
/// secret again.
fn copy_of(secret: &DeviceSecret) -> DeviceSecret {
    let mut bytes = vec![];
    secret
        .lend_to_keychain(|seed| {
            bytes.extend_from_slice(seed);
            Ok::<(), std::convert::Infallible>(())
        })
        .unwrap();
    DeviceSecret::from_keychain_bytes(Zeroizing::new(bytes)).unwrap()
}

/// The store `change` sealed, opened with `secret`.
fn reopen(change: StoreChange, secret: &DeviceSecret) -> PersonaStore {
    let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = change;
    PersonaStore::unseal(&write.sealed, write.device_key, copy_of(secret)).unwrap()
}

/// A founding proposed by "alice" on `svc`: its Device key, secret and change.
fn found(svc: &mut OrgService) -> (DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, StoreChange) {
    svc.propose_founding(&mut OsRng, "Alice", "Smith", "alice", "Acme".into()).unwrap()
}

/// Each held store's plaintext, in store order.
fn plaintexts(svc: &OrgService) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
    svc.list_personas()
        .iter()
        .map(|persona| postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&persona.device_key).unwrap()).unwrap())
        .collect()
}

/// A random source that returns one byte for ever: every draw is the same
/// 32 bytes, so the Organisation key pair is the founder's member key pair.
struct ConstRng(u8);

impl rand::RngCore for ConstRng {
    fn next_u32(&mut self) -> u32 {
        u32::from_le_bytes([self.0; 4])
    }
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        u64::from_le_bytes([self.0; 8])
    }
    fn fill_bytes(&mut self, dest: &mut [u8]) {
        dest.fill(self.0);
    }
    fn try_fill_bytes(&mut self, dest: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), rand::Error> {
        dest.fill(self.0);
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl rand::CryptoRng for ConstRng {}

/// A random source that counts the bytes drawn from it.
struct CountingRng(usize);

impl rand::RngCore for CountingRng {
    fn next_u32(&mut self) -> u32 {
        self.0 += 4;
        rand::RngCore::next_u32(&mut OsRng)
    }
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.0 += 8;
        rand::RngCore::next_u64(&mut OsRng)
    }
    fn fill_bytes(&mut self, dest: &mut [u8]) {
        self.0 += dest.len();
        rand::RngCore::fill_bytes(&mut OsRng, dest)
    }
    fn try_fill_bytes(&mut self, dest: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), rand::Error> {
        self.fill_bytes(dest);
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl rand::CryptoRng for CountingRng {}

/// The `field` of an `InvalidField` refusal.
fn refused_field(error: OrgNodeError) -> &'static str {
    match error {
        OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field, .. } => field,
        other => panic!("expected InvalidField, got {other:?}"),
    }
}

// ---- T9: proposing a founding and recording its proxy ----------------------

// Normal: one new store, holding the Persona (no Organisation yet, its
// Handle set, proposed), the Organisation name and the provisional founding
// at epoch 1 — the founder alone, its root, the key pair and no proxy — and
// no current record; the change is that store's, and it reopens the same.
// verifies: LLR-d4gpxm
#[test]
fn propose_founding_adds_one_store_with_a_provisional_founding_at_epoch_one_and_no_record() {
    let mut svc = service();
    let (device, secret, change) = found(&mut svc);
    assert_eq!(svc.list_personas().len(), 1, "one store added");
    let data = svc.store_data(&device).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(data.persona.org_id, None);
    assert_eq!(data.persona.handle.as_ref().map(|h| h.as_str()), Some("alice"));
    assert_eq!(data.persona.status, PersonaStatus::Proposed);
    assert_eq!(data.persona.member_id, None);
    assert_eq!(data.org_name, "Acme");
    assert!(data.record.is_none(), "no current record");
    let founding = data.founding.as_ref().expect("a provisional founding");
    assert_eq!((founding.epoch, founding.proxy), (Epoch::new(1), None));
    assert_eq!(founding.members.len(), 1, "the founder alone");
    let founder = &founding.members[0];
    assert_eq!((founder.handle.as_str(), founder.device_keys.clone()), ("alice", vec![device]));
    assert_eq!(founder.member_key, data.persona.member_seed_for_test().x25519_keypair().member_key().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(founding.org_private_key_for_test().x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap(), founding.org_pub_key);
    let reopened = reopen(change, &secret);
    assert_eq!(
        postcard::to_allocvec(reopened.data()).unwrap(),
        postcard::to_allocvec(data).unwrap(),
        "the change is the store as held"
    );
}

// Normal: the operation takes no chain state and makes no chain call — its
// signature names none and the service holds none — and the Device secret is
// returned by value: the store holds the Device public key, never the seed.
// verifies: LLR-d4gpxm
#[test]
fn propose_founding_calls_no_chain_operation_and_returns_the_secret_by_value() {
    let source = include_str!("../src/service.rs");
    let start = source.find("pub fn propose_founding<").unwrap();
    let signature = &source[start..start + source[start..].find('{').unwrap()];
    for chain in ["OrgState", "chain", "Chain"] {
        assert!(!signature.contains(chain), "the signature names {chain}: {signature}");
    }
    assert!(signature.contains("-> Result<(DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, StoreChange), OrgNodeError>"), "{signature}");
    let mut svc = service();
    let (device, secret, change) = found(&mut svc);
    assert_eq!(secret.device_key(), device);
    let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = change;
    let plaintext = postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&device).unwrap()).unwrap();
    let mut seed = vec![];
    secret.lend_to_keychain(|bytes| {
        seed.extend_from_slice(bytes);
        Ok::<(), std::convert::Infallible>(())
    })
    .unwrap();
    assert!(!plaintext.windows(32).any(|window| window == seed.as_slice()), "the store holds no Device seed");
    assert!(!write.sealed.as_bytes().windows(32).any(|window| window == seed.as_slice()));
}

fn details_are_parsed_in_order_before_any_draw() {
    let over = "a".repeat(129);

#[test]
fn record_founding_proxy_sets_the_proxy_and_the_org_id() {
    let mut svc = service();
    let (device, secret, _) = found(&mut svc);
    let (org_id, proxy) = (OrgId::new([7; 20]), ChainAccount::new([0x5a; 32]));
    let change = svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device, org_id, proxy).unwrap();

// Abnormal: a store with no provisional founding, another proxy, and
// another Organisation identifier are refused, changing nothing; normal: the
// same proxy and identifier again are accepted, sealed unchanged in content.
// verifies: LLR-nx87k5
#[test]
fn record_founding_proxy_refuses_no_founding_or_another_proxy_and_accepts_the_same_again() {
    let mut svc = service();
    let (device, _, _) = found(&mut svc);
    let (org_id, proxy) = (OrgId::new([7; 20]), ChainAccount::new([0x5a; 32]));
    let _ = svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device, org_id, proxy).unwrap();
    let before = plaintexts(&svc);
    assert_eq!(
        svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device, org_id, ChainAccount::new([0x5b; 32])).err(),
        Some(OrgNodeError::FoundingProxyAlreadyRecorded)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device, OrgId::new([8; 20]), proxy).err(),
        Some(OrgNodeError::FoundingProxyAlreadyRecorded)
    );
    assert_eq!(plaintexts(&svc), before, "nothing changed");
    let again = svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device, org_id, proxy).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(plaintexts(&svc), before, "the same values again change no content");
    let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = again;
    assert_eq!(write.device_key, device, "and the store is sealed again, for a retried write");
    // A store with no provisional founding: one Persona and nothing else.
    let unfounded = StoreData::new(persona_record("p2", 0x41, 0x42));
    svc.restore_store(store_for_test(&device_secret([0x42; 32]), unfounded));
    assert_eq!(
        svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device_key(0x42), org_id, proxy).err(),
        Some(OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalFounding)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &device_key(0x43), org_id, proxy).err(),
        Some(OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld)
```

```rust
//! OrgService: one sealed Persona store per Persona (LLR-f9x3vf), each one
//! Persona's view of one Organisation (SDD-undd7q).

//! It reads no chain: the one operation that judges against the chain takes
```

```rust
/// A Persona identifier from its Member-as-a-group key: the first 16 bytes,
/// in hex.
fn persona_id_for(member_key: &PersonPublicKey) -> PersonaId {
    use std::fmt::Write as _;
    PersonaId::new(member_key.as_bytes().iter().take(16).fold(String::new(), |mut s, b| {
        let _ = write!(s, "{b:02x}");
        s
    }))
```

```rust
/// A fresh `MemberId`: 32 bytes from the caller's cryptographic random
/// source, never derived from a key (REQ-d9g6nt, LLR-4rv4kr).
fn fresh_member_id<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(rng: &mut R) -> MemberId {
    let mut id = [0u8; 32];
    rng.fill_bytes(&mut id);
    MemberId::new(id)
}
```

Add, after `fn new` in `impl OrgService`:

```rust
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // Proposing a founding (SDD-hwax8v).
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    /// Propose a founding (LLR-d4gpxm, LLR-9qavm7, LLR-rjphn4): the name,
    /// surname and Handle are parsed first, in that order (`InvalidField`
    /// `member.name`, `member.surname`, `member.handle`), before any draw;
    /// then a fresh Device seed, a member seed and a MemberId are drawn from
    /// `rng`, the founding record listing the founder alone is built and its
    /// Membership root calculated, and only then the Organisation key pair is
    /// drawn, refused with `Trie(DuplicateKey)` when its public key equals the
    /// founder's Member-as-a-group key or DevicePublicKey. A new store is
    /// added holding the Persona (`org_id` `None`, `handle` set, `status`
    /// `Proposed`), `org_name` and the provisional founding at epoch 1 with no
    /// proxy; no current record, no chain operation. The secret is returned by
    /// value for org-io's keychain and org-node keeps no copy; a refusal adds
    /// no store and returns no secret.
    pub fn propose_founding<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
        &mut self,
        rng: &mut R,
        name: &str,
        surname: &str,
        handle: &str,
        org_name: String,
    ) -> Result<(DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, StoreChange), OrgNodeError> {
        let name = parse_field("member.name", Name::parse(name))?;
        let surname = parse_field("member.surname", Surname::parse(surname))?;
        let handle = parse_field("member.handle", Handle::parse(handle))?;
        let secret = DeviceSecret::generate(rng);
        let member = X25519Keypair::generate(rng);
        let member_key = member.member_key()?;
        let founder = MemberLeaf::new(
            fresh_member_id(rng),
            handle.clone(),
            member_key,
            name.clone(),
            surname.clone(),
            vec![secret.device_key()],
        )
        .map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
        let trie = Trie::genesis(vec![founder.clone()]).map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
        let root = trie.root_hash().map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
        // REQ-ech45n: drawn for this Organisation alone, after the root, and
        // equal to no key of the founding record (LLR-9qavm7).
        let org_key = X25519Keypair::generate(rng);
        let org_pub_key = org_key.org_public_key()?;
        org_pub_key.ensure_distinct_from(&trie.members())?;
        let persona = PersonaRecord {
            persona_id: persona_id_for(&member_key),
            org_id: None,
            name,
            surname,
            handle: Some(handle),
            member_seed: member.member_seed(),
            device_key: secret.device_key(),
            member_id: None,
            status: PersonaStatus::Proposed,
        };
        let founding = ProvisionalFounding {
            epoch: Epoch::new(1),
            members: vec![snapshot_of(&founder)],
            root,
            org_pub_key,
            org_private_key: org_key.org_private_key(),
            proxy: None,
        };
        let data = StoreData { org_name, founding: Some(founding), ..StoreData::new(persona) };
        let change = self.add_store(rng, &secret, data)?;
        Ok((secret.device_key(), secret, change))
    }
```

Add, after `fn propose_founding` in `impl OrgService`:

```rust
    /// Record the founding's pure proxy and its Organisation identifier
    /// (LLR-nx87k5, LLR-qqqg4b): sets the founding's `proxy` and
    /// `persona.org_id`. Refused, changing nothing: a store with no
    /// provisional founding (`NoProvisionalFounding`); a founding holding
    /// another proxy or a Persona bound to another Organisation
    /// (`FoundingProxyAlreadyRecorded`). The same proxy and identifier again
    /// are accepted and the store sealed unchanged in content, so a retry
    /// after a lost write succeeds.
    pub fn record_founding_proxy<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
        &mut self,
        rng: &mut R,
        device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
        org_id: OrgId,
        proxy: ChainAccount,
    ) -> Result<StoreChange, OrgNodeError> {
        let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
        let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
            let founding = data.founding.as_mut().ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalFounding)?;
            if founding.proxy.is_some_and(|held| held != proxy) || data.persona.org_id.is_some_and(|held| held != org_id) {
                return Err(OrgNodeError::FoundingProxyAlreadyRecorded);
            }
            founding.proxy = Some(proxy);
            data.persona.org_id = Some(org_id);
            Ok(())
        })?;
        Ok(StoreChange::Sealed(write))
    }
```

Add, after `fn record_index` in `impl OrgService`:

```rust
    /// Add the new store `data` keyed from `secret`, sealed with a fresh
    /// nonce: refused (`DuplicatePersonaStore`) when a store with its Device
    /// key is held, adding nothing (LLR-f9x3vf).
    fn add_store<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
        &mut self,
        rng: &mut R,
        secret: &DeviceSecret,
        data: StoreData,
    ) -> Result<StoreChange, OrgNodeError> {
        if self.store_index(&data.persona.device_key).is_ok() {
            return Err(OrgNodeError::DuplicatePersonaStore);
        }
        let store = PersonaStore::create(secret, data)?;
        let write = store.seal(rng)?;
        self.stores.push(store);
        Ok(StoreChange::Sealed(write))
    }
```

```rust
    /// An open store over `data`, keyed from `secret`, whose Device key must
    /// be `data`'s Persona's. The secret is borrowed: the operation that
    /// adds a store returns it to its caller.
    pub(crate) fn create(secret: &DeviceSecret, data: StoreData) -> Result<Self, OrgNodeError> {
        if secret.device_key() != data.persona.device_key {
            return Err(OrgNodeError::DeviceSecretMismatch);
        }
        let key = cipher(secret, &data.persona.device_key)?;
        Ok(Self { key, data })
    }
```

```rust
        self.seal_data(&self.data, rng)
    }
```

```rust
// Normal: a Persona's Organisation is set once, by `propose_member` (at its

#[test]
fn a_personas_organisation_is_written_only_by_propose_member_and_record_founding_proxy() {
    let code: String = include_str!("../src/service.rs")
        .lines()
        .map(|line| line.split("//").next().unwrap_or_default())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n");
    let mut writers = vec![];
    for (offset, _) in code.match_indices("persona.org_id = ") {
        let before = &code[..offset];
        let function = before.rfind("pub fn ").map(|start| &before[start + 7..]).unwrap_or_default();
        writers.push(function.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || *c == '_').collect::<String>());
    }
    assert_eq!(writers, ["record_founding_proxy"], "persona.org_id is assigned only by record_founding_proxy");
    let propose_member = &code[code.find("pub fn propose_member<").unwrap()..];
    let propose_member = &propose_member[..propose_member.find("\n    }\n").unwrap()];
    assert!(propose_member.contains("org_id: Some(org_id)"), "propose_member sets it at the store's creation");
    for file in [include_str!("../src/store.rs"), include_str!("../src/revocation.rs"), include_str!("../src/invitation.rs")] {
        assert!(!file.contains("persona.org_id = "), "no other source file writes it");
    }
    // Behaviour: the identifier a store is created with stays.
    let mut svc = service();
    let org_id = OrgId::new([7; 20]);
    let (device, _, _) = join(&mut svc, &invite_to(org_id, device_key(0x23))).unwrap();
    let _ = svc.build_invite(&mut OsRng, &device, "X".into(), vec![]);
    assert_eq!(svc.store_data(&device).unwrap().persona.org_id, Some(org_id));
}
```

```rust
//! OrgService: one sealed Persona store per Persona (LLR-f9x3vf), each one
//! Persona's view of one Organisation (SDD-undd7q).
//!
//! It reads no chain: the one operation that judges against the chain takes
//! the Organisation's state as a value (LLR-7en38k). It binds no endpoint and
//! sends and receives nothing: org-io receives a body and its sender and
//! hands them to `check_received`, and sends the messages org-node builds.
//!
//! It writes no file: every operation that changes a store returns at most
//! one `StoreChange` for org-io to write (LLR-ay8nvu). A refusal changes
//! nothing: each change is made on a copy of the store's data, sealed, and
//! only then adopted.
//!
//! *Stripped 2026-10-21 (T5 of docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md):*
//! the commit path and every operation this change supersedes are removed;
//! the proposal, verification and receive operations that replace them come
//! in the tasks after T5.
//!
//! Gated on the `app` feature.
use org_members::hasher::Blake3Hasher;
use org_members::trie::OrgTrie;
use org_members::{DevicePublicKey, Handle, MemberId, MemberLeaf, Name, PersonPublicKey, Surname};
use rand_core::{CryptoRng, RngCore};

use crate::error::OrgNodeError;
use crate::ids::OrgId;
use crate::invitation::{EndpointAddresses, Invite, InviteId};
use crate::keys::{DeviceSecret, X25519Keypair};
use crate::revocation::{Acknowledgement, RevocationNotice, VerifiedAcknowledgement};
use crate::store::{
    check_preferred_handles, parse_field, parse_members, ExpectedAdmission, MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord,
    OutstandingInvite, PersonaRecord, PersonaStatus, PersonaStore, ProvisionalFounding, ProvisionalMember,
    RawMemberSnapshot, StoreData, StoreWrite,
};
use crate::types::{ChainAccount, Epoch, PersonaId};
use crate::wire::{decode_message, WireMessage};
```

Add, after `fn record_founding_proxy` in `impl OrgService`:

```rust
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // Proposing a Member (SDD-hwax8v).
    // ----------------------------------------------------------

    /// Propose to join the Organisation of `invite` as a new Persona
    /// (LLR-6acxu9, LLR-rjphn4, LLR-w2uyyh). The name, surname and each
    /// preferred Handle are parsed, in that order (`InvalidField`
    /// `member.name`, `member.surname`, `member.preferred_handles[i]`), and
    /// the Handles checked to be one to three and pairwise distinct
    /// (`member.preferred_handles`); an Organisation a held store is bound
    /// to or expects admission to is refused
    /// (`OrganisationHeldByAnotherPersona`) — all before any draw, adding no
    /// store. Then a fresh Device seed and member seed are drawn for this
    /// Organisation alone, and a new store added holding the Persona
    /// (`org_id` the Invite's, no Handle, `Proposed`), the Invite's
    /// Organisation name, the provisional Member and one expected admission;
    /// no chain operation. The secret is returned by value and org-node
    /// keeps no copy.
    pub fn propose_member<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
        &mut self,
        rng: &mut R,
        invite: &Invite,
        name: &str,
        surname: &str,
        handles: &[&str],
    ) -> Result<(DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, StoreChange), OrgNodeError> {
        const HANDLE_FIELDS: [&str; 3] =
            ["member.preferred_handles[0]", "member.preferred_handles[1]", "member.preferred_handles[2]"];
        let name = parse_field("member.name", Name::parse(name))?;
        let surname = parse_field("member.surname", Surname::parse(surname))?;
        let preferred_handles = handles
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(index, handle)| {
                parse_field(HANDLE_FIELDS.get(index).copied().unwrap_or("member.preferred_handles"), Handle::parse(handle))
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
        check_preferred_handles("member.preferred_handles", &preferred_handles)?;
        let org_id = invite.org_id;
        let held_elsewhere = self.stores.iter().map(PersonaStore::data).any(|data| {
            data.persona.org_id == Some(org_id)
                || data.record.as_ref().is_some_and(|record| record.org_id == org_id)
                || data.expected_admissions.iter().any(|expected| expected.org_id == org_id)
        });
        if held_elsewhere {
            return Err(OrgNodeError::OrganisationHeldByAnotherPersona { org_id });
        }
        let secret = DeviceSecret::generate(rng);
        let member = X25519Keypair::generate(rng);
        let member_key = member.member_key()?;
        let persona = PersonaRecord {
            persona_id: persona_id_for(&member_key),
            org_id: Some(org_id),
            name: name.clone(),
            surname: surname.clone(),
            handle: None,
            member_seed: member.member_seed(),
            device_key: secret.device_key(),
            member_id: None,
            status: PersonaStatus::Proposed,
        };
        let provisional = ProvisionalMember {
            org_id,
            invite_id: invite.invite_id,
            issuer: invite.issuer,
            issuer_addresses: invite.issuer_addresses.clone(),
            name,
            surname,
            preferred_handles,
            member_key,
            device_key: secret.device_key(),
        };
        let data = StoreData {
            org_name: invite.org_name.clone(),
            member: Some(provisional),
            expected_admissions: vec![ExpectedAdmission { org_id }],
            ..StoreData::new(persona)
        };
        let change = self.add_store(rng, &secret, data)?;
        Ok((secret.device_key(), secret, change))
    }
```
