   ```rust
   #![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]
   //! Verification of one Organisation against the chain (SDD-kegag2; plan
   //! docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md, T14 and T17–T19): `verify`
   //! judges the chain state org-io read against the store's record and its
   //! provisional organisations, adopts only a match, and otherwise changes no
   //! sealed byte and asks no secret.

   use std::cell::Cell;

   use org_node::error::OrgNodeError;
   use org_node::service::OrgService;
   use org_node::store::PersonaStore;
   use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, device_secret, seal_for_test, store_for_test};
   use org_node::{ChainAccount, Epoch, Inconsistency, RootHash, Verified};
   use rand::rngs::OsRng;

   /// Fixtures: stores holding a record of one Organisation, chain states,
   /// and the Organisation information a listed Device sends.
   mod fx {
       use std::cell::Cell;

       use org_members::hasher::Blake3Hasher;
       use org_members::trie::OrgTrie;
       use org_members::MemberLeaf;
       use org_node::chain::OrgState;
       use org_node::envelope::Envelope;
       use org_node::error::OrgNodeError;
       use org_node::ids::OrgId;
       use org_node::service::{Checked, OrgService, StoreChange};
       use org_node::store::{
           MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord, OrgRecordParts, PersonaRecord, PersonaRecordParts, PersonaStatus, StoreData,
       };
       use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, device_secret, empty_store, member_key, store_for_test};
       use org_node::wire::{encode_message, WireMessage};
       use org_node::{
           DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, Epoch, Handle, MemberId, MemberSeed, Name, OrgPrivateKey, OrgPublicKey,
           PersonaId, RootHash, SequenceNumber, Surname, VerificationTime, Verified,
       };
       use rand::rngs::OsRng;

       pub type Trie = OrgTrie<Blake3Hasher>;

       /// Device seeds.
       pub const ADA: u8 = 0xa1;
       pub const BOB: u8 = 0xb1;
       pub const CAROL: u8 = 0xc1;
       /// The record's Organisation private key.
       pub const RECORD_KEY: [u8; 32] = [0x3d; 32];

       pub fn org() -> OrgId {
           OrgId::new([0x0a; 20])
       }

       pub fn snapshot(id: u8, handle: &str, member: u8, devices: &[u8]) -> MemberSnapshot {
           MemberSnapshot {
               id: MemberId::new([id; 32]),
               handle: Handle::parse(handle).unwrap(),
               name: Name::parse("Test").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("Member").unwrap(),
               member_key: member_key(member),
               device_keys: devices.iter().map(|seed| device_key(*seed)).collect(),
           }
       }

       pub fn ada() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x01, "ada", 0x61, &[ADA])
       }

       pub fn bob() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x02, "bob", 0x62, &[BOB])
       }

       pub fn carol() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x03, "carol", 0x63, &[CAROL])
       }

       pub fn leaf_of(s: &MemberSnapshot) -> MemberLeaf {
           MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone())
               .unwrap()
       }

       pub fn trie_of(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> Trie {
           Trie::genesis(members.iter().map(leaf_of).collect()).unwrap()
       }

       /// The trie's members, in the trie's order, as a record holds them.
       pub fn snapshots_of(trie: &Trie) -> Vec<MemberSnapshot> {
           trie.members()
               .iter()
               .map(|m| MemberSnapshot {
                   id: *m.id(),
                   handle: m.handle().clone(),
                   name: m.name().clone(),
                   surname: m.surname().clone(),
                   member_key: *m.p2p_key(),
                   device_keys: m.p2p_devices().to_vec(),
               })
               .collect()
       }

       pub fn public_key(secret: [u8; 32]) -> OrgPublicKey {
           OrgPrivateKey::from(secret).x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap()
       }

       pub fn record(epoch: u64, members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> OrgRecord {
           let trie = trie_of(members);
           OrgRecord::from(OrgRecordParts {
               org_id: org(),
               root_hash: trie.root_hash().unwrap(),
               org_pub_key: public_key(RECORD_KEY),
               epoch: Epoch::new(epoch),
               last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch),
               trie_members: snapshots_of(&trie),
               proxy_account: None,
               org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey::from(RECORD_KEY),
               kept_change_set: None,
               kept_base_snapshot: None,
           })
       }

       /// The Persona `of` lists, Active in the Organisation.
       pub fn persona(of: &MemberSnapshot, member: u8) -> PersonaRecord {
           PersonaRecord::from(PersonaRecordParts {
               persona_id: PersonaId::new(of.handle.as_str().to_string()),
               org_id: Some(org()),
               name: of.name.clone(),
               surname: of.surname.clone(),
               handle: Some(of.handle.clone()),
               member_seed: MemberSeed::from([member; 32]),
               device_key: of.device_keys[0],
               member_id: Some(of.id),
               status: PersonaStatus::Active,
           })
       }

       /// Ada's store: a record at `epoch` listing `members`.
       pub fn ada_store(epoch: u64, members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> StoreData {
           let mut data = empty_store(persona(&ada(), 0x61));
           data.org_name = "Acme".to_string();
           data.record = Some(record(epoch, members));
           data
       }

       pub fn service(device: u8, data: StoreData) -> OrgService {
           OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&device_secret([device; 32]), data)]).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn data(svc: &OrgService, device: u8) -> &StoreData {
           svc.store_data(&device_key(device)).unwrap()
       }

       /// The store's plaintext as it is sealed (the behind marker is not in it).
       pub fn plaintext(svc: &OrgService, device: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
           postcard::to_allocvec(data(svc, device)).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn record_root(svc: &OrgService, device: u8) -> RootHash {
           data(svc, device).record.as_ref().unwrap().root_hash
       }

       pub fn chain(epoch: u64, root: RootHash, key: OrgPublicKey) -> OrgState {
           OrgState { root_hash: root, org_pub_key: key, epoch: Epoch::new(epoch) }
       }

       /// `verify` on `device`'s store against `state`, recording in `asked`
       /// whether the secret source was called.
       pub fn verify(
           svc: &mut OrgService,
           device: u8,
           state: Option<OrgState>,
           asked: &Cell<bool>,
       ) -> Result<(Verified, Option<StoreChange>), OrgNodeError> {
           svc.verify(&mut OsRng, &device_key(device), state, VerificationTime(1_760_000_000), |_: &[DevicePublicKey]| -> Vec<DeviceSecret> {
               asked.set(true);
               Vec::new()
           })
       }

       /// The Organisation information a listed Device sends for the epoch
       /// after a record at `base_epoch` listing `base`, admitting `added`
       /// and carrying the private key `key`: the body, the next record's
       /// root and the key's public half.
       pub fn information(
           base_epoch: u64,
           base: &[MemberSnapshot],
           added: &MemberSnapshot,
           key: [u8; 32],
       ) -> (Vec<u8>, RootHash, OrgPublicKey) {
           let base_trie = trie_of(base);
           let (next, delta) = base_trie.add_member(leaf_of(added)).unwrap().recalculate().unwrap();
           let envelope = Envelope::build(org(), SequenceNumber::new(base_epoch + 1), &delta).unwrap();
           let body = encode_message(&WireMessage::OrgInformation {
               envelope,
               record_snapshot: postcard::to_allocvec(&snapshots_of(&base_trie)).unwrap(),
               org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey::from(key),
           })
           .unwrap();
           (body, next.root_hash().unwrap(), public_key(key))
       }

       /// `body` received by `device`'s store from `sender`, which must keep
       /// it as a provisional organisation; returns its epoch.
       pub fn receive(svc: &mut OrgService, device: u8, sender: u8, body: &[u8]) -> Epoch {
           match svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &device_key(device), device_key(sender), body).unwrap() {
               (Checked::ProvisionalOrganisationKept { epoch }, Some(_sealed)) => epoch,
               _ => panic!("the Organisation information is not kept"),
           }
       }
   }

   // ---- T14: judgement without adoption, and the behind marker -------------------

   // No chain state is `OrgNotOnChain`; a founding store whose proxy is not
   // recorded is `FoundingNotWritten` whatever state is passed, since it has
   // no Organisation to read; neither asks a secret.
   // verifies: LLR-rr558z
   #[test]
   fn no_chain_state_is_org_not_on_chain_and_a_founding_without_proxy_is_founding_not_written() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       assert_eq!(fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, None, &asked).unwrap_err(), OrgNodeError::OrgNotOnChain);

       let mut founder = OrgService::new(Vec::new()).unwrap();
       let (key, _secret, _sealed) = founder.propose_founding(&mut OsRng, "Ada", "Lovelace", "ada", "Acme".to_string()).unwrap();
       let (root, org_pub_key) = {
           let founding = founder.store_data(&key).unwrap().founding.as_ref().unwrap();
           (founding.root, founding.org_pub_key)
       };
       for state in [None, Some(fx::chain(1, root, org_pub_key))] {
           let refused = founder.verify(&mut OsRng, &key, state, org_node::VerificationTime(1), |_: &[org_node::DevicePublicKey]| {
               asked.set(true);
               Vec::<org_node::DeviceSecret>::new()
           });
           assert_eq!(refused.unwrap_err(), OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten);
       }
       assert!(!asked.get(), "no secret asked");
   }

   // A chain state behind the record, or at its epoch with another root, is
   // `Inconsistent`, naming which.
   // verifies: LLR-rr558z
   #[test]
   fn a_chain_behind_the_record_or_at_its_epoch_with_another_root_is_inconsistent() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       let (root, key) = (fx::record_root(&svc, fx::ADA), fx::public_key(fx::RECORD_KEY));
       let (behind, change) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(2, root, key)), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(
           behind,
           Verified::Inconsistent {
               reason: Inconsistency::ChainBehindRecord { chain_epoch: Epoch::new(2), record_epoch: Epoch::new(3) }
           }
       );
       assert!(change.is_none());
       let (other, change) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(3, RootHash::new([0x5e; 32]), key)), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(other, Verified::Inconsistent { reason: Inconsistency::OtherRoot { epoch: Epoch::new(3) } });
       assert!(change.is_none());
   }

   // The chain at the record's epoch holding the record's root is in step.
   // verifies: LLR-rr558z
   #[test]
   fn the_records_epoch_and_root_are_in_step() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       let root = fx::record_root(&svc, fx::ADA);
       let (verified, change) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(3, root, fx::public_key(fx::RECORD_KEY))), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(verified, Verified::InStep);
       assert!(change.is_none());
   }

   // A greater epoch that no held provisional organisation matches is
   // `Behind`; so is any state but the founding's in a founding store with
   // its proxy recorded.
   // verifies: LLR-rr558z
   #[test]
   fn a_greater_epoch_with_no_match_is_behind() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       let root = fx::record_root(&svc, fx::ADA);
       let (verified, _none) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(4, root, fx::public_key([0x4c; 32]))), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(verified, Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: Epoch::new(4) });

       let mut founder = OrgService::new(Vec::new()).unwrap();
       let (key, _secret, _sealed) = founder.propose_founding(&mut OsRng, "Ada", "Lovelace", "ada", "Acme".to_string()).unwrap();
       let _recorded = founder.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &key, fx::org(), ChainAccount::new([7; 32])).unwrap();
       let org_pub_key = founder.store_data(&key).unwrap().founding.as_ref().unwrap().org_pub_key;
       for state in [fx::chain(1, RootHash::new([0x5e; 32]), org_pub_key), fx::chain(2, RootHash::new([0x5e; 32]), org_pub_key)] {
           let (verified, change) = founder
               .verify(&mut OsRng, &key, Some(state), org_node::VerificationTime(1), |_: &[org_node::DevicePublicKey]| {
                   Vec::<org_node::DeviceSecret>::new()
               })
               .unwrap();
           assert_eq!(verified, Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: state.epoch });
           assert!(change.is_none());
       }
   }

   // `InStep`, `Behind`, `Inconsistent` and the refusal change no sealed
   // byte, return no store change and never ask a secret.
   // verifies: LLR-qvp7mq
   #[test]
   fn in_step_behind_inconsistent_and_refusals_change_no_sealed_byte_and_ask_no_secret() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       let (root, key) = (fx::record_root(&svc, fx::ADA), fx::public_key(fx::RECORD_KEY));
       let before = fx::plaintext(&svc, fx::ADA);
       for state in [
           None,
           Some(fx::chain(2, root, key)),
           Some(fx::chain(3, RootHash::new([0x5e; 32]), key)),
           Some(fx::chain(3, root, key)),
           Some(fx::chain(4, root, key)),
       ] {
           match fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, state, &asked) {
               Ok((_verified, change)) => assert!(change.is_none(), "no store change for {state:?}"),
               Err(error) => assert_eq!(error, OrgNodeError::OrgNotOnChain),
           }
           assert_eq!(fx::plaintext(&svc, fx::ADA), before, "no sealed byte changes for {state:?}");
       }
       assert!(!asked.get(), "no secret asked");
   }

   // `Behind` sets the marker and `InStep` clears it, changing no sealed
   // byte; a store unsealed holds no marker.
   // verifies: LLR-zk7fx2
   #[test]
   fn behind_sets_the_marker_in_step_clears_it_and_unseal_leaves_it_none() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       let (root, key) = (fx::record_root(&svc, fx::ADA), fx::public_key(fx::RECORD_KEY));
       let before = fx::plaintext(&svc, fx::ADA);
       let (_behind, _none) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(4, root, key)), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(fx::data(&svc, fx::ADA).behind, Some(Epoch::new(4)));
       assert_eq!(fx::plaintext(&svc, fx::ADA), before, "the marker is not sealed");
       let (_in_step, _none) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(3, root, key)), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(fx::data(&svc, fx::ADA).behind, None);

       let mut marked = fx::ada_store(3, &[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]);
       marked.behind = Some(Epoch::new(4));
       let store = store_for_test(&device_secret([fx::ADA; 32]), marked);
       let write = seal_for_test(&store, &mut OsRng);
       let reopened = PersonaStore::unseal(&write.sealed, device_key(fx::ADA), device_secret([fx::ADA; 32])).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(reopened.data().behind, None);
   }

   fn verify_reports_one_outcome_from_the_record_and_the_state() {
   ```

   ```rust
   //! Verification of one Organisation against the chain (SDD-kegag2): the
   //! judgement of a chain state against the store's record and its
   //! provisional organisations. Pure functions over values (LLR-g2jeqd): no
   //! chain, transport, endpoint, file-system or clock function is called.
   use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

   use crate::chain::OrgState;
   use crate::store::StoreData;
   use crate::types::Epoch;

   /// The caller's time of a verification, in seconds since the Unix epoch
   /// (LLR-rr558z); org-node reads no clock and keeps it only on a removal.
   #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   #[serde(transparent)]
   pub struct VerificationTime(pub u64);

   /// Why a chain state contradicts the record (LLR-rr558z).
   #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub enum Inconsistency {
       /// The chain is at an epoch below the record's.
       ChainBehindRecord { chain_epoch: Epoch, record_epoch: Epoch },
       /// The chain is at the record's epoch with another root.
       OtherRoot { epoch: Epoch },
   }

   /// What `OrgService::verify` decided: exactly one outcome (LLR-rr558z).
   #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub enum Verified {
       InStep,
       Behind { chain_epoch: Epoch },
       Inconsistent { reason: Inconsistency },
   }

   /// The outcome of `chain` against `store` (LLR-rr558z): with a record,
   /// a lower epoch or the same epoch with another root is inconsistent and
   /// the same epoch and root in step; a greater epoch, or any state in a
   /// store with no record, is behind (the match arm comes with adoption).
   pub(crate) fn judge(store: &StoreData, chain: &OrgState) -> Verified {
       if let Some(record) = &store.record {
           if chain.epoch < record.epoch {
               return Verified::Inconsistent {
                   reason: Inconsistency::ChainBehindRecord { chain_epoch: chain.epoch, record_epoch: record.epoch },
               };
           }
           if chain.epoch == record.epoch {
               return if chain.root_hash == record.root_hash {
                   Verified::InStep
               } else {
                   Verified::Inconsistent { reason: Inconsistency::OtherRoot { epoch: chain.epoch } }
               };
           }
       }
       Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: chain.epoch }
   }
   ```
   - `org-node/src/lib.rs`: beside `pub mod service;`, add `#[cfg(feature = "app")] pub mod verify_org;`. Add `#[cfg(feature = "app")] pub use verify_org::{Inconsistency, VerificationTime, Verified};`.
   - `org-node/src/service.rs`: add `use crate::verify_org::{VerificationTime, Verified};`, then add `verify` and the marker helper. `_rng`, `_verified_at` and `_device_secrets` are used from T17 and T24. The founding refusal comes first: a founding with no proxy has no Organisation to read, so whatever state is passed it is `FoundingNotWritten`.
   ```rust
       /// Verify the store `device_key` names against `chain`, the
       /// Organisation state org-io read at a finalised block (LLR-rr558z):
       /// a founding with no proxy recorded is `FoundingNotWritten`, no state
       /// `OrgNotOnChain`, and otherwise exactly one `Verified`. `InStep`,
       /// `Behind` and `Inconsistent` return no store change and call
       /// `device_secrets` never; only the behind marker, which is not
       /// sealed, changes (LLR-qvp7mq, LLR-zk7fx2).
       pub fn verify<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
           &mut self,
           _rng: &mut R,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           chain: Option<OrgState>,
           _verified_at: VerificationTime,
           _device_secrets: impl FnOnce(&[DevicePublicKey]) -> Vec<DeviceSecret>,
       ) -> Result<(Verified, Option<StoreChange>), OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let data = self.stores[index].data();
           if data.founding.as_ref().is_some_and(|founding| founding.proxy.is_none()) {
               return Err(OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten);
           }
           let chain = chain.ok_or(OrgNodeError::OrgNotOnChain)?;
           let verified = crate::verify_org::judge(data, &chain);
           mark(self.stores[index].data_mut(), &verified);
           Ok((verified, None))
       }
   ```
   And as a free function beside the other private helpers:

   ```rust
   /// The behind marker after `verified` (LLR-zk7fx2): set on `Behind`,
   /// cleared on `InStep`, left as it was otherwise.
   fn mark(data: &mut StoreData, verified: &Verified) {
       match verified {
           Verified::Behind { chain_epoch } => data.behind = Some(*chain_epoch),
           Verified::InStep => data.behind = None,
           Verified::Inconsistent { .. } => {}
       }
   }
   ```

Its Admin store is built from values: Ada is the Persona; the record at epoch 3 lists Ada and Bob; two admission requests are kept (Carol's for invite `0x11`, preferring bob, carol, cee; Dave's for invite `0x12`, preferring carol, dave), each with its outstanding invite.

   ```rust
   /// Fixtures of the Admin's provisional changes (T15, T16): Ada's store,
   /// holding a record at epoch 3 that lists Ada and Bob, and two kept
   /// admission requests with their outstanding invites.
   mod rc {
       use org_members::hasher::Blake3Hasher;
       use org_members::trie::OrgTrie;
       use org_members::MemberLeaf;
       use org_node::chain::OrgState;
       use org_node::ids::OrgId;
       use org_node::invitation::InviteId;
       use org_node::service::{OrgService, StoreChange};
       use org_node::invitation::EndpointAddresses;
       use org_node::store::{
           KeptAdmissionRequest, MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord, OrgRecordParts, OutstandingInvite,
           PersonaRecord, PersonaRecordParts, PersonaStatus, ProvisionalChange, StoreData, StoreWrite,
           MAX_PROVISIONAL_BYTES,
       };
       use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, device_secret, empty_store, member_key, store_for_test};
       use org_node::{
           DevicePublicKey, Epoch, Handle, MemberId, MemberSeed, Name, OrgPrivateKey, OrgPublicKey, PersonaId, RootHash,
           SequenceNumber, Surname,
       };

       pub type Trie = OrgTrie<Blake3Hasher>;

       /// Device seeds.
       pub const ADA: u8 = 0xa1;
       pub const BOB: u8 = 0xb1;
       pub const CAROL: u8 = 0xc1;
       pub const DAVE: u8 = 0xd1;
       /// The record's Organisation private key.
       pub const RECORD_KEY: [u8; 32] = [0x3d; 32];

       pub fn org() -> OrgId {
           OrgId::new([0x0b; 20])
       }

       pub fn h(handle: &str) -> Handle {
           Handle::parse(handle).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn snapshot(id: u8, handle: &str, member: u8, device: u8) -> MemberSnapshot {
           MemberSnapshot {
               id: MemberId::new([id; 32]),
               handle: h(handle),
               name: Name::parse("Test").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("Member").unwrap(),
               member_key: member_key(member),
               device_keys: vec![device_key(device)],
           }
       }

       pub fn ada_snapshot() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x01, "ada", 0x61, ADA)
       }

       pub fn bob_snapshot() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x02, "bob", 0x62, BOB)
       }

       pub fn trie_of(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> Trie {
           let leaves = members
               .iter()
               .map(|s| {
                   MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone())
                       .unwrap()
               })
               .collect();
           Trie::genesis(leaves).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn public_key(secret: [u8; 32]) -> OrgPublicKey {
           OrgPrivateKey::from(secret).x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap()
       }

       pub fn record(epoch: u64, members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> OrgRecord {
           OrgRecord::from(OrgRecordParts {
               org_id: org(),
               root_hash: trie_of(members).root_hash().unwrap(),
               org_pub_key: public_key(RECORD_KEY),
               epoch: Epoch::new(epoch),
               last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch),
               trie_members: members.to_vec(),
               proxy_account: None,
               org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey::from(RECORD_KEY),
               kept_change_set: None,
               kept_base_snapshot: None,
           })
       }

       fn persona(of: &MemberSnapshot, member: u8) -> PersonaRecord {
           PersonaRecord::from(PersonaRecordParts {
               persona_id: PersonaId::new(of.handle.as_str().to_string()),
               org_id: Some(org()),
               name: of.name.clone(),
               surname: of.surname.clone(),
               handle: Some(of.handle.clone()),
               member_seed: MemberSeed::from([member; 32]),
               device_key: of.device_keys[0],
               member_id: Some(of.id),
               status: PersonaStatus::Active,
           })
       }

       pub fn invite(byte: u8) -> InviteId {
           InviteId::new([byte; 32])
       }

       /// A request kept for `invite` from the Device of seed `device`.
       pub fn request(invite_byte: u8, name: &str, member: u8, device: u8, handles: &[&str]) -> KeptAdmissionRequest {
           KeptAdmissionRequest {
               org_id: org(),
               invite_id: invite(invite_byte),
               from: device_key(device),
               name: Name::parse(name).unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("Joiner").unwrap(),
               preferred_handles: handles.iter().map(|handle| h(handle)).collect(),
               member_key: member_key(member),
               device_key: device_key(device),
               addresses: EndpointAddresses::parse(vec![format!("10.0.0.{device}:4433")]).unwrap(),
           }
       }

       pub fn outstanding(invite_byte: u8, invitee_name: &str) -> OutstandingInvite {
           OutstandingInvite { org_id: org(), invite_id: invite(invite_byte), invitee_name: invitee_name.to_string() }
       }

       /// Ada's store: the record at epoch 3 listing Ada and Bob; Carol's and
       /// Dave's requests kept, each with its outstanding invite.
       pub fn admin_store() -> StoreData {
           let mut data = empty_store(persona(&ada_snapshot(), 0x61));
           data.org_name = "Acme".to_string();
           data.record = Some(record(3, &[ada_snapshot(), bob_snapshot()]));
           data.kept_admission_requests = vec![
               request(0x11, "Carol", 0x63, CAROL, &["bob", "carol", "cee"]),
               request(0x12, "Dave", 0x64, DAVE, &["carol", "dave"]),
           ];
           data.outstanding_invites = vec![outstanding(0x11, "Carol"), outstanding(0x12, "Dave")];
           data
       }

       pub fn service(data: StoreData) -> OrgService {
           OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&device_secret([ADA; 32]), data)]).unwrap()
       }

       /// Ada's Device key: the store every operation below names.
       pub fn me() -> DevicePublicKey {
           device_key(ADA)
       }

       pub fn data(svc: &OrgService) -> &StoreData {
           svc.store_data(&me()).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn plaintext(svc: &OrgService) -> Vec<u8> {
           postcard::to_allocvec(data(svc)).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn record_root(svc: &OrgService) -> RootHash {
           data(svc).record.as_ref().unwrap().root_hash
       }

       pub fn chain(epoch: u64, root: RootHash, key: OrgPublicKey) -> OrgState {
           OrgState { root_hash: root, org_pub_key: key, epoch: Epoch::new(epoch) }
       }

       /// The one store write a change is (LLR-ay8nvu: `Sealed` only).
       pub fn sealed(change: StoreChange) -> StoreWrite {
           let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = change;
           write
       }

       /// The postcard length of the tuple LLR-m76r4k measures, for `data`.
       pub fn bound_len(data: &StoreData) -> usize {
           let mut without = data.clone();
           without.provisional_changes.clear();
           without.provisional_organisations.clear();
           without.kept_revocation_notices.clear();
           postcard::to_allocvec(data).unwrap().len() - postcard::to_allocvec(&without).unwrap().len() + 3
       }

       /// `count` distinct `Revoke` changes, as padding.
       pub fn revokes(count: usize) -> Vec<ProvisionalChange> {
           (0..count)
               .map(|i| {
                   let mut id = [0x77u8; 32];
                   id[..8].copy_from_slice(&(i as u64).to_le_bytes());
                   ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: MemberId::new(id) }
               })
               .collect()
       }

       /// `data` padded with the fewest `Revoke` changes for which keeping
       /// `extra` as well exceeds the bound; the padded store is within it.
       pub fn filled_before(data: &StoreData, extra: &ProvisionalChange) -> StoreData {
           let with = |count: usize, plus: bool| {
               let mut filled = data.clone();
               filled.provisional_changes = revokes(count);
               if plus {
                   filled.provisional_changes.push(extra.clone());
               }
               filled
           };
           let per = bound_len(&with(1, false)) - bound_len(&with(0, false));
           let mut count = (MAX_PROVISIONAL_BYTES - bound_len(&with(0, true))) / per;
           while bound_len(&with(count, true)) <= MAX_PROVISIONAL_BYTES {
               count += 1;
           }
           while count > 0 && bound_len(&with(count - 1, true)) > MAX_PROVISIONAL_BYTES {
               count -= 1;
           }
           let filled = with(count, false);
           assert!(bound_len(&filled) <= MAX_PROVISIONAL_BYTES, "fixture: the padded store is within the bound");
           filled
       }
   }

   // Recording an admission and a revocation appends each, in order, to
   // `provisional_changes` and changes nothing else: the record is byte for
   // byte as it was, and each returns its store sealed.
   // verifies: LLR-b2hgd4
   #[test]
   fn recording_a_change_appends_it_and_leaves_the_record_byte_for_byte() {
       let mut svc = rc::service(rc::admin_store());
       let mut rest = rc::data(&svc).clone();
       let admitted = svc.record_admission(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me(), rc::invite(0x11), None).unwrap();
       let revoked = svc.record_revocation(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me(), org_node::MemberId::new([0x02; 32])).unwrap();
       let changes = vec![
           org_node::store::ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: rc::invite(0x11), handle: rc::h("carol") },
           org_node::store::ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: org_node::MemberId::new([0x02; 32]) },
       ];
       assert_eq!(rc::data(&svc).provisional_changes, changes);
       rest.provisional_changes = changes.clone();
       assert_eq!(rc::plaintext(&svc), postcard::to_allocvec(&rest).unwrap(), "no other field changes, the record none");
       let write = rc::sealed(revoked);
       let reopened = org_node::store::PersonaStore::unseal(
           &write.sealed,
           rc::me(),
           org_node::test_fixtures::device_secret([rc::ADA; 32]),
       )
       .unwrap();
       assert_eq!(reopened.data().provisional_changes, changes);
       let first = rc::sealed(admitted);
       assert_ne!(first.sealed, write.sealed, "each change returns its own sealed store");
   }
   ```

   ```rust
       /// Record the admission of the request kept for `invite_id`
       /// (LLR-bwtx3h): the first of its preferred Handles, in ranked order,
       /// that neither a member of the current record nor another `Admit`
       /// holds, else the parsed `chosen`; appends `Admit { invite_id,
       /// handle }` and changes nothing else (LLR-b2hgd4). Refused, recording
       /// nothing, as LLR-mq7n6u states.
       pub fn record_admission<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
           &mut self,
           rng: &mut R,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           invite_id: InviteId,
           chosen: Option<&str>,
       ) -> Result<StoreChange, OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
               let handle = admission_handle(data, invite_id, chosen)?;
               data.provisional_changes.push(ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id, handle });
               crate::store::ensure_within_bound(data)
           })?;
           Ok(StoreChange::Sealed(write))
       }

       /// Record the revocation of `member_id` (LLR-f3hru6): appends
       /// `Revoke { member_id }`; refuses a MemberId the record does not
       /// hold, one a `Revoke` already names, a store with no record, the
       /// behind marker set and the bound, recording nothing.
       pub fn record_revocation<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
           &mut self,
           rng: &mut R,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           member_id: MemberId,
       ) -> Result<StoreChange, OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
               let record = current_record(data)?;
               ensure_not_behind(data, record)?;
               if !record.trie_members.iter().any(|member| member.id == member_id) {
                   return Err(OrgNodeError::MemberNotHeld { member_id });
               }
               let named = |change: &ProvisionalChange| matches!(change, ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: m } if *m == member_id);
               if data.provisional_changes.iter().any(named) {
                   return Err(OrgNodeError::RevocationAlreadyRecorded { member_id });
               }
               data.provisional_changes.push(ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id });
               crate::store::ensure_within_bound(data)
           })?;
           Ok(StoreChange::Sealed(write))
       }
   ```
   `current_record` is T8's (`pub(crate) fn current_record(data: &StoreData) -> Result<&OrgRecord, OrgNodeError>` in
   `service.rs`: `OrgNotHeld` for a bound store with no record, `FoundingNotWritten` for a founding with no
   Organisation identifier); this task calls it and does not define it again. Free functions beside the other private
   helpers:
   ```rust
   /// Refuses while the behind marker is set (LLR-zk7fx2).
   fn ensure_not_behind(data: &StoreData, record: &OrgRecord) -> Result<(), OrgNodeError> {
       match data.behind {
           Some(chain_epoch) => Err(OrgNodeError::OrganisationBehind { org_id: record.org_id, chain_epoch }),
           None => Ok(()),
       }
   }

   /// The Handle an admission of the request kept for `invite_id` is given
   /// (LLR-bwtx3h), or the refusal LLR-mq7n6u states.
   fn admission_handle(data: &StoreData, invite_id: InviteId, chosen: Option<&str>) -> Result<Handle, OrgNodeError> {
       let record = current_record(data)?;
       ensure_not_behind(data, record)?;
       let request = data
           .kept_admission_requests
           .iter()
           .find(|request| request.invite_id == invite_id)
           .ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoAdmissionRequestKept)?;
       let names_invite =
           |change: &ProvisionalChange| matches!(change, ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: named, .. } if *named == invite_id);
       if data.provisional_changes.iter().any(names_invite) {
           return Err(OrgNodeError::AdmissionAlreadyRecorded);
       }
       let taken = |handle: &Handle| {
           record.trie_members.iter().any(|member| &member.handle == handle)
               || data
                   .provisional_changes
                   .iter()
                   .any(|change| matches!(change, ProvisionalChange::Admit { handle: given, .. } if given == handle))
       };
       if let Some(free) = request.preferred_handles.iter().find(|handle| !taken(handle)) {
           return Ok(free.clone());
       }
       let chosen = parse_field("admission.handle", Handle::parse(chosen.ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoFreeHandle)?))?;
       if taken(&chosen) {
           return Err(OrgNodeError::HandleTaken);
       }
       Ok(chosen)
   }
   ```
   *Note on the design:* LLR-mq7n6u gives `OrgNotHeld { org_id }` for a store with no record. A founding store with no proxy recorded has no `org_id` to name, so `current_record` answers `FoundingNotWritten` for it, which is LLR-rr558z's refusal for the same store. This adds no behaviour and no variant. It is said here so that the owner can confirm it.

**Intent:** `propose_updated_organisation(rng, device_key)` rebuilds the record's trie, applies every provisional change (an `Admit` with a MemberId drawn from `rng` and the kept request's values), calculates the root once, encodes the Change set, draws one Organisation key pair (`ensure_distinct_from`), and keeps an `Own` provisional organisation for epoch + 1 with its base root, base snapshot and `applied` copy. `provisional_changes`, `provisional_organisations` (`ProvisionalOrganisationView` with `current_proposal`) and `admission_requests` return borrowed views and clone no key. `persona_view` returns a `PersonaView`, a copy of the store's public values (the Persona's Device key and binding, the Organisation name, the record's `RecordView`, the founding's `FoundingView` with its proxy, and the Organisation a provisional Member asked to join): org-io's production read of a store in every build, `store_data` staying `test-support` (dispatcher decision O1, 2026-10-22; LLR-8ru6mv amended in place).

   ```rust
       /// A random source that serves `first` for its first 32 bytes and
       /// `then` after.
       pub struct TwoRng {
           first: u8,
           then: u8,
           served: usize,
       }

       impl TwoRng {
           pub fn new(first: u8, then: u8) -> Self {
               Self { first, then, served: 0 }
           }
       }

       impl RngCore for TwoRng {
           fn next_u32(&mut self) -> u32 {
               let mut bytes = [0u8; 4];
               self.fill_bytes(&mut bytes);
               u32::from_le_bytes(bytes)
           }
           fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
               let mut bytes = [0u8; 8];
               self.fill_bytes(&mut bytes);
               u64::from_le_bytes(bytes)
           }
           fn fill_bytes(&mut self, dest: &mut [u8]) {
               for byte in dest {
                   *byte = if self.served < 32 { self.first } else { self.then };
                   self.served += 1;
               }
           }
           fn try_fill_bytes(&mut self, dest: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), rand::Error> {
               self.fill_bytes(dest);
               Ok(())
           }
       }

       impl CryptoRng for TwoRng {}

           let _proposed = svc.propose_updated_organisation(&mut TwoRng::new(0x22, 0x4a), &me()).unwrap();
           svc
   ```

   ```rust
   // Every provisional change is applied in recorded order: Carol is added,
   // Bob deleted, and one `Own` provisional organisation for epoch 4 is kept
   // with the resulting members and root, the record's root as its base, the
   // record's members as its base snapshot, the Change set from the record,
   // the drawn key and a copy of the changes it applied.
   // verifies: LLR-va2yqz
   #[test]
   fn propose_updated_organisation_applies_every_change_in_order_and_keeps_one_own_provisional_organisation() {
       let mut svc = rc::service(rc::admin_store());
       let _admitted = svc.record_admission(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me(), rc::invite(0x11), None).unwrap();
       let _revoked = svc.record_revocation(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me(), org_node::MemberId::new([0x02; 32])).unwrap();
       let record = rc::data(&svc).record.clone().unwrap();
       let _proposed = svc.propose_updated_organisation(&mut rc::TwoRng::new(0x22, 0x4a), &rc::me()).unwrap();

       let data = rc::data(&svc);

       assert!(matches!(proposal.origin, org_node::store::Origin::Own));
       assert_eq!(proposal.epoch, org_node::Epoch::new(4));
       assert_eq!(proposal.base_root, record.root_hash);
       let mut ids: Vec<_> = proposal.members.iter().map(|member| member.id).collect();
       ids.sort();

       assert_eq!(proposal.root, rc::trie_of(&proposal.members).root_hash().unwrap());
       assert_eq!(proposal.org_pub_key, rc::public_key([0x4a; 32]));
       let delta: org_members::delta::Delta = postcard::from_bytes(proposal.change_set.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(delta.base_root(), &record.root_hash, "the Change set extends the record");
       assert_eq!(proposal.base_snapshot.clone().unwrap(), postcard::to_allocvec(&record.trie_members).unwrap());
       assert_eq!(proposal.applied, data.provisional_changes);

       assert_eq!(postcard::to_allocvec(rc::data(&svc).record.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap(), record);
   }

   // A drawn key whose public half is the record's Organisation public key
   // (draw `0x3d`) or Carol's Member-as-a-group key in the result (draw

   // then accepted.
   // verifies: LLR-qghs95
   #[test]
   fn a_key_equal_to_the_records_or_to_a_key_of_the_result_is_refused_keeping_nothing() {
       let mut svc = rc::service(rc::admin_store());

       let before = rc::plaintext(&svc);
       for then in [0x3d, 0x63] {
           let refused = svc.propose_updated_organisation(&mut rc::TwoRng::new(0x22, then), &rc::me());
           assert_eq!(
               refused.unwrap_err(),
               org_node::error::OrgNodeError::Trie(org_members::OrgMembersError::DuplicateKey),
               "draw {then:#x}"
           );
           assert_eq!(rc::plaintext(&svc), before, "nothing kept");

   // No provisional change, no record, the behind marker, a change
   // org-members refuses (Erin's request carries Bob's Device key) and the
   // bound are each refused, keeping nothing.
   // verifies: LLR-n6ssue
   #[test]
   fn propose_updated_organisation_refuses_no_change_no_record_behind_and_the_bound() {
       use org_node::error::OrgNodeError;
       let refuse = |svc: &mut org_node::service::OrgService| {
           let before = rc::plaintext(svc);
           let refused = svc.propose_updated_organisation(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me()).unwrap_err();
           assert_eq!(rc::plaintext(svc), before, "nothing kept");
           refused
       };
       assert_eq!(refuse(&mut rc::service(rc::admin_store())), OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalChange);

       let mut no_record = rc::admin_store();
       no_record.record = None;
       no_record.provisional_changes.push(org_node::store::ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: org_node::MemberId::new([0x02; 32]) });
       assert_eq!(refuse(&mut rc::service(no_record)), OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id: rc::org() });

       let mut behind = rc::service(rc::admin_store());
       let _admitted = behind.record_admission(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me(), rc::invite(0x11), None).unwrap();
       let state = rc::chain(4, rc::record_root(&behind), rc::public_key(rc::RECORD_KEY));
       let (_behind, _none) = behind
           .verify(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &rc::me(), Some(state), org_node::VerificationTime(1), |_: &[org_node::DevicePublicKey]| {
               Vec::<org_node::DeviceSecret>::new()
           })
           .unwrap();
       assert_eq!(
           refuse(&mut behind),
           OrgNodeError::OrganisationBehind { org_id: rc::org(), chain_epoch: org_node::Epoch::new(4) }
       );

       let mut duplicate = rc::admin_store();
       duplicate.kept_admission_requests.push(rc::request(0x14, "Erin", 0x65, rc::BOB, &["erin"]));
       duplicate.outstanding_invites.push(rc::outstanding(0x14, "Erin"));
       duplicate.provisional_changes.push(org_node::store::ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: rc::invite(0x14), handle: rc::h("erin") });
       assert_eq!(
           refuse(&mut rc::service(duplicate)),
           OrgNodeError::Trie(org_members::OrgMembersError::DuplicateKey)
       );

       let one = rc::data(&rc::proposed()).clone();
       let copies = |count: usize| {
           let mut filled = one.clone();
           filled.provisional_organisations = vec![one.provisional_organisations[0].clone(); count];
           filled
       };
       let max = org_node::store::MAX_PROVISIONAL_BYTES;
       let per = rc::bound_len(&copies(2)) - rc::bound_len(&copies(1));
       let mut count = (max - rc::bound_len(&copies(0))) / per;
       while rc::bound_len(&copies(count + 1)) <= max {
           count += 1;
       }
       while rc::bound_len(&copies(count)) > max {
           count -= 1;
       }
       assert_eq!(refuse(&mut rc::service(copies(count))), OrgNodeError::ProvisionalLimit { limit: max });
   }

   // The Persona view of a record store, of a founding store with its proxy
   // recorded and of a provisional Member's store copies their public values

   // the Organisation the Member asked to join), holds no seed, secret or
   // private key, and changes nothing; an unknown Device key is refused
   // (dispatcher decision O1).
   // verifies: LLR-8ru6mv
   #[test]
   fn persona_view_copies_each_stores_public_values_and_no_key() {
       let admin = rc::service(rc::admin_store());
       let before = rc::plaintext(&admin);
       let view = admin.persona_view(&rc::me()).unwrap();
       let data = rc::data(&admin);
       let record = data.record.as_ref().unwrap();
       assert_eq!((view.device_key, view.org_id), (rc::me(), data.persona.org_id));
       assert_eq!(view.org_name, data.org_name);

       assert_eq!(
           (held.org_id, held.root_hash, held.org_pub_key, held.epoch),
           (record.org_id, record.root_hash, record.org_pub_key, record.epoch)

       let mut svc = service();
       let (founder, _, _) = found(&mut svc);
       let (org_id, proxy) = (OrgId::new([7; 20]), ChainAccount::new([0x5a; 32]));
       let _ = svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &founder, org_id, proxy).unwrap();
       let invite = invite_to(OrgId::new([9; 20]), device_key(0x23));

       assert_eq!(founding_view.org_id, Some(org_id));
       assert!(founding_view.record.is_none() && founding_view.member_of.is_none());
       let held = founding_view.founding.as_ref().expect("the founding's public values");
       assert_eq!(
           (held.epoch, held.root, held.org_pub_key, held.proxy),
           (founding.epoch, founding.root, founding.org_pub_key, Some(proxy))
       );
       let member_view = svc.persona_view(&member).unwrap();
       assert_eq!((member_view.member_of, member_view.org_name.as_str()), (Some(invite.org_id), "Acme"));
       assert!(member_view.record.is_none() && member_view.founding.is_none());
       for rendered in [format!("{view:?}"), format!("{founding_view:?}"), format!("{member_view:?}")] {
           for secret in ["OrgPrivateKey", "MemberSeed", "DeviceSecret"] {
               assert!(!rendered.contains(secret), "no {secret} in a view: {rendered}");
           }

       assert_eq!(svc.persona_view(&device_key(0x77)).err(), Some(OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld));
       assert_eq!(plaintexts(&svc), before, "reading changes nothing");
   }
   ```

   - `org-node/src/service.rs`: add the proposal, its builder and the four views. The builder draws, in order, each `Admit`'s MemberId and then the one Organisation key pair, after the root is calculated (LLR-4rv4kr, LLR-qghs95). It runs outside `change`, because the seal inside `change` needs the same random source. Imports needed: `ProvisionalOrganisation`, `ProvisionalOrganisationView`, `PersonaView`, `RecordView`, `FoundingView`, `Origin`, `KeptAdmissionRequest` from `crate::store`, and `org_members::OrgMembersError`.
   ```rust
       /// Calculate the next epoch from every provisional change, in recorded
       /// order, and keep it as one `Own` provisional organisation for epoch
       /// + 1 (LLR-va2yqz); the changes stay held and the record is
       /// unchanged. Refused, keeping nothing, as LLR-n6ssue and LLR-qghs95
       /// state.
       pub fn propose_updated_organisation<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
           &mut self,
           rng: &mut R,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
       ) -> Result<StoreChange, OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let proposal = proposal_of(self.stores[index].data(), rng)?;
           let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
               data.provisional_organisations.push(proposal);
               crate::store::ensure_within_bound(data)
           })?;
           Ok(StoreChange::Sealed(write))
       }

       /// The store's provisional changes, in recorded order, by reference
       /// (LLR-8ru6mv).
       pub fn provisional_changes(&self, device_key: &DevicePublicKey) -> Result<&[ProvisionalChange], OrgNodeError> {
           Ok(&self.stores[self.store_index(device_key)?].data().provisional_changes)
       }

       /// Each provisional organisation's public values, with no private key
       /// (LLR-8ru6mv).
       pub fn provisional_organisations(
           &self,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
       ) -> Result<Vec<ProvisionalOrganisationView>, OrgNodeError> {
           let data = self.stores[self.store_index(device_key)?].data();
           let record_epoch = data.record.as_ref().map(|record| record.epoch);
           Ok(data
               .provisional_organisations
               .iter()
               .map(|held| {
                   let base_epoch = Epoch::new(held.epoch.get().saturating_sub(1));
                   let own = matches!(held.origin, Origin::Own);
                   ProvisionalOrganisationView {
                       epoch: held.epoch,
                       base_epoch,
                       root: held.root,
                       org_pub_key: held.org_pub_key,
                       origin: match held.origin {
                           Origin::Own => Origin::Own,
                           Origin::Received { from } => Origin::Received { from },
                           Origin::Answer { from } => Origin::Answer { from },
                       },
                       current_proposal: own
                           && record_epoch == Some(base_epoch)
                           && held.applied == data.provisional_changes,
                   }
               })
               .collect())
       }

       /// The kept admission requests, in kept order, each with the invitee
       /// name of the outstanding invite whose identifier it carries
       /// (LLR-8ru6mv). A request is kept only for an outstanding invite and
       /// both go together (LLR-6gkxpg, LLR-rzqs2u, LLR-ag8hjd), so the empty
       /// name is never returned in practice.
       pub fn admission_requests(
           &self,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
       ) -> Result<Vec<(&KeptAdmissionRequest, &str)>, OrgNodeError> {
           let data = self.stores[self.store_index(device_key)?].data();
           Ok(data
               .kept_admission_requests
               .iter()
               .map(|request| {
                   let name = data
                       .outstanding_invites
                       .iter()
                       .find(|invite| invite.org_id == request.org_id && invite.invite_id == request.invite_id)
                       .map_or("", |invite| invite.invitee_name.as_str());
                   (request, name)
               })
               .collect())
       }

       /// A copy of the public values of `device_key`'s store (LLR-8ru6mv):
       /// the Persona's Device key and binding, the Organisation name, the
       /// current record's values, the provisional founding's with its proxy,
       /// and the Organisation a provisional Member asked to join. It copies
       /// no seed, secret or private key and changes nothing; an unknown key
       /// is `PersonaNotHeld`.
       pub fn persona_view(&self, device_key: &DevicePublicKey) -> Result<PersonaView, OrgNodeError> {
           let data = self.stores[self.store_index(device_key)?].data();
           Ok(PersonaView {
               device_key: data.persona.device_key,
               org_id: data.persona.org_id,
               org_name: data.org_name.clone(),
               record: data.record.as_ref().map(|record| RecordView {
                   org_id: record.org_id,
                   root_hash: record.root_hash,
                   org_pub_key: record.org_pub_key,
                   epoch: record.epoch,
                   members: record.trie_members.clone(),
               }),
               founding: data.founding.as_ref().map(|founding| FoundingView {
                   epoch: founding.epoch,
                   root: founding.root,
                   org_pub_key: founding.org_pub_key,
                   proxy: founding.proxy,
               }),
               member_of: data.member.as_ref().map(|member| member.org_id),
           })
       }
   ```
   As a free function:
   ```rust
   /// The `Own` provisional organisation of the store's current record and
   /// provisional changes (LLR-va2yqz): the trie rebuilt, every change
   /// applied in recorded order (an `Admit` under a MemberId drawn from
   /// `rng` with the kept request's values), the root calculated once, the
   /// Change set encoded, then one Organisation key pair drawn and checked
   /// distinct (LLR-qghs95).
   fn proposal_of<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(data: &StoreData, rng: &mut R) -> Result<ProvisionalOrganisation, OrgNodeError> {
       let record = current_record(data)?;
       ensure_not_behind(data, record)?;
       if data.provisional_changes.is_empty() {
           return Err(OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalChange);
       }
       let mut trie = trie_from_snapshots(&record.trie_members)?;
       for change in &data.provisional_changes {
           trie = match change {
               ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id, handle } => {
                   let request = data
                       .kept_admission_requests
                       .iter()
                       .find(|request| request.invite_id == *invite_id)
                       .ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoAdmissionRequestKept)?;
                   let leaf = MemberLeaf::new(
                       fresh_member_id(rng),
                       handle.clone(),
                       request.member_key,
                       request.name.clone(),
                       request.surname.clone(),
                       vec![request.device_key],
                   )
                   .map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
                   trie.add_member(leaf).map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?
               }
               ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id } => trie.delete_member(member_id).map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?,
           };
       }
       let (next, delta) = trie.recalculate().map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
       let root = next.root_hash().map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
       let epoch = Epoch::new(record.epoch.get() + 1);
       let change_set = Envelope::build(record.org_id, SequenceNumber::new(epoch.get()), &delta)?.delta_bytes;
       let members = next.members();
       let org_kp = X25519Keypair::generate(rng);
       let org_pub_key = org_kp.org_public_key()?;
       if org_pub_key == record.org_pub_key {
           return Err(OrgNodeError::Trie(OrgMembersError::DuplicateKey));
       }
       org_pub_key.ensure_distinct_from(&members)?;
       Ok(ProvisionalOrganisation {
           epoch,
           base_root: record.root_hash,
           members: members.iter().map(snapshot_of).collect(),
           root,
           org_pub_key,
           org_private_key: org_kp.org_private_key(),
           change_set: Some(change_set),
           base_snapshot: Some(encode_record_snapshot(&record.trie_members)?),
           origin: Origin::Own,
           applied: data.provisional_changes.clone(),
       })
   }
   ```

   ```rust
       pub const DAVE: u8 = 0xd1;
       pub const EVE: u8 = 0xe1;

       pub fn eve() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x05, "eve", 0x65, &[EVE])
       }

       pub fn dave() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x04, "dave", 0x64, &[DAVE])
       }

       pub fn invite(byte: u8) -> InviteId {
           InviteId::new([byte; 32])
       }

       pub fn addresses(entries: &[&str]) -> EndpointAddresses {
           EndpointAddresses::parse(entries.iter().map(|entry| entry.to_string()).collect()).unwrap()
       }

       /// The request `joiner`'s Device sent for `invite_byte`, kept.
       pub fn request(invite_byte: u8, joiner: &MemberSnapshot, handles: &[&str]) -> KeptAdmissionRequest {
           KeptAdmissionRequest {
               org_id: org(),
               invite_id: invite(invite_byte),
               from: joiner.device_keys[0],
               name: joiner.name.clone(),
               surname: joiner.surname.clone(),
               preferred_handles: handles.iter().map(|handle| Handle::parse(handle).unwrap()).collect(),
               member_key: joiner.member_key,
               device_key: joiner.device_keys[0],
               addresses: addresses(&[&format!("{}.example:4433", joiner.handle.as_str())]),
           }
       }

       /// Ada's store at epoch 3 listing `members`, with Carol's request
       /// (invite `0x11`) and Dave's (invite `0x12`) kept and outstanding.
       pub fn admin_store(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> StoreData {
           let mut data = ada_store(3, members);
           data.kept_admission_requests = vec![request(0x11, &carol(), &["carol"]), request(0x12, &dave(), &["carol", "dave"])];
           data.outstanding_invites = vec![
               OutstandingInvite { org_id: org(), invite_id: invite(0x11), invitee_name: "Carol".to_string() },
               OutstandingInvite { org_id: org(), invite_id: invite(0x12), invitee_name: "Dave".to_string() },
           ];
           data
       }

       /// Ada's store with Carol's admission recorded and proposed; the
       /// chain state that holds the proposal.
       pub fn own_proposal(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> (OrgService, OrgState) {
           let mut svc = service(ADA, admin_store(members));
           let _admitted = svc.record_admission(&mut OsRng, &device_key(ADA), invite(0x11), None).unwrap();
           let _proposed = svc.propose_updated_organisation(&mut OsRng, &device_key(ADA)).unwrap();
           let held = &data(&svc, ADA).provisional_organisations[0];
           let state = chain(held.epoch.get(), held.root, held.org_pub_key);
           (svc, state)
       }

       /// `svc`'s one store, given the `origin` its first provisional
       /// organisation was not kept with: a store org-io would unseal.
       pub fn with_origin(svc: &OrgService, device: u8, origin: Origin) -> OrgService {
           let mut moved = data(svc, device).clone();
           moved.provisional_organisations[0].origin = origin;
           service(device, moved)
       }

       /// A notice of a Member's absence, for a kept notice the store holds.
       pub fn absence_notice(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> RevocationNotice {
           let member_id = MemberId::new([0x09; 32]);
           let device = device_key(0x99);
           let proof = trie_of(members).prove_absent(&member_id, &device).unwrap();
           RevocationNotice { org_id: org(), member_id, device, proof }
       }
   ```

   ```rust
   // ---- T17: adopting a matched provisional organisation -------------------------

   // Of two received provisional organisations for epoch 4, the one whose
   // epoch, root and key the chain holds is adopted; the other is dropped.
   // verifies: LLR-8528ud
   #[test]
   fn the_match_is_the_one_provisional_organisation_with_the_chains_epoch_root_and_key() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let base = [fx::ada(), fx::bob()];
       let mut svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &base));
       let (carol_body, carol_root, carol_key) = fx::information(3, &base, &fx::carol(), [0x4c; 32]);
       let (dave_body, _dave_root, _dave_key) = fx::information(3, &base, &fx::dave(), [0x4d; 32]);
       fx::receive(&mut svc, fx::ADA, fx::BOB, &carol_body);
       fx::receive(&mut svc, fx::ADA, fx::BOB, &dave_body);
       let (verified, change) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(4, carol_root, carol_key)), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(verified, Verified::Adopted { epoch: Epoch::new(4), discarded: Vec::new(), own: false });
       assert!(change.is_some());
       let record = fx::data(&svc, fx::ADA).record.as_ref().unwrap();
       assert_eq!((record.epoch, record.root_hash, record.org_pub_key), (Epoch::new(4), carol_root, carol_key));
       assert!(fx::data(&svc, fx::ADA).provisional_organisations.is_empty(), "the other, for the same epoch, is dropped");
   }

   // An own, a received and an answer provisional organisation are matched
   // alike; only the own one reports `own`.
   // verifies: LLR-8528ud
   #[test]
   fn own_received_and_answer_provisional_organisations_match_alike() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let base = [fx::ada(), fx::bob()];
       let (mut own, own_state) = fx::own_proposal(&base);
       let (verified, _sealed) = fx::verify(&mut own, fx::ADA, Some(own_state), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(verified, Verified::Adopted { epoch: Epoch::new(4), discarded: Vec::new(), own: true });

       let mut received = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::ada_store(3, &base));
       let (body, root, key) = fx::information(3, &base, &fx::carol(), [0x4c; 32]);
       fx::receive(&mut received, fx::ADA, fx::BOB, &body);
       let mut answer = fx::with_origin(&received, fx::ADA, Origin::Answer { from: device_key(fx::BOB) });
       for svc in [&mut received, &mut answer] {
           let (verified, sealed) = fx::verify(svc, fx::ADA, Some(fx::chain(4, root, key)), &asked).unwrap();
           assert_eq!(verified, Verified::Adopted { epoch: Epoch::new(4), discarded: Vec::new(), own: false });
           assert!(sealed.is_some());
       }
   }

   // Adoption replaces the record's members, root, key pair and epoch with
   // the match's, clears the marker, and returns one sealed change holding
   // all of it.
   // verifies: LLR-34c5y3
   #[test]
   fn adoption_replaces_the_record_and_reports_own_in_one_sealed_change() {
       let asked = Cell::new(false);
       let (mut svc, state) = fx::own_proposal(&[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]);
       let members = fx::data(&svc, fx::ADA).provisional_organisations[0].members.clone();
       let (verified, change) = fx::verify(&mut svc, fx::ADA, Some(state), &asked).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(verified, Verified::Adopted { epoch: Epoch::new(4), discarded: Vec::new(), own: true });
       let Some(org_node::service::StoreChange::Sealed(write)) = change else { panic!("one sealed change") };
       let reopened = PersonaStore::unseal(&write.sealed, device_key(fx::ADA), device_secret([fx::ADA; 32])).unwrap();
       let record = reopened.data().record.as_ref().unwrap();
       assert_eq!((record.epoch, record.last_seq.get()), (Epoch::new(4), 4));
       assert_eq!((record.root_hash, record.org_pub_key), (state.root_hash, state.org_pub_key));
       assert_eq!(record.trie_members, members);
       assert_eq!(
           record.org_private_key_for_test().x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap(),
           state.org_pub_key,
           "the record holds the private half of the adopted key"
       );
       assert_eq!(fx::data(&svc, fx::ADA).behind, None);
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   /// A provisional change the adopted record did not include, reported by
   /// the adoption that discarded it (LLR-d9x6xf).
   #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub enum DiscardedChange {
       Admit { invite_id: InviteId, handle: Handle },
       Revoke { member_id: MemberId },
   }

   /// What `OrgService::verify` decided: exactly one outcome (LLR-rr558z).
   #[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub enum Verified {
       InStep,
       Behind { chain_epoch: Epoch },
       Inconsistent { reason: Inconsistency },
       /// A held provisional organisation was adopted (LLR-34c5y3).
       Adopted { epoch: Epoch, discarded: Vec<DiscardedChange>, own: bool },
   }

   /// What `judge` found: an outcome that adopts nothing, or the index of
   /// the provisional organisation to adopt.
   pub(crate) enum Judgement {
       Done(Verified),
       Adopt(usize),
   }

   /// The outcome of `chain` against `store` (LLR-rr558z, LLR-8528ud): with
   /// a record, a lower epoch or the same epoch with another root is
   /// inconsistent and the same epoch and root in step; a greater epoch is
   /// the one held provisional organisation whose epoch, root and key are
   /// the chain's, else behind. A store with no record is behind (its first
   /// adoptions come with T19).
   pub(crate) fn judge(store: &StoreData, chain: &OrgState) -> Judgement {
       let Some(record) = &store.record else {
           return Judgement::Done(Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: chain.epoch });
       };
       if chain.epoch < record.epoch {
           return Judgement::Done(Verified::Inconsistent {
               reason: Inconsistency::ChainBehindRecord { chain_epoch: chain.epoch, record_epoch: record.epoch },
           });
       }
       if chain.epoch == record.epoch {
           return Judgement::Done(if chain.root_hash == record.root_hash {
               Verified::InStep
           } else {
               Verified::Inconsistent { reason: Inconsistency::OtherRoot { epoch: chain.epoch } }
           });
       }
       match matching(store, chain) {
           Some(index) => Judgement::Adopt(index),
           None => Judgement::Done(Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: chain.epoch }),
       }
   }

   /// The one held provisional organisation whose epoch, root and
   /// Organisation public key are the chain's (LLR-8528ud): own, received
   /// or answer alike; identity (root, key) makes at most one.
   pub(crate) fn matching(store: &StoreData, chain: &OrgState) -> Option<usize> {
       store.provisional_organisations.iter().position(|held| {
           held.epoch == chain.epoch && held.root == chain.root_hash && held.org_pub_key == chain.org_pub_key
       })
   }

   /// Whether `record` lists a member with `request`'s Member-as-a-group key
   /// and DevicePublicKey (LLR-d9x6xf, LLR-rzqs2u).
   pub(crate) fn lists(record: &OrgRecord, request: &KeptAdmissionRequest) -> bool {
       record
           .trie_members
           .iter()
           .any(|member| member.member_key == request.member_key && member.device_keys.contains(&request.device_key))
   }

   /// The store after adopting the provisional organisation at `index` over
   /// `previous`, and the outcome (LLR-34c5y3): the match's members, root,
   /// key pair, epoch and Sequence number, Change set and base snapshot
   /// replace the record's; the proxy account is kept; every provisional
   /// change is removed, those left out reported (LLR-d9x6xf); provisional
   /// organisations up to the epoch and every kept notice are dropped
   /// (LLR-x8drb8); the marker is cleared.
   pub(crate) fn adopt(store: &StoreData, previous: &OrgRecord, index: usize) -> (StoreData, Verified) {
       let mut next = store.clone();
       let matched = next.provisional_organisations.remove(index);
       let own = matches!(matched.origin, Origin::Own);
       let epoch = matched.epoch;
       let record = OrgRecord {
           org_id: previous.org_id,
           root_hash: matched.root,
           org_pub_key: matched.org_pub_key,
           epoch,
           last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch.get()),
           trie_members: matched.members,
           proxy_account: previous.proxy_account,
           org_private_key: matched.org_private_key,
           kept_change_set: matched.change_set,
           kept_base_snapshot: matched.base_snapshot,
       };
       let discarded = discarded_changes(store, &record);
       next.provisional_changes.clear();
       next.provisional_organisations.retain(|held| held.epoch > epoch);
       next.kept_revocation_notices.clear();
       next.behind = None;
       next.record = Some(record);
       (next, Verified::Adopted { epoch, discarded, own })
   }

   /// The provisional changes `adopted` does not include, in recorded order
   /// (LLR-d9x6xf): an `Admit` whose kept request's keys it does not list,
   /// a `Revoke` whose MemberId it still holds.
   fn discarded_changes(store: &StoreData, adopted: &OrgRecord) -> Vec<DiscardedChange> {
       store
           .provisional_changes
           .iter()
           .filter_map(|change| match change {
               ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id, handle } => {
                   let included = store
                       .kept_admission_requests
                       .iter()
                       .find(|request| request.invite_id == *invite_id)
                       .is_some_and(|request| lists(adopted, request));
                   (!included).then(|| DiscardedChange::Admit { invite_id: *invite_id, handle: handle.clone() })
               }
               ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id } => {
                   let included = !adopted.trie_members.iter().any(|member| member.id == *member_id);
                   (!included).then_some(DiscardedChange::Revoke { member_id: *member_id })
               }
           })
           .collect()
   }
   ```

   ```rust
       pub fn verify<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
           &mut self,
           rng: &mut R,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           chain: Option<OrgState>,
           _verified_at: VerificationTime,
           _device_secrets: impl FnOnce(&[DevicePublicKey]) -> Vec<DeviceSecret>,
       ) -> Result<(Verified, Option<StoreChange>), OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let data = self.stores[index].data();
           if data.founding.as_ref().is_some_and(|founding| founding.proxy.is_none()) {
               return Err(OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten);
           }
           let chain = chain.ok_or(OrgNodeError::OrgNotOnChain)?;
           let (next, verified) = match crate::verify_org::judge(data, &chain) {
               Judgement::Done(verified) => {
                   mark(self.stores[index].data_mut(), &verified);
                   return Ok((verified, None));
               }
               Judgement::Adopt(matched) => crate::verify_org::adopt(data, current_record(data)?, matched),
           };
           // Sealed before the outcome is returned (LLR-34c5y3).
           let write = self.stores[index].seal_data(&next, rng)?;
           *self.stores[index].data_mut() = next;
           Ok((verified, Some(StoreChange::Sealed(write))))
       }
   ```

   ```rust
   // addresses, else none; an unknown store is refused.
   // verifies: LLR-pgy2rb
   #[test]
   fn addresses_for_prefers_the_address_book_then_a_kept_request_then_the_invite() {
       let carol = device_key(fx::CAROL);
       let from_book = fx::addresses(&["book.example:1"]);
       let mut booked = fx::admin_store(&[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]);
       booked.address_book.push((carol, from_book.clone()));
       let svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, booked);
       assert_eq!(svc.addresses_for(&device_key(fx::ADA), carol).unwrap(), Some(&from_book));

       let svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, fx::admin_store(&[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]));
       let requested = fx::request(0x11, &fx::carol(), &["carol"]).addresses;
       assert_eq!(svc.addresses_for(&device_key(fx::ADA), carol).unwrap(), Some(&requested));
       assert_eq!(svc.addresses_for(&device_key(fx::ADA), device_key(0x99)).unwrap(), None);

       let mut joiner = OrgService::new(Vec::new()).unwrap();
       let (key, _secret, _sealed) = joiner.propose_member(&mut OsRng, &fx::invite_to_carol(), "Carol", "Coder", &["carol"]).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(
           joiner.addresses_for(&key, device_key(fx::ADA)).unwrap(),
           Some(&fx::addresses(&["ada.example:4433"]))
       );
       assert_eq!(joiner.addresses_for(&key, device_key(fx::BOB)).unwrap(), None);
       assert_eq!(joiner.addresses_for(&device_key(0x99), device_key(fx::ADA)).unwrap_err(), OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld);
   }

   // org-node holds endpoint addresses only as opaque text and dials,
   // resolves and builds none (LLR-ds228z, the successor of LLR-qezw3n): no
   // source file of `org-node/src` names a transport address type, a peer
   // address or a dial or resolve function, and `addresses_for` hands back
   // exactly the strings a kept request carried, however little they look like
   // an address.
   // verifies: LLR-ds228z
   #[test]
   fn org_node_keeps_endpoint_addresses_as_opaque_text_and_dials_none() {
       fn rust_files(dir: &std::path::Path, found: &mut Vec<(std::path::PathBuf, String)>) {
           for entry in std::fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap() {
               let path = entry.unwrap().path();
               if path.is_dir() {
                   rust_files(&path, found);
               } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "rs") {
                   let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
                   found.push((path, text));
               }
           }
       }
       let whole_word = |text: &str, word: &str| {
           text.match_indices(word).any(|(offset, _)| {
               let before = text[..offset].chars().next_back();
               let after = text[offset + word.len()..].chars().next();
               let ident = |c: Option<char>| c.is_some_and(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_');
               !ident(before) && !ident(after)
           })
       };
       let mut sources = Vec::new();
       rust_files(&std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("src"), &mut sources);
       assert!(sources.iter().any(|(path, _)| path.ends_with("service.rs")), "the scan reads org-node/src");
       for (path, text) in &sources {
           for word in ["SocketAddr", "SocketAddrV4", "SocketAddrV6", "IpAddr", "EndpointAddr", "NodeAddr", "PeerAddr", "peer_addr", "node_addr_for_dial", "ToSocketAddrs"] {
               assert!(!whole_word(text, word), "{} names `{word}`: org-node holds no transport address", path.display());
           }
           for call in ["fn dial", "fn resolve", ".dial(", ".resolve(", "lookup_host", "TcpStream", "UdpSocket", "iroh::"] {
               assert!(!text.contains(call), "{} contains `{call}`: org-node dials and resolves nothing", path.display());
           }
       }

       let carol = device_key(fx::CAROL);
       let opaque = vec!["not an address at all".to_string(), "relay://whatever?x=1".to_string(), String::new()];
       let mut data = fx::admin_store(&[fx::ada(), fx::bob()]);
       let request = data.kept_admission_requests.iter_mut().find(|request| request.device_key == carol).unwrap();
       request.addresses = org_node::invitation::EndpointAddresses::parse(opaque.clone()).unwrap();
       let svc = fx::service(fx::ADA, data);
       let kept = svc.addresses_for(&device_key(fx::ADA), carol).unwrap().expect("the kept request's addresses");
       assert_eq!(kept.as_slice(), opaque.as_slice(), "the strings as given, unparsed and unchanged");
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   pub(crate) fn adopt(store: &StoreData, previous: &OrgRecord, index: usize) -> (StoreData, Verified) {
       let mut next = store.clone();
       let matched = next.provisional_organisations.remove(index);
       let own = matches!(matched.origin, Origin::Own);
       let epoch = matched.epoch;
       let record = OrgRecord {
           org_id: previous.org_id,
           root_hash: matched.root,
           org_pub_key: matched.org_pub_key,
           epoch,
           last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch.get()),
           trie_members: matched.members,
           proxy_account: previous.proxy_account,
           org_private_key: matched.org_private_key,
           kept_change_set: matched.change_set,
           kept_base_snapshot: matched.base_snapshot,
       };
       let discarded = discarded_changes(store, &record);
       next.provisional_changes.clear();
       next.provisional_organisations.retain(|held| held.epoch > epoch);
       next.kept_revocation_notices.clear();
       settle_admitted(&mut next, &record);
       hold_dropped_devices(&mut next, previous, &record);
       next.behind = None;
       next.record = Some(record);
       (next, Verified::Adopted { epoch, discarded, own })
   }

   /// Each kept request whose keys `adopted` lists is removed with its
   /// outstanding pair, and its addresses become its Device's address-book
   /// entry, replacing any (LLR-rzqs2u, LLR-h9d65p).
   fn settle_admitted(next: &mut StoreData, adopted: &OrgRecord) {
       let (settled, kept): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) =
           std::mem::take(&mut next.kept_admission_requests).into_iter().partition(|request| lists(adopted, request));
       next.kept_admission_requests = kept;
       for request in settled {
           next.outstanding_invites
               .retain(|invite| !(invite.org_id == request.org_id && invite.invite_id == request.invite_id));
           next.address_book.retain(|(device, _)| *device != request.device_key);
           next.address_book.push((request.device_key, request.addresses));
       }
   }

   /// Each Device `previous` lists and `adopted` does not, in snapshot and
   /// slot order, held as revoked once (LLR-bgj2ff).
   fn hold_dropped_devices(next: &mut StoreData, previous: &OrgRecord, adopted: &OrgRecord) {
       for member in &previous.trie_members {
           for device in &member.device_keys {
               let still_listed = adopted.trie_members.iter().any(|listed| listed.device_keys.contains(device));
               let held = next.revoked_devices.iter().any(|revoked| revoked.device_key == *device);
               if !still_listed && !held {
                   next.revoked_devices.push(RevokedDevice { member_id: member.id, device_key: *device });
               }
           }
       }
   }
   ```
   - `org-node/src/service.rs`: add `addresses_for` (`EndpointAddresses` is already imported there, by T8, from `crate::invitation`).
   ```rust
       /// The addresses this store keeps for `peer` (LLR-pgy2rb): its
       /// address-book entry; else a kept request's from it; else, in a
       /// provisional Member's store whose Invite it issued, the Invite's
       /// issuer addresses; else none. Changes nothing.
       pub fn addresses_for(
           &self,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           peer: DevicePublicKey,
       ) -> Result<Option<&EndpointAddresses>, OrgNodeError> {
           let data = self.stores[self.store_index(device_key)?].data();
           if let Some((_, addresses)) = data.address_book.iter().find(|(device, _)| *device == peer) {
               return Ok(Some(addresses));
           }
           if let Some(request) = data.kept_admission_requests.iter().find(|request| request.from == peer) {
               return Ok(Some(&request.addresses));
           }
           Ok(data.member.as_ref().filter(|member| member.issuer == peer).map(|member| &member.issuer_addresses))
       }
   ```

**Intent:** In a provisional Member's store, a match is adopted only when it lists one member with the provisional Member's Member-as-a-group key and DevicePublicKey: the record is created (key = the chain's), `member_id` and `handle` set, the provisional Member and expectation removed. In a founding store, the founding matches at epoch 1 and becomes the record with its proxy as `proxy_account`, reported `Adopted { epoch: 1, discarded: [], own: true }`.

   ```rust
       /// Carol's provisional Member store, made from Ada's Invite.
       pub fn joiner() -> (OrgService, DevicePublicKey) {
           let mut svc = OrgService::new(Vec::new()).unwrap();
           let (key, _secret, _sealed) = svc.propose_member(&mut OsRng, &invite_to_carol(), "Carol", "Coder", &["carol"]).unwrap();

       /// The member snapshot listing the joiner's keys: MemberId `0x33`,
       /// Handle carol.
   ```
