           let member = svc.store_data(&key).unwrap().member.as_ref().unwrap();
           MemberSnapshot {
               id: MemberId::new([0x33; 32]),
               handle: Handle::parse("carol").unwrap(),
               name: member.name.clone(),
               surname: member.surname.clone(),
               member_key: member.member_key,
               device_keys: vec![member.device_key],
           }
       }

       /// Ada's founding store with its proxy recorded, its Device secret,
       /// and the chain state its write leaves at epoch 1.
       pub fn founding() -> (OrgService, DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, OrgState) {
           let mut svc = OrgService::new(Vec::new()).unwrap();
           let (key, secret, _sealed) = svc.propose_founding(&mut OsRng, "Ada", "Lovelace", "ada", "Acme".to_string()).unwrap();
           let _recorded = svc.record_founding_proxy(&mut OsRng, &key, org(), ChainAccount::new([7; 32])).unwrap();
           let held = svc.store_data(&key).unwrap().founding.as_ref().unwrap();
           let state = chain(1, held.root, held.org_pub_key);
           (svc, key, secret, state)
       }

       /// `body` received by the store `key` names from `sender`, which must
       /// keep it; returns its epoch.
       pub fn receive_into(svc: &mut OrgService, key: DevicePublicKey, sender: u8, body: &[u8]) -> Epoch {
           match svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &key, device_key(sender), body).unwrap() {
               (Checked::ProvisionalOrganisationKept { epoch }, Some(_sealed)) => epoch,
               _ => panic!("the Organisation information is not kept"),
           }
       }

       /// `verify` on the store `key` names, recording whether a secret was asked.
       pub fn verify_as(
           svc: &mut OrgService,
           key: DevicePublicKey,
           state: Option<OrgState>,
           asked: &Cell<bool>,
       ) -> Result<(Verified, Option<StoreChange>), OrgNodeError> {
           svc.verify(&mut OsRng, &key, state, VerificationTime(1_760_000_000), |_: &[DevicePublicKey]| -> Vec<DeviceSecret> {
               asked.set(true);
               Vec::new()
           })
       }

       pub fn plaintext_of(svc: &OrgService, key: DevicePublicKey) -> Vec<u8> {
           postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&key).unwrap()).unwrap()
       }

The `Judgement` enum, the complete new `judge`, and the new functions:
   ```rust
   pub(crate) enum Judgement {
       Done(Verified),
       Adopt(usize),
       /// A provisional Member's store adopts the provisional organisation
       /// at this index (LLR-q4puca).
       AdoptFirst(usize),
       /// A founding store adopts its founding (LLR-gcm7bq).
       AdoptFounding,
   }

   pub(crate) fn judge(store: &StoreData, chain: &OrgState) -> Judgement {
       let Some(record) = &store.record else {
           if let Some(founding) = &store.founding {
               return if founding_matches(founding, chain) {
                   Judgement::AdoptFounding
               } else {
                   Judgement::Done(Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: chain.epoch })
               };
           }
           return match matching(store, chain) {
               Some(index) if store.member.is_some() => Judgement::AdoptFirst(index),
               _ => Judgement::Done(Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: chain.epoch }),
           };
       };
       if chain.epoch < record.epoch {
           return Judgement::Done(Verified::Inconsistent {
               reason: Inconsistency::ChainBehindRecord { chain_epoch: chain.epoch, record_epoch: record.epoch },
           });
       }
       if chain.epoch == record.epoch {
           return Judgement::Done(if chain.root_hash == record.root_hash {
               Verified::InStep
           } else {
               Verified::Inconsistent { reason: Inconsistency::OtherRoot { epoch: chain.epoch } }
           });
       }
       match matching(store, chain) {
           Some(index) => Judgement::Adopt(index),
           None => Judgement::Done(Verified::Behind { chain_epoch: chain.epoch }),
       }
   }

   /// The founding matches a chain state at epoch 1 holding its root and
   /// key, its members rebuilding that root (LLR-8528ud, LLR-gcm7bq).
   fn founding_matches(founding: &ProvisionalFounding, chain: &OrgState) -> bool {
       chain.epoch == Epoch::new(1)
           && founding.root == chain.root_hash
           && founding.org_pub_key == chain.org_pub_key
           && rebuilds(&founding.members, founding.root)
   }

   /// Whether `members` rebuild `root`.
   fn rebuilds(members: &[MemberSnapshot], root: RootHash) -> bool {
       members
           .iter()
           .map(|s| MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone()))
           .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
           .and_then(Trie::genesis)
           .and_then(|trie| trie.root_hash())
           .is_ok_and(|rebuilt| rebuilt == root)
   }

   /// A provisional Member's first adoption (LLR-q4puca): only a match
   /// listing one member with the provisional Member's Member-as-a-group key
   /// and DevicePublicKey (else `AdmissionNotOurs`, nothing changed); the
   /// record is created with the chain's Organisation public key and the
   /// match's private key, members, root and kept values; the Persona takes
   /// that member's MemberId and Handle; the provisional Member and the
   /// expectation go; earlier provisional organisations and kept notices
   /// go as on every adoption (LLR-x8drb8).
   pub(crate) fn adopt_first(store: &StoreData, index: usize, chain: &OrgState) -> Result<(StoreData, Verified), OrgNodeError> {
       let member = store.member.as_ref().ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalMember)?;
       let org_id = member.org_id;
       let ours = store.provisional_organisations[index]
           .members
           .iter()
           .find(|listed| listed.member_key == member.member_key && listed.device_keys.contains(&member.device_key))
           .ok_or(OrgNodeError::AdmissionNotOurs { org_id })?;
       let (member_id, handle) = (ours.id, ours.handle.clone());
       let mut next = store.clone();
       let matched = next.provisional_organisations.remove(index);
       let own = matches!(matched.origin, Origin::Own);
       let epoch = matched.epoch;
       next.record = Some(OrgRecord {
           org_id,
           root_hash: matched.root,
           org_pub_key: chain.org_pub_key,
           epoch,
           last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch.get()),
           trie_members: matched.members,
           proxy_account: None,
           org_private_key: matched.org_private_key,
           kept_change_set: matched.change_set,
           kept_base_snapshot: matched.base_snapshot,
       });
       next.persona.member_id = Some(member_id);
       next.persona.handle = Some(handle);
       next.member = None;
       next.expected_admissions.retain(|expected| expected.org_id != org_id);
       next.provisional_organisations.retain(|held| held.epoch > epoch);
       next.kept_revocation_notices.clear();
       next.behind = None;
       Ok((next, Verified::Adopted { epoch, discarded: Vec::new(), own }))
   }

   /// A founding store's adoption (LLR-gcm7bq): the record is created at
   /// epoch and Sequence number 1 from the founding's members, root and key
   /// pair, with its proxy as `proxy_account` and no kept Change set or base
   /// snapshot; the Persona takes the founder's MemberId; the founding goes.
   pub(crate) fn adopt_founding(store: &StoreData) -> Result<(StoreData, Verified), OrgNodeError> {
       let mut next = store.clone();
       let founding = next.founding.take().ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalFounding)?;
       let org_id = next.persona.org_id.ok_or(OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten)?;
       let founder = founding
           .members
           .iter()
           .find(|member| member.device_keys.contains(&next.persona.device_key))
           .map(|member| member.id)
           .ok_or(OrgNodeError::AdmissionNotOurs { org_id })?;
       next.record = Some(OrgRecord {
           org_id,
           root_hash: founding.root,
           org_pub_key: founding.org_pub_key,
           epoch: Epoch::new(1),
           last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(1),
           trie_members: founding.members,
           proxy_account: founding.proxy,
           org_private_key: founding.org_private_key,
           kept_change_set: None,
           kept_base_snapshot: None,
       });
       next.persona.member_id = Some(founder);
       next.behind = None;
       Ok((next, Verified::Adopted { epoch: Epoch::new(1), discarded: Vec::new(), own: true }))
   }
   ```
   - `org-node/src/service.rs`: in `verify`, the match on `judge` gains two arms. This is the complete new match; the rest of `verify` is as T17 left it.

   #![cfg(all(feature = "app", feature = "test-support"))]
   #![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]
   //! The messages of the adopted current epoch (SDD-qzv5mn; plan
   //! docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md, T20): built from the
   //! record's kept Change set and base snapshot, after adoption, changing
   //! nothing, so a send that fails or never happens is repeated with the
   //! same bodies.

   use org_members::hasher::Blake3Hasher;
   use org_node::envelope::Envelope;
   use org_node::error::OrgNodeError;
   use org_node::service::OutgoingMessage;
   use org_node::store::{MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord};
   use org_node::wire::{decode_message, WireMessage};
   use org_node::{DevicePublicKey, SequenceNumber};

   /// Ada's store, its admission and revocation proposed and adopted.
   mod ob {
       use org_members::hasher::Blake3Hasher;
       use org_members::trie::OrgTrie;
       use org_members::MemberLeaf;
       use org_node::chain::OrgState;
       use org_node::ids::OrgId;
       use org_node::invitation::{Invite, InviteId};
       use org_node::service::OrgService;
       use org_node::invitation::EndpointAddresses;
       use org_node::store::{
           KeptAdmissionRequest, MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord, OrgRecordParts, OutstandingInvite,
           PersonaRecord, PersonaRecordParts, PersonaStatus, StoreData,
       };
       use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, device_secret, empty_store, member_key, store_for_test};
       use org_node::{
           DevicePublicKey, DeviceSecret, Epoch, Handle, MemberId, MemberSeed, Name, OrgPrivateKey, PersonaId,
           SequenceNumber, Surname, VerificationTime, Verified,
       };
       use rand::rngs::OsRng;

       type Trie = OrgTrie<Blake3Hasher>;

       pub const ADA: u8 = 0xa1;

       pub fn org() -> OrgId {
           OrgId::new([0x0e; 20])
       }

       fn snapshot(id: u8, handle: &str, member: u8, devices: &[u8]) -> MemberSnapshot {
           MemberSnapshot {
               id: MemberId::new([id; 32]),
               handle: Handle::parse(handle).unwrap(),
               name: Name::parse("Test").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("Member").unwrap(),
               member_key: member_key(member),
               device_keys: devices.iter().map(|seed| device_key(*seed)).collect(),
           }
       }

       fn ada() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x01, "ada", 0x61, &[ADA])
       }

       /// Eve, listed with two Devices.
       pub fn eve() -> MemberSnapshot {
           snapshot(0x05, "eve", 0x65, &[0xe1, 0xe2])
       }

       pub fn invite_id() -> InviteId {
           InviteId::new([0x11; 32])
       }

       fn record(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> OrgRecord {
           let leaves = members
               .iter()
               .map(|s| {
                   MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone())
                       .unwrap()
               })
               .collect();
           let trie = Trie::genesis(leaves).unwrap();
           let key = OrgPrivateKey::from([0x3d; 32]);
           OrgRecord::from(OrgRecordParts {
               org_id: org(),
               root_hash: trie.root_hash().unwrap(),
               org_pub_key: key.x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap(),
               epoch: Epoch::new(3),
               last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(3),
               trie_members: members.to_vec(),
               proxy_account: None,
               org_private_key: key,
               kept_change_set: None,
               kept_base_snapshot: None,
           })
       }

       /// Ada's store: the record at epoch 3 listing Ada, Bob and Eve;
       /// Carol's request kept with its outstanding invite.
       pub fn admin_store() -> StoreData {

           let persona = PersonaRecord::from(PersonaRecordParts {
               persona_id: PersonaId::new("ada".to_string()),
               org_id: Some(org()),
               name: ada.name.clone(),
               surname: ada.surname.clone(),
               handle: Some(ada.handle.clone()),
               member_seed: MemberSeed::from([0x61; 32]),
               device_key: device_key(ADA),
               member_id: Some(ada.id),

           data.record = Some(record(&[ada, snapshot(0x02, "bob", 0x62, &[0xb1]), eve()]));
           data.kept_admission_requests = vec![KeptAdmissionRequest {
               org_id: org(),
               invite_id: invite_id(),
               from: device_key(0xc1),
               name: Name::parse("Carol").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("Coder").unwrap(),
               preferred_handles: vec![Handle::parse("carol").unwrap()],

       pub fn service(data: StoreData) -> OrgService {
           OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&device_secret([ADA; 32]), data)]).unwrap()
       }

       pub fn me() -> DevicePublicKey {

       /// Ada's store after recording Carol's admission (`admit`) and Eve's

       pub fn adopted(admit: bool, revoke: bool) -> OrgService {
           let mut svc = service(admin_store());
           if admit {
               let _admitted = svc.record_admission(&mut OsRng, &me(), invite_id(), None).unwrap();
           }
           if revoke {
               let _revoked = svc.record_revocation(&mut OsRng, &me(), eve().id).unwrap();
           }
           let _proposed = svc.propose_updated_organisation(&mut OsRng, &me()).unwrap();
           let held = &data(&svc).provisional_organisations[0];
           let state = OrgState { root_hash: held.root, org_pub_key: held.org_pub_key, epoch: held.epoch };
           let (verified, _sealed) = svc
               .verify(&mut OsRng, &me(), Some(state), VerificationTime(1), |_: &[DevicePublicKey]| Vec::<DeviceSecret>::new())
               .unwrap();
           assert!(matches!(verified, Verified::Adopted { .. }), "fixture: adopted");

       }

       /// Carol's provisional Member store, which holds no record.
       pub fn joiner() -> (OrgService, DevicePublicKey) {

               org_name: "Acme".to_string(),
               org_id: org(),
               invitee_name: "Carol".to_string(),
               issuer: me(),
               issuer_addresses: EndpointAddresses::parse(Vec::new()).unwrap(),
               invite_id: invite_id(),
           };
           let mut svc = OrgService::new(Vec::new()).unwrap();
           let (key, _secret, _sealed) = svc.propose_member(&mut OsRng, &invite, "Carol", "Coder", &["carol"]).unwrap();
           (svc, key)
       }
   }

   /// Every Device `record` lists, in record order (member, then slot).
   fn devices_of(record: &OrgRecord) -> Vec<DevicePublicKey> {
       record.trie_members.iter().flat_map(|member| member.device_keys.iter().copied()).collect()
   }

   fn recipients(messages: &[OutgoingMessage]) -> Vec<DevicePublicKey> {
       messages.iter().map(|message| message.recipient).collect()
   }

   /// The adopted record and the members of the record it extends.
   fn record_and_base(svc: &org_node::service::OrgService) -> (OrgRecord, Vec<MemberSnapshot>) {
       let record = ob::data(svc).record.clone().unwrap();
       let base: Vec<MemberSnapshot> = postcard::from_bytes(record.kept_base_snapshot.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
       (record, base)
   }

   /// The Organisation information every listed Device but Ada's receives:
   /// the adopted epoch's Envelope, the base snapshot and the record's key.
   fn assert_information(body: &[u8], record: &OrgRecord) {
       let WireMessage::OrgInformation { envelope, record_snapshot, org_private_key } = decode_message(body).unwrap() else {
           panic!("Organisation information")
       };
       assert_eq!(
           envelope,
           Envelope {
               org_id: record.org_id,
               parent_seq: SequenceNumber::new(record.epoch.get()),
               delta_bytes: record.kept_change_set.clone().unwrap()
           }
       );
       assert_eq!(Some(record_snapshot), record.kept_base_snapshot.clone());
       assert_eq!(&org_private_key, record.org_private_key_for_test());
   }

   /// A revocation notice for `recipient`, proving its absence from `record`.
   fn assert_notice(body: &[u8], recipient: DevicePublicKey, record: &OrgRecord) {
       let WireMessage::Revocation(notice) = decode_message(body).unwrap() else { panic!("a revocation notice") };
       assert_eq!(notice.device, recipient);
       assert_eq!(notice.org_id, record.org_id);
       notice.proof.verify::<Blake3Hasher>(&record.root_hash, &notice.member_id, &notice.device).unwrap();
   }

   fn messages_for_the_current_epoch_inform_every_listed_device_but_the_own_then_notify_every_removed_one() {
       let svc = ob::adopted(true, true);
       let (record, base) = record_and_base(&svc);
       let messages = svc.messages_for_current_epoch(&ob::me()).unwrap();
       let listed: Vec<_> = devices_of(&record).into_iter().filter(|device| *device != ob::me()).collect();
       let removed: Vec<_> = base
           .iter()
           .flat_map(|member| member.device_keys.iter().copied())
           .filter(|device| !devices_of(&record).contains(device))
           .collect();
       assert_eq!(removed, ob::eve().device_keys, "fixture: Eve's two Devices are removed");
       assert_eq!(recipients(&messages), [listed.clone(), removed].concat());
       for message in &messages[..listed.len()] {
           assert_information(&message.body, &record);
       }
       for message in &messages[listed.len()..] {
           assert_notice(&message.body, message.recipient, &record);

   /// Every rendering of an 8-byte window of `bytes` a `Debug` could print:
   /// the decimal list and lower-case hex.
   fn renderings(bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<String> {
       bytes
           .windows(8)
           .flat_map(|window| {
               let decimal = format!("{window:?}");
               let hex: String = window.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect();
               [decimal.trim_matches(|c| c == '[' || c == ']').to_string(), hex]
           })
           .collect()
   }

   // Rewritten from `outgoing_debug_shows_no_body_byte`: the messages'
   // `Debug` shows each body's length and no window of a body, nor of the
   // record's private key.
   // verifies: LLR-rsjs8e
   #[test]
   fn outgoing_message_debug_shows_no_body_byte() {
       let svc = ob::adopted(true, true);
       let (record, _base) = record_and_base(&svc);
       let messages = svc.messages_for_current_epoch(&ob::me()).unwrap();
       let rendered = format!("{messages:?}");
       for message in &messages {
           assert!(rendered.contains(&format!("body_len: {}", message.body.len())));
           for window in renderings(&message.body) {
               assert!(!rendered.contains(&window), "a body window {window} in {rendered}");
           }
       }
       for window in renderings(record.org_private_key_for_test().expose_secret()) {
           assert!(!rendered.contains(&window), "the key's bytes {window} in {rendered}");
       }
   }

   /// A trait probe for `Clone`, resolved at compile time.
   struct CloneProbe<T: ?Sized>(std::marker::PhantomData<T>);

   trait NotCloneFallback {
       const IS_CLONE: bool = false;
   }

   impl<T: ?Sized> NotCloneFallback for CloneProbe<T> {}

   impl<T: Clone> CloneProbe<T> {
       const IS_CLONE: bool = true;
   }

   #[test]
   #[allow(
       clippy::assertions_on_constants,
       reason = "the probe's answers are compile-time constants by design; asserting them at run time is the test"
   )]
   fn outgoing_message_is_not_clone() {
       assert!(CloneProbe::<Vec<u8>>::IS_CLONE, "the probe sees a Clone type");
       assert!(!CloneProbe::<OutgoingMessage>::IS_CLONE, "OutgoingMessage is not Clone");
   }

   // Rewritten from `building_the_bodies_writes_and_sends_nothing`: the call

       let pairs = |messages: &[OutgoingMessage]| -> Vec<(DevicePublicKey, Vec<u8>)> {

       };
       assert_eq!(pairs(&first), pairs(&second));
       assert_eq!(postcard::to_allocvec(ob::data(&svc)).unwrap(), before);
   }

Imports needed: `crate::envelope::Envelope`, `crate::store::RawMemberSnapshot` and `crate::wire::{encode_message, WireMessage}`, all used today.
   ```rust
       /// The messages of the epoch the store holds as current (LLR-degg8t):
       /// refused for a store with no record (`OrgNotHeld`); none when the
       /// record keeps no Change set; otherwise one Organisation-information
       /// body (the kept Change set under the record's epoch, the kept base
       /// snapshot, the record's private key) for each Device the record
       /// lists other than this Persona's, in record order, then one
       /// revocation notice for each Device the base lists and the record
       /// does not. Changes nothing; equal stores give equal results.
       pub fn messages_for_current_epoch(&self, device_key: &DevicePublicKey) -> Result<Vec<OutgoingMessage>, OrgNodeError> {
           let data = self.stores[self.store_index(device_key)?].data();
           let record = current_record(data)?;
           let (Some(change_set), Some(base_snapshot)) = (&record.kept_change_set, &record.kept_base_snapshot) else {
               return Ok(Vec::new());
           };
           let information = encode_message(&WireMessage::OrgInformation {
               envelope: Envelope { org_id: record.org_id, parent_seq: record.last_seq, delta_bytes: change_set.clone() },
               record_snapshot: base_snapshot.clone(),
               org_private_key: record.org_private_key.clone(),
           })?;
           let own = data.persona.device_key;
           let mut outgoing: Vec<OutgoingMessage> = record
               .trie_members
               .iter()
               .flat_map(|member| member.device_keys.iter().copied())
               .filter(|device| *device != own)
               .map(|recipient| OutgoingMessage { recipient, body: information.clone() })
               .collect();
           let base = OrgRecord { trie_members: decode_record_snapshot(base_snapshot)?, ..record.clone() };
           let trie = trie_from_snapshots(&record.trie_members)?;
           for notice in crate::revocation::notices_for(&base, record, &trie)? {
               let recipient = notice.device;
               outgoing.push(OutgoingMessage { recipient, body: encode_message(&WireMessage::Revocation(notice))? });
           }
           Ok(outgoing)
       }
   ```
   As a free function:
   ```rust
   /// The members a kept base snapshot encodes, each field parsed by its
   /// type (LLR-7yu2xy's `member.*` refusals).
   fn decode_record_snapshot(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<MemberSnapshot>, OrgNodeError> {
       let raw: Vec<RawMemberSnapshot> = postcard::from_bytes(bytes)
           .map_err(|error| OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field: "org.kept_base_snapshot", reason: error.to_string() })?;
       raw.into_iter().map(MemberSnapshot::try_from).collect()
   }
   ```

### T21 — org-node: the admission request built, and an invite cancelled

**Files touched:** org-node/src/service.rs, org-node/tests/invitation.rs
**Parallel:** yes (with T2–T4; after T20)
**Implements:** LLR-g32hjn, LLR-ag8hjd
**Tests (verifies: annotations):**
- `org-node/tests/invitation.rs::build_admission_request_encodes_the_provisional_member_for_the_issuer_with_the_given_addresses` — `verifies: LLR-g32hjn`
- `org-node/tests/invitation.rs::build_admission_request_refuses_no_provisional_member_and_bad_addresses` — `verifies: LLR-g32hjn, LLR-h4gwns`

- `org-node/tests/invitation.rs::cancel_invite_refuses_an_invite_with_no_kept_request` — `verifies: LLR-ag8hjd`
**Out-of-force tests handled:** none
**Intent:** `build_admission_request(&self, device_key, sender_addresses)` returns the encoded `WireMessage::AdmissionRequest` for `member.issuer` and changes nothing, so a retry sends the same bytes; `cancel_invite(rng, device_key, invite_id)` removes the kept request, its outstanding pair and any `Admit` naming it, refusing `NoAdmissionRequestKept` otherwise.
**Steps:**

1. **Write the failing tests.** In `org-node/tests/invitation.rs`, append the module
   `admission_request_and_cancel` with four tests:
   - `build_admission_request` builds a provisional Member's request through the public API (`propose_member`
     from a hand-built Invite). It decodes the bytes and finds every field of the provisional Member, plus the
     addresses given. It checks the recipient is the Invite's issuer, that a retry gives the same bytes, and
     that the store is unchanged.
   - Its refusals are tested in their order: an unknown Device, a store with no provisional Member, and
     addresses that `EndpointAddresses::parse` refuses.
   - `cancel_invite` runs on a hand-built Admin store. It removes exactly the request, its outstanding pair
     and its `Admit`, keeps the other invite's three, and a later request for the cancelled invite is
     refused as not outstanding.
   - `cancel_invite` with no kept request is refused, and nothing changes.
   ```rust
   mod admission_request_and_cancel {
       use org_members::{DevicePublicKey, Handle, MemberId, MemberLeaf, Name, PersonPublicKey, Surname};
       use org_node::error::OrgNodeError;
       use org_node::ids::OrgId;
       use org_node::invitation::{EndpointAddresses, Invite, InviteId};
       use org_node::service::{OrgService, StoreChange};
       use org_node::store::{
           KeptAdmissionRequest, MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord, OrgRecordParts, OutstandingInvite, PersonaStatus,
           ProvisionalChange, StoreData,
       };
       use org_node::test_fixtures::{
           device_key, device_secret, empty_store, member_key, persona_record, store_for_test, Trie,
       };
       use org_node::wire::{decode_message, encode_message, WireMessage};
       use org_node::{Epoch, OrgPrivateKey, SequenceNumber};
       use rand::rngs::OsRng;

       const OWN: u8 = 4;

       fn org() -> OrgId {
           OrgId::new([0xaa; 20])
       }
       fn h(text: &str) -> Handle {
           Handle::parse(text).unwrap()
       }
       fn addresses(list: &[&str]) -> Vec<String> {
           list.iter().map(|address| address.to_string()).collect()
       }

       /// An Invite another node issued, from Device 5.
       fn invite() -> Invite {
           Invite {
               org_name: "Acme".into(),
               org_id: org(),
               invitee_name: "Bob Builder".into(),
               issuer: device_key(5),
               issuer_addresses: EndpointAddresses::parse(addresses(&["192.0.2.5:4433"])).unwrap(),
               invite_id: InviteId::new([3; 32]),
           }
       }

       fn encoded(svc: &OrgService, device: &DevicePublicKey) -> Vec<u8> {
           postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(device).unwrap()).unwrap()
       }

       fn snapshot(id: u8, handle: &str, member: u8, device: u8) -> MemberSnapshot {
           MemberSnapshot {
               id: MemberId::new([id; 32]),
               handle: h(handle),
               name: Name::parse("Test").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("User").unwrap(),
               member_key: member_key(member),
               device_keys: vec![device_key(device)],
           }
       }

       fn record(members: Vec<MemberSnapshot>) -> OrgRecord {
           let leaves = members
               .iter()
               .map(|s| {
                   MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone())
                       .unwrap()
               })
               .collect();
           let key = OrgPrivateKey::from([0x60; 32]);
           OrgRecord::from(OrgRecordParts {
               org_id: org(),
               root_hash: Trie::genesis(leaves).unwrap().root_hash().unwrap(),
               org_pub_key: key.x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap(),
               epoch: Epoch::new(3),
               last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(3),
               trie_members: members,
               proxy_account: None,
               org_private_key: key,
               kept_change_set: None,
               kept_base_snapshot: None,
           })
       }

       fn kept_request(invite_id: InviteId, member: u8, device: u8, handle: &str) -> KeptAdmissionRequest {
           KeptAdmissionRequest {
               org_id: org(),
               invite_id,
               from: device_key(device),
               name: Name::parse("Carol").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("King").unwrap(),
               preferred_handles: vec![h(handle)],
               member_key: member_key(member),
               device_key: device_key(device),
               addresses: EndpointAddresses::parse(addresses(&["192.0.2.9:4433"])).unwrap(),
           }
       }

       /// An Admin's store: a record listing this Device (seed 4) and Bob (0x21); two outstanding invites,
       /// each with a kept request; an Admit for each and a Revoke between them.
       fn admin_with_two_requests() -> (OrgService, InviteId, InviteId) {
           let (first, second) = (InviteId::new([0x31; 32]), InviteId::new([0x32; 32]));
           let mut persona = persona_record("p-alice", 1, OWN);
           persona.org_id = Some(org());
           persona.member_id = Some(MemberId::new([1; 32]));
           persona.status = PersonaStatus::Active;
           let mut data: StoreData = empty_store(persona);
           data.record = Some(record(vec![snapshot(1, "alice", 1, OWN), snapshot(2, "bob", 0x11, 0x21)]));
           data.org_name = "Acme".into();
           data.outstanding_invites = vec![
               OutstandingInvite { org_id: org(), invite_id: first, invitee_name: "Carol".into() },
               OutstandingInvite { org_id: org(), invite_id: second, invitee_name: "Dave".into() },
           ];
           data.kept_admission_requests = vec![kept_request(first, 0x12, 0x22, "carol"), kept_request(second, 0x13, 0x23, "dave")];
           data.provisional_changes = vec![
               ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: first, handle: h("carol") },
               ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: MemberId::new([2; 32]) },
               ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: second, handle: h("dave") },
           ];
           let svc = OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&device_secret([OWN; 32]), data)]).unwrap();
           (svc, first, second)
       }

       /// The admission request Device `device` would send for `invite_id`.
       fn request_body(invite_id: InviteId, member: u8, device: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
           let member_key: PersonPublicKey = member_key(member);
           encode_message(&WireMessage::AdmissionRequest {
               org_id: org(),
               invite_id,
               name: Name::parse("Carol").unwrap(),
               surname: Surname::parse("King").unwrap(),
               preferred_handles: vec![h("carol")],
               member_key,
               device_key: device_key(device),
               addresses: addresses(&["192.0.2.9:4433"]),
           })
           .unwrap()
       }

       // verifies: LLR-g32hjn
       #[test]
       fn build_admission_request_encodes_the_provisional_member_for_the_issuer_with_the_given_addresses() {
           let mut svc = OrgService::new(vec![]).unwrap();
           let (device, _secret, _created) =
               svc.propose_member(&mut OsRng, &invite(), "Bob", "Builder", &["bob", "bobby"]).unwrap();
           let before = encoded(&svc, &device);
           let given = addresses(&["198.51.100.1:7000", "[2001:db8::1]:7000"]);

           let message = svc.build_admission_request(&device, given.clone()).unwrap();
           assert_eq!(message.recipient, device_key(5), "the request goes to the Invite's issuer");
           let member = svc.store_data(&device).unwrap().member.clone().expect("a provisional Member");
           let WireMessage::AdmissionRequest { org_id, invite_id, name, surname, preferred_handles, member_key, device_key: sent_device, addresses: sent } =
               decode_message(&message.body).unwrap()

               panic!("an admission request")

           assert_eq!((org_id, invite_id), (org(), InviteId::new([3; 32])));
           assert_eq!((name, surname), (member.name.clone(), member.surname.clone()));
           assert_eq!(preferred_handles, vec![h("bob"), h("bobby")]);
           assert_eq!((member_key, sent_device), (member.member_key, member.device_key));
           assert_eq!(sent_device, device, "the request names this Device");
           assert_eq!(sent, given, "the addresses the caller gave, last");

           let again = svc.build_admission_request(&device, given).unwrap();
           assert_eq!(again.body, message.body, "a retry sends the same bytes");
           assert_eq!(encoded(&svc, &device), before, "building changes nothing");

               vec![second]
           );
           assert_eq!(data.outstanding_invites.iter().map(|invite| invite.invite_id).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![second]);
           assert_eq!(
               data.provisional_changes,
               vec![
                   ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: MemberId::new([2; 32]) },
                   ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: second, handle: h("dave") },
               ]
           );
           assert_eq!(postcard::to_allocvec(&data.record).unwrap(), record_before, "the record is untouched");

           // The cancelled invite is no longer outstanding: a later request carrying it is refused.
           assert!(matches!(
               svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own, device_key(0x22), &request_body(first, 0x12, 0x22)),
               Err(OrgNodeError::InviteNotOutstanding)
           ));

       // verifies: LLR-ag8hjd

       fn cancel_invite_refuses_an_invite_with_no_kept_request() {
           let (mut svc, first, _) = admin_with_two_requests();
           let own = device_key(OWN);
           svc.cancel_invite(&mut OsRng, &own, first).unwrap();
           let before = encoded(&svc, &own);
           for invite_id in [first, InviteId::new([0x39; 32])] {

                   svc.cancel_invite(&mut OsRng, &own, invite_id),
                   Err(OrgNodeError::NoAdmissionRequestKept)

               svc.cancel_invite(&mut OsRng, &device_key(0x40), first),
               Err(OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld)
           ));

   `let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = …;` is irrefutable because `StoreChange` has one variant (T5, LLR-ay8nvu).

2. **Run them and see them fail.** `cargo test -p org-node --features app,test-support --test invitation admission_request_and_cancel`.
   Expected: a compile error, `no method named build_admission_request found for struct OrgService` (and the

3. **Write the minimal implementation.** In `org-node/src/service.rs`, add the two methods to `impl OrgService`
   and add `EndpointAddresses` and `ProvisionalChange` to the existing `use` lines. `build_admission_request`
   takes `&self`, so it cannot change anything. It checks the store, then the provisional Member, then the
   addresses, and puts the caller's own list in the body once the parse accepts it. `cancel_invite` refuses
   before it copies anything, then removes the request, its outstanding pair and every `Admit` naming it, in
   one sealed change.
   ```rust
       /// The admission request of this store's provisional Member, for the Invite's issuer, carrying the
       /// sending Device's own addresses last (LLR-g32hjn, LLR-h4gwns). Changes nothing, so a retry with the
       /// same addresses sends the same bytes.
       pub fn build_admission_request(
           &self,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           sender_addresses: Vec<String>,
       ) -> Result<OutgoingMessage, OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let member = self.stores[index].data().member.as_ref().ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalMember)?;
           crate::store::parse_field("request.addresses", EndpointAddresses::parse(sender_addresses.clone()))?;
           let body = encode_message(&WireMessage::AdmissionRequest {
               org_id: member.org_id,
               invite_id: member.invite_id,
               name: member.name.clone(),
               surname: member.surname.clone(),
               preferred_handles: member.preferred_handles.clone(),
               member_key: member.member_key,
               device_key: member.device_key,
               addresses: sender_addresses,
           })?;
           Ok(OutgoingMessage { recipient: member.issuer, body })
       }

       /// Cancel the invite `invite_id`: remove its kept admission request, its outstanding pair and any
       /// `Admit` naming it, so a later request carrying it is refused as not outstanding (LLR-ag8hjd).
       /// An invite id with no kept request is refused with `NoAdmissionRequestKept`, changing nothing.
       pub fn cancel_invite<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
           &mut self,
           rng: &mut R,
           device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
           invite_id: InviteId,
       ) -> Result<StoreChange, OrgNodeError> {
           let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
           let org_id = self.stores[index]
               .data()
               .kept_admission_requests
               .iter()
               .find(|request| request.invite_id == invite_id)
               .map(|request| request.org_id)
               .ok_or(OrgNodeError::NoAdmissionRequestKept)?;
           let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
               data.kept_admission_requests.retain(|request| request.invite_id != invite_id);
               data.outstanding_invites
                   .retain(|outstanding| !(outstanding.org_id == org_id && outstanding.invite_id == invite_id));
               data.provisional_changes.retain(|change| {
                   !matches!(change, ProvisionalChange::Admit { invite_id: named, .. } if *named == invite_id)
               });
               Ok(())
           })?;
           Ok(StoreChange::Sealed(write))
       }
   ```

**Intent:** `build_organisation_request(&self, device_key, sender_addresses)` builds one `OrganisationRequest { org_id, addresses }` per listed Device (or for the Invite's issuer in a provisional Member's store). On receipt, a listed requester gets `Checked::OrganisationRequest { answer }` carrying `WireMessage::Organisation` (record snapshot and private key), a revoked one its `Revocation` notice proved absent from the current trie, and the sender's address-book entry is set; an `Organisation` answer is kept as an `Answer { from }` provisional organisation only while behind and for a later epoch.
*Settled at assembly:* a provisional Member's store keeps an organisation answer for the Organisation its
expected admission names, from whichever Device sent it, only while the behind marker is set, without
LLR-kd7u2r's listed-sender and record-epoch conditions (LLR-e6w3nr amended in 84a31b1a); step 3 adds that path
to T12's no-record gate and the eighth test below verifies it. A founding store with no proxy is refused at
the building with `FoundingNotWritten` (LLR-vyank2 amended in 84a31b1a) and, holding no expected admission,
keeps no answer (`OrgNotHeld`).

**Steps:**

1. **Write the failing tests.** Write `org-node/tests/organisation_request.rs`, which replaces T1's stub. A
   hand-built Admin store at epoch 3 lists this Device (seed 4) and Carol (0x22), and holds Bob (0x21, MemberId
   `[2;32]`) as revoked. Seven tests drive it, and an eighth drives a provisional Member's store:
   - the request, built for every listed Device or for the issuer;
   - a listed requester answered in full;
   - a revoked requester answered with its notice, proved against the record's root;
   - a never-listed requester refused;
   - an answer over the bound refused (a record of 3000 snapshots with 128-byte names, about 1.08 MiB);
   - the answer kept only from a listed Device, while behind and for a later epoch;
   - the address book set, sealing only on change;

   #![cfg(all(feature = "app", feature = "test-support"))]
   #![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]
   //! The organisation request and its answer (SDD-pkqc2j): built for the Devices of the current record or the
   //! Invite's issuer, answered with the record and its key to a listed Device and with its notice to a
   //! revoked one, and an answer kept only while behind (T22 of docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md).

   use org_members::hasher::Blake3Hasher;
   use org_members::{DevicePublicKey, Handle, MemberId, MemberLeaf, Name, Surname};
   use org_node::ids::OrgId;
   use org_node::invitation::{EndpointAddresses, Invite, InviteId};
   use org_node::service::{Checked, OrgService, StoreChange};
   use org_node::store::{MemberSnapshot, OrgRecord, OrgRecordParts, Origin, PersonaStatus, RevokedDevice, StoreData};
   use org_node::test_fixtures::{device_key, device_secret, empty_store, member_key, persona_record, store_for_test, Trie};
   use org_node::wire::{decode_message, encode_message, WireMessage, MAX_MESSAGE};
   use org_node::{Epoch, OrgNodeError, OrgPrivateKey, RootHash, SequenceNumber};
   use rand::rngs::OsRng;

   const OWN: u8 = 4;
   const CAROL: u8 = 0x22;
   const BOB: u8 = 0x21;
   const STRANGER: u8 = 0x2f;

   fn org() -> OrgId {
       OrgId::new([0xaa; 20])
   }
   fn h(text: &str) -> Handle {
       Handle::parse(text).unwrap()
   }
   fn addresses(list: &[&str]) -> Vec<String> {
       list.iter().map(|address| address.to_string()).collect()
   }
   fn parsed(list: &[&str]) -> EndpointAddresses {
       EndpointAddresses::parse(addresses(list)).unwrap()
   }

   fn snapshot(id: u8, handle: &str, member: u8, device: u8) -> MemberSnapshot {
       MemberSnapshot {
           id: MemberId::new([id; 32]),
           handle: h(handle),
           name: Name::parse("Test").unwrap(),
           surname: Surname::parse("User").unwrap(),
           member_key: member_key(member),
           device_keys: vec![device_key(device)],
       }
   }

   fn trie_of(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> Trie {
       let leaves = members
           .iter()
           .map(|s| {
               MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone())
                   .unwrap()
           })
           .collect();
       Trie::genesis(leaves).unwrap()
   }

   fn record_key() -> OrgPrivateKey {
       OrgPrivateKey::from([0x60; 32])
   }

   fn record(members: Vec<MemberSnapshot>, root: RootHash, epoch: u64) -> OrgRecord {
       OrgRecord::from(OrgRecordParts {
           org_id: org(),
           root_hash: root,
           org_pub_key: record_key().x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap(),
           epoch: Epoch::new(epoch),
           last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch),
           trie_members: members,
           proxy_account: None,
           org_private_key: record_key(),
           kept_change_set: None,
           kept_base_snapshot: None,
       })
   }

   fn listed_members() -> Vec<MemberSnapshot> {
       vec![snapshot(1, "alice", 1, OWN), snapshot(3, "carol", 0x12, CAROL)]
   }

   /// The Admin's store: the record at epoch 3 listing this Device and Carol's; Bob's Device held as revoked.
   fn admin_data() -> StoreData {
       let mut persona = persona_record("p-alice", 1, OWN);
       persona.org_id = Some(org());
       persona.member_id = Some(MemberId::new([1; 32]));
       persona.status = PersonaStatus::Active;
       let mut data = empty_store(persona);
       let members = listed_members();
       let root = trie_of(&members).root_hash().unwrap();
       data.record = Some(record(members, root, 3));
       data.org_name = "Acme".into();
       data.revoked_devices = vec![RevokedDevice { member_id: MemberId::new([2; 32]), device_key: device_key(BOB) }];
       data
   }

   fn service(data: StoreData) -> OrgService {
       OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&device_secret([OWN; 32]), data)]).unwrap()
   }

   fn own() -> DevicePublicKey {
       device_key(OWN)
   }

   fn encoded(svc: &OrgService) -> Vec<u8> {
       postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&own()).unwrap()).unwrap()
   }

   fn request(list: &[&str]) -> Vec<u8> {
       encode_message(&WireMessage::OrganisationRequest { org_id: org(), addresses: addresses(list) }).unwrap()
   }

   fn answer_body(epoch: u64, members: &[MemberSnapshot], key: [u8; 32]) -> Vec<u8> {
       encode_message(&WireMessage::Organisation {
           org_id: org(),
           epoch: Epoch::new(epoch),
           record_snapshot: postcard::to_allocvec(members).unwrap(),
           org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey::from(key),
       })
       .unwrap()
   }

   // verifies: LLR-vyank2
   #[test]
   fn build_organisation_request_addresses_every_listed_device_or_the_invites_issuer() {
       let mut data = admin_data();
       let mut members = listed_members();
       members.push(snapshot(5, "erin", 0x14, 0x25));
       let root = trie_of(&members).root_hash().unwrap();
       data.record = Some(record(members, root, 3));
       let svc = service(data);
       let before = encoded(&svc);
       let given = addresses(&["198.51.100.4:7000"]);
       let requests = svc.build_organisation_request(&own(), given.clone()).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(
           requests.iter().map(|message| message.recipient).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
           vec![device_key(CAROL), device_key(0x25)],
           "every listed Device but this one, in record order"
       );
       for message in &requests {
           assert_eq!(
               decode_message(&message.body).unwrap(),

       // A provisional Member, holding no record, asks its Invite's issuer.

           issuer_addresses: parsed(&[]),

       let (member, _secret, _created) = svc.propose_member(&mut OsRng, &invite, "Bob", "Builder", &["bob"]).unwrap();

       assert!(matches!(svc.build_organisation_request(&founder, vec![]), Err(OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten)));
       assert!(matches!(svc.build_organisation_request(&device_key(0x40), vec![]), Err(OrgNodeError::PersonaNotHeld)));

   fn a_listed_requester_is_answered_with_the_full_record_and_its_key() {

   // verifies: LLR-j338wq
   #[test]
   fn a_revoked_requester_is_answered_with_its_notice_and_nothing_else() {
       let mut svc = service(admin_data());
       let root = svc.store_data(&own()).unwrap().record.as_ref().unwrap().root_hash;
       let (checked, change) = svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(BOB), &request(&[])).unwrap();

       assert!(change.is_some(), "the sender's address-book entry is set");

   // verifies: LLR-xc9c6w
   #[test]
   fn an_answer_over_the_message_bound_is_refused() {
       let mut data = admin_data();
       let long = Name::parse(&"N".repeat(128)).unwrap();
       let long_surname = Surname::parse(&"S".repeat(128)).unwrap();
       let mut members = listed_members();
       for index in 0..3000u32 {
           let mut id = [0x70; 32];
           id[..4].copy_from_slice(&index.to_be_bytes());
           members.push(MemberSnapshot {
               id: MemberId::new(id),
               handle: h("m"),
               name: long.clone(),
               surname: long_surname.clone(),
               member_key: member_key(0x15),
               device_keys: vec![device_key(0x26)],
           });
       }
       assert!(postcard::to_allocvec(&members).unwrap().len() > MAX_MESSAGE, "fixture: the record is over the bound");
       // The record is held as given; its root is not recalculated for a listed requester's answer.
       data.record = Some(record(members, RootHash::new([0x33; 32]), 3));
       let mut svc = service(data);
       let before = encoded(&svc);
       let refused = svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &request(&["192.0.2.22:4433"]));
       assert!(matches!(refused, Err(OrgNodeError::MessageTooLarge { length }) if length > MAX_MESSAGE));
       assert_eq!(encoded(&svc), before, "answered whole or not at all: no address-book change either");
   }

   // verifies: LLR-kd7u2r
   #[test]
   fn an_answer_is_kept_only_from_a_listed_device_while_behind_and_for_a_later_epoch() {
       let next = vec![snapshot(1, "alice", 1, OWN), snapshot(3, "carol", 0x12, CAROL), snapshot(6, "fay", 0x16, 0x27)];
       let next_root = trie_of(&next).root_hash().unwrap();

       // Not behind: refused, nothing kept.
       let mut svc = service(admin_data());
       assert!(matches!(
           svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &answer_body(5, &next, [0x61; 32])),
           Err(OrgNodeError::OrganisationNotRequested { org_id }) if org_id == org()
       ));

       let mut behind = admin_data();
       behind.behind = Some(Epoch::new(5));
       let mut svc = service(behind);
       let before = encoded(&svc);
       // From a Device the record does not list (a revoked one included).
       for sender in [STRANGER, BOB] {
           assert!(matches!(
               svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(sender), &answer_body(5, &next, [0x61; 32])),
               Err(OrgNodeError::SenderNotListed { .. })
           ));
       }
       // For an epoch not after the record's.
       for epoch in [2, 3] {
           assert!(matches!(
               svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &answer_body(epoch, &next, [0x61; 32])),
               Err(OrgNodeError::StaleChainState { .. })
           ));
       }
       assert_eq!(encoded(&svc), before, "every refusal keeps nothing");

       // Listed, behind, later epoch: kept as an answer, the key derived, no Change set.
       let (checked, change) =
           svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &answer_body(5, &next, [0x61; 32])).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(checked, Checked::OrganisationAnswerKept { epoch } if epoch == Epoch::new(5)));
       assert!(change.is_some());
       let data = svc.store_data(&own()).unwrap();
       let kept = data.provisional_organisations.last().unwrap();
       assert_eq!(kept.origin, Origin::Answer { from: device_key(CAROL) });
       assert_eq!((kept.epoch, kept.root), (Epoch::new(5), next_root));
       assert_eq!(kept.org_pub_key, OrgPrivateKey::from([0x61; 32]).x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap());
       assert!(kept.change_set.is_none() && kept.applied.is_empty());
       assert_eq!(data.record.as_ref().unwrap().epoch, Epoch::new(3), "kept, never adopted on receipt");

       // The same identity again: already held, no second copy.
       let (checked, change) =
           svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &answer_body(5, &next, [0x61; 32])).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(checked, Checked::AlreadyHeld));
       assert!(change.is_none());
   }

   // verifies: LLR-h9d65p
   #[test]
   fn a_request_sets_its_senders_address_book_entry_and_seals_only_on_change() {
       let mut svc = service(admin_data());
       let first = ["192.0.2.22:4433"];
       let (_, change) = svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &request(&first)).unwrap();
       let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = change.expect("a new entry seals the store");
       assert_eq!(write.device_key, own());
       let (_, change) = svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &request(&first)).unwrap();
       assert!(change.is_none(), "the same addresses again change nothing");
       let second = ["192.0.2.23:4433", "198.51.100.23:4433"];
       let (_, change) = svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(CAROL), &request(&second)).unwrap();
       assert!(change.is_some(), "other addresses replace the entry");
       let (_, change) = svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &own(), device_key(BOB), &request(&first)).unwrap();
       assert!(change.is_some(), "a revoked requester's entry is set too");
       assert_eq!(
           svc.store_data(&own()).unwrap().address_book,
           vec![(device_key(CAROL), parsed(&second)), (device_key(BOB), parsed(&first))],
           "one entry per Device key"
       );
   }

   // In a store with no record: a provisional Member keeps the answer to the request it sent its issuer,
   // for the Organisation its expected admission names, from whichever Device sent it, only while behind;
   // an answer for another Organisation, and any answer in a founding store, is `OrgNotHeld`.
   // verifies: LLR-e6w3nr
   #[test]
   fn a_provisional_member_keeps_an_expected_answer_only_while_behind() {
       let invite = Invite {
           org_name: "Acme".into(),
           org_id: org(),
           invitee_name: "Bob".into(),
           issuer: device_key(5),
           issuer_addresses: parsed(&[]),
           invite_id: InviteId::new([3; 32]),
       };
       let mut proposing = OrgService::new(vec![]).unwrap();
       let (member, secret, _created) =
           proposing.propose_member(&mut OsRng, &invite, "Bob", "Builder", &["bob"]).unwrap();
       let created = proposing.store_data(&member).unwrap().clone();
       assert!(created.record.is_none() && created.member.is_some(), "fixture: a provisional Member's store");
       let members = vec![snapshot(1, "alice", 1, OWN), snapshot(7, "bob", 0x17, 0x28)];
       let root = trie_of(&members).root_hash().unwrap();

       // Not behind: refused, nothing kept.
       let mut svc = OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&secret, created.clone())]).unwrap();
       let before = postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&member).unwrap()).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(
           svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &member, device_key(5), &answer_body(1, &members, [0x61; 32])),
           Err(OrgNodeError::OrganisationNotRequested { org_id }) if org_id == org()
       ));
       assert_eq!(postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&member).unwrap()).unwrap(), before);

       // Behind: an answer for an Organisation no expected admission names is refused.
       let mut behind = created.clone();
       behind.behind = Some(Epoch::new(1));
       let expected_before = behind.expected_admissions.clone();
       let mut svc = OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&secret, behind)]).unwrap();
       let elsewhere = OrgId::new([0xbb; 20]);
       let other = encode_message(&WireMessage::Organisation {
           org_id: elsewhere,
           epoch: Epoch::new(1),
           record_snapshot: postcard::to_allocvec(&members).unwrap(),
           org_private_key: OrgPrivateKey::from([0x61; 32]),
       })
       .unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(
           svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &member, device_key(5), &other),
           Err(OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id }) if org_id == elsewhere
       ));

       // Behind, the expected Organisation, from a Device nothing lists: kept for verification.
       let (checked, change) =
           svc.check_received(&mut OsRng, &member, device_key(STRANGER), &answer_body(1, &members, [0x61; 32])).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(checked, Checked::OrganisationAnswerKept { epoch } if epoch == Epoch::new(1)));
       let StoreChange::Sealed(write) = change.expect("the keep seals the store");
       assert_eq!(write.device_key, member);
       let data = svc.store_data(&member).unwrap();
       let kept = data.provisional_organisations.last().unwrap();
       assert_eq!(kept.origin, Origin::Answer { from: device_key(STRANGER) });
       assert_eq!((kept.epoch, kept.root), (Epoch::new(1), root));
       assert_eq!(kept.org_pub_key, OrgPrivateKey::from([0x61; 32]).x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap());
       assert!(kept.change_set.is_none() && kept.applied.is_empty());
       assert!(data.record.is_none(), "kept, never adopted on receipt");
       assert_eq!(data.expected_admissions, expected_before, "the expectations are untouched");

       // A founding store whose proxy is not recorded holds no expected admission: it keeps no answer.
       let (founder, _secret, _created) =
           proposing.propose_founding(&mut OsRng, "Alice", "Smith", "alice", "Acme".into()).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(
           proposing.check_received(&mut OsRng, &founder, device_key(5), &answer_body(1, &members, [0x61; 32])),
           Err(OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id }) if org_id == org()
       ));
   }
   ```

     impl StoreData {
         /// Set the address-book entry of `device_key` to `addresses`, replacing an earlier one; true
         /// exactly when the entry changed (LLR-h9d65p). One entry per Device key.
         pub(crate) fn set_address(&mut self, device_key: DevicePublicKey, addresses: EndpointAddresses) -> bool {
             match self.address_book.iter_mut().find(|(key, _)| *key == device_key) {
                 Some((_, kept)) if *kept == addresses => false,

                     *kept = addresses;
                     true
                 }

     ```rust
         /// One organisation request per Device the current record lists other than this Persona's, in
         /// record order; in a provisional Member's store, one for the Invite's issuer (LLR-vyank2). The
         /// caller's addresses travel last (LLR-h4gwns). Changes nothing.
         pub fn build_organisation_request(
             &self,
             device_key: &DevicePublicKey,
             sender_addresses: Vec<String>,
         ) -> Result<Vec<OutgoingMessage>, OrgNodeError> {
             let index = self.store_index(device_key)?;
             let data = self.stores[index].data();
             let (org_id, recipients): (OrgId, Vec<DevicePublicKey>) = match (&data.record, &data.member) {
                 (Some(record), _) => (
                     record.org_id,
                     record
                         .trie_members
                         .iter()
                         .flat_map(|member| member.device_keys.iter().copied())
                         .filter(|device| *device != data.persona.device_key)
                         .collect(),
                 ),
                 (None, Some(member)) => (member.org_id, vec![member.issuer]),
                 (None, None) => {
                     return Err(match data.persona.org_id {
                         Some(org_id) => OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id },
                         None => OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten,
                     })
                 }
             };
             crate::store::parse_field("request.addresses", EndpointAddresses::parse(sender_addresses.clone()))?;
             let body = encode_message(&WireMessage::OrganisationRequest { org_id, addresses: sender_addresses })?;
             Ok(recipients.into_iter().map(|recipient| OutgoingMessage { recipient, body: body.clone() }).collect())
         }

         /// The organisation-request arm of `check_received`. Who may ask is LLR-283x6f's rule: a listed
         /// Device or one held as revoked. The answer is built whole or not at all (LLR-xc9c6w): the record
         /// snapshot and its key for a listed requester (LLR-7kdhst), the notice proving its absence from the
         /// current record for a revoked one (LLR-j338wq). Then the requester's address-book entry is set,
         /// sealing only when it changed (LLR-h9d65p). Every refusal keeps nothing.
         fn answer_organisation_request<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
             &mut self,
             rng: &mut R,
             index: usize,
             sender: DevicePublicKey,
             org_id: OrgId,
             addresses: Vec<String>,
         ) -> Result<(Checked, Option<StoreChange>), OrgNodeError> {
             let data = self.stores[index].data();
             let record = match &data.record {
                 Some(record) if record.org_id == org_id => record,
                 _ => return Err(OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id }),
             };
             let listed = record.trie_members.iter().any(|member| member.device_keys.contains(&sender));
             let revoked = match listed {
                 true => None,
                 false => Some(
                     data.revoked_devices
                         .iter()
                         .find(|revoked| revoked.device_key == sender)
                         .ok_or(OrgNodeError::SenderNotListed { org_id })?,
                 ),
             };
             let addresses = crate::store::parse_field("request.addresses", EndpointAddresses::parse(addresses))?;
             let body = match revoked {
                 None => encode_message(&WireMessage::Organisation {
                     org_id,
                     epoch: record.epoch,
                     record_snapshot: encode_record_snapshot(&record.trie_members)?,
                     org_private_key: record.org_private_key.clone(),
                 })?,
                 Some(revoked) => {
                     let proof = trie_from_snapshots(&record.trie_members)?
                         .prove_absent(&revoked.member_id, &sender)
                         .map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
                     let notice = RevocationNotice { org_id, member_id: revoked.member_id, device: sender, proof };
                     encode_message(&WireMessage::Revocation(notice))?
                 }
             };
             let answer = OutgoingMessage { recipient: sender, body };
             if !data.clone().set_address(sender, addresses.clone()) {
                 return Ok((Checked::OrganisationRequest { answer }, None));
             }
             let (_, write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| Ok(data.set_address(sender, addresses)))?;
             Ok((Checked::OrganisationRequest { answer }, Some(StoreChange::Sealed(write))))
         }

         /// The organisation-answer arm of `check_received` (LLR-kd7u2r) and of `check_without_record`
         /// (LLR-e6w3nr). With a record, an answer is kept only from a listed Device (`SenderNotListed`), only
         /// while the behind marker is set (`OrganisationNotRequested`), and only for an epoch after the
         /// record's (`StaleChainState`); with none, only while the behind marker is set. Its
         /// snapshot is decoded with the `member.*` refusals and its root calculated. It is kept as an
         /// `Answer` provisional organisation with the key derived from the carried one and no Change set,
         /// through the one bound-checked keep (LLR-m76r4k). An identity already held is `AlreadyHeld`, with
         /// no change.
         fn keep_organisation_answer<R: RngCore + CryptoRng>(
             &mut self,
             rng: &mut R,
             index: usize,
             sender: DevicePublicKey,
             message: WireMessage,
         ) -> Result<(Checked, Option<StoreChange>), OrgNodeError> {
             let WireMessage::Organisation { org_id, epoch, record_snapshot, org_private_key } = message else {
                 return Err(OrgNodeError::MalformedMessage);
             };
             let data = self.stores[index].data();
             // With a record: LLR-kd7u2r's three conditions, in its order. With none (a provisional
             // Member's store, which `check_without_record` lets through only for the Organisation its
             // expected admission names): the behind marker alone, from whichever Device (LLR-e6w3nr).
             let base_root = match &data.record {
                 Some(record) if record.org_id == org_id => {
                     if !record.trie_members.iter().any(|member| member.device_keys.contains(&sender)) {
                         return Err(OrgNodeError::SenderNotListed { org_id });
                     }
                     if data.behind.is_none() {
                         return Err(OrgNodeError::OrganisationNotRequested { org_id });
                     }
                     if epoch <= record.epoch {
                         return Err(OrgNodeError::StaleChainState { org_id, chain_epoch: epoch, record_epoch: record.epoch });
                     }
                     Some(record.root_hash)
                 }
                 Some(_) => return Err(OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { org_id }),
                 None => {
                     if data.behind.is_none() {
                         return Err(OrgNodeError::OrganisationNotRequested { org_id });
                     }
                     None
                 }
             };
             let trie = first_admission_base(&record_snapshot)?;
             let root = trie.root_hash().map_err(OrgNodeError::Trie)?;
             let org_pub_key = org_private_key.x25519_keypair().org_public_key()?;
             if data.provisional_organisations.iter().any(|held| held.root == root && held.org_pub_key == org_pub_key) {
                 return Ok((Checked::AlreadyHeld, None));
             }
             let organisation = ProvisionalOrganisation {
                 epoch,
                 // An answer carries no Change set; in a store with no record there is no base, and the
                 // answer's own root stands in (no adoption reads `base_root` of an `Answer`).
                 base_root: base_root.unwrap_or(root),
                 members: trie.members().iter().map(snapshot_of).collect(),
                 root,
                 org_pub_key,
                 org_private_key,
                 change_set: None,
                 base_snapshot: None,
                 origin: Origin::Answer { from: sender },
                 applied: Vec::new(),
             };
             let ((), write) = self.change(index, rng, |data| {
                 data.provisional_organisations.push(organisation);
                 crate::store::ensure_within_bound(data)
             })?;
             Ok((Checked::OrganisationAnswerKept { epoch }, Some(StoreChange::Sealed(write))))
         }
     ```
     `data.clone().set_address(…)` decides "changed?" on a copy, so the unchanged case seals nothing. In
     `keep_organisation_answer`, a `StaleChainState` naming the answer's epoch as `chain_epoch` reuses the
     variant LLR-kd7u2r names.

   /// This store's Persona: member seed 1, Device seed 4, MemberId `[1;32]`.

   }
   fn h(text: &str) -> Handle {
       Handle::parse(text).unwrap()
   }
   fn parsed(list: &[&str]) -> EndpointAddresses {
       EndpointAddresses::parse(list.iter().map(|a| a.to_string()).collect()).unwrap()
   }
   fn org_key(seed: u8) -> (OrgPrivateKey, OrgPublicKey) {
       let private = OrgPrivateKey::from([seed; 32]);
       let public = private.x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap();
       (private, public)
   }

   fn snapshot(id: u8, handle: &str, member: u8, device: u8) -> MemberSnapshot {
       MemberSnapshot {
           id: MemberId::new([id; 32]),
           handle: h(handle),
           name: Name::parse("Test").unwrap(),
           surname: Surname::parse("User").unwrap(),
           member_key: member_key(member),
           device_keys: vec![device_key(device)],
       }
   }
   fn alice() -> MemberSnapshot {
       snapshot(1, "alice", 1, OWN)
   }

   fn trie_of(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> Trie {
       let leaves = members
           .iter()
           .map(|s| {
               MemberLeaf::new(s.id, s.handle.clone(), s.member_key, s.name.clone(), s.surname.clone(), s.device_keys.clone())
                   .unwrap()
           })
           .collect();
       Trie::genesis(leaves).unwrap()
   }
   fn root_of(members: &[MemberSnapshot]) -> RootHash {
       trie_of(members).root_hash().unwrap()
   }

   fn record(members: Vec<MemberSnapshot>, epoch: u64) -> OrgRecord {
       let (private, public) = org_key(0x60);
       OrgRecord::from(OrgRecordParts {
           org_id: org(),
           root_hash: root_of(&members),
           org_pub_key: public,
           epoch: Epoch::new(epoch),
           last_seq: SequenceNumber::new(epoch),
           trie_members: members,
           proxy_account: None,
           org_private_key: private,
           kept_change_set: None,
           kept_base_snapshot: None,
       })
   }

   /// An Active store whose record (epoch 3) lists this Device and `others`.
   fn member_data(others: Vec<MemberSnapshot>) -> StoreData {
       let mut persona = persona_record("p-alice", 1, OWN);
       persona.org_id = Some(org());
       persona.member_id = Some(MemberId::new([1; 32]));
       persona.status = PersonaStatus::Active;
       let mut data = empty_store(persona);
       let mut members = vec![alice()];
       members.extend(others);
       data.record = Some(record(members, 3));
       data.org_name = "Acme".into();
       data
   }

   /// The rich Active store LLR-f9mcsq's test drives: a record listing this Device, Bob (0x21) and Carol
   /// (0x22); a provisional change and organisation; a kept admission request and revocation notice; an
   /// outstanding invite; an address-book entry; a revoked Device.
   fn rich_data() -> StoreData {
       let mut data = member_data(vec![snapshot(2, "bob", 0x11, 0x21), snapshot(3, "carol", 0x12, 0x22)]);
       let invite_id = InviteId::new([0x31; 32]);
       data.provisional_changes = vec![ProvisionalChange::Revoke { member_id: MemberId::new([2; 32]) }];
       let next = vec![alice(), snapshot(3, "carol", 0x12, 0x22)];
       let (private, public) = org_key(0x62);
       data.provisional_organisations = vec![ProvisionalOrganisation::from(ProvisionalOrganisationParts {
           epoch: Epoch::new(4),
           base_root: data.record.as_ref().unwrap().root_hash,
           root: root_of(&next),
           members: next,
           org_pub_key: public,
           org_private_key: private,
           change_set: Some(vec![9, 8]),
           base_snapshot: Some(vec![7]),
           origin: Origin::Own,
           applied: data.provisional_changes.clone(),
       })];
       data.outstanding_invites = vec![OutstandingInvite { org_id: org(), invite_id, invitee_name: "Dave".into() }];
       data.kept_admission_requests = vec![KeptAdmissionRequest {
           org_id: org(),
           invite_id,
           from: device_key(0x23),
           name: Name::parse("Dave").unwrap(),
           surname: Surname::parse("Day").unwrap(),
           preferred_handles: vec![h("dave")],
           member_key: member_key(0x13),
           device_key: device_key(0x23),
           addresses: parsed(&["192.0.2.23:4433"]),
       }];
       data.kept_revocation_notices = vec![notice_removing_own(&data)];
       data.address_book = vec![(device_key(0x21), parsed(&["192.0.2.21:4433"]))];
       data.revoked_devices = vec![RevokedDevice { member_id: MemberId::new([9; 32]), device_key: device_key(0x29) }];
       data
   }

   /// A notice for this Device, its proof from the record without this Persona's Member.
   fn notice_removing_own(data: &StoreData) -> RevocationNotice {
       let without = removed_members(data);
       let proof = trie_of(&without).prove_absent(&MemberId::new([1; 32]), &own()).unwrap();
       RevocationNotice { org_id: org(), member_id: MemberId::new([1; 32]), device: own(), proof }
   }
   fn removed_members(data: &StoreData) -> Vec<MemberSnapshot> {
       data.record.as_ref().unwrap().trie_members.iter().filter(|m| !m.device_keys.contains(&own())).cloned().collect()
   }

   fn service(data: StoreData) -> OrgService {
       OrgService::new(vec![store_for_test(&own_secret(), data)]).unwrap()
   }

   fn encoded(svc: &OrgService) -> Vec<u8> {
       postcard::to_allocvec(svc.store_data(&own()).unwrap()).unwrap()
   }

   fn sample_ack(signature: u8) -> Acknowledgement {
       Acknowledgement {
           org_id: org(),
           member_id: MemberId::new([1; 32]),
           device: own(),
           epoch: Epoch::new(4),
           root: RootHash::new([0x66; 32]),
           signature: Signature64([signature; 64]),
       }
   }

   fn kept(recipient: u8, addresses: Option<EndpointAddresses>) -> KeptAcknowledgement {
       KeptAcknowledgement { ack: sample_ack(0x5a), recipient: device_key(recipient), recipient_addresses: addresses }
   }

   fn removed_store() -> RemovedStore {
       RemovedStore {
           org_id: org(),
           verified_at: VerificationTime(1_760_000_000),
           acknowledgements: vec![kept(0x21, Some(parsed(&["198.51.100.7:4433"]))), kept(0x22, None)],
       }
   }

   /// `content`'s plaintext sealed under this Device's store key, as org-io's file would hold it.
   fn sealed(plaintext: &[u8]) -> SealedStore {
       seal_plaintext_for_test(&own_secret(), own(), plaintext, &mut OsRng)
   }
   fn removed_plaintext(store: &RemovedStore) -> Vec<u8> {
       let mut bytes = vec![1u8];
       bytes.extend(postcard::to_allocvec(store).unwrap());
       bytes
   }
   /// A service over the removed store `store`, as `unseal` opens it.
   fn removed_service(store: &RemovedStore) -> OrgService {
       let opened = PersonaStore::unseal(&sealed(&removed_plaintext(store)), own(), own_secret()).unwrap();
       OrgService::new(vec![opened]).unwrap()
   }

   /// The content a write sealed, opened with this Device's secret.
   fn content_of(write: &StoreWrite) -> StoreContent {
       PersonaStore::unseal(&write.sealed, write.device_key, own_secret()).unwrap().content().clone()
   }

   fn never_asked(_: &[DevicePublicKey]) -> Vec<DeviceSecret> {
       panic!("device_secrets must not be called")
   }

   // verifies: LLR-6zaeb6
   #[test]
   fn store_content_encodes_its_variant_index_then_its_fields() {
       let data = member_data(vec![]);
       let active = postcard::to_allocvec(&StoreContent::Active(data.clone())).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(active[0], 0, "Active is variant 0");
       assert_eq!(&active[1..], postcard::to_allocvec(&data).unwrap().as_slice(), "then the store data");

       let removed = removed_store();
       let bytes = postcard::to_allocvec(&StoreContent::Removed(removed.clone())).unwrap();
       assert_eq!(bytes[0], 1, "Removed is variant 1");
       let mut expected = org().as_bytes().to_vec();
       expected.extend(postcard::to_allocvec(&removed.verified_at).unwrap());
       expected.extend(postcard::to_allocvec(&removed.acknowledgements).unwrap());
       assert_eq!(&bytes[1..], expected.as_slice(), "org_id, verified_at, acknowledgements, in that order");
       let one = postcard::to_allocvec(&removed.acknowledgements[1]).unwrap();
       let mut fields = postcard::to_allocvec(&removed.acknowledgements[1].ack).unwrap();
       fields.extend(device_key(0x22).as_bytes());
       fields.push(0); // recipient_addresses: None
       assert_eq!(one, fields, "ack, recipient, recipient_addresses, in that order");
   }

   // verifies: LLR-6zaeb6
   #[test]
   fn unseal_reparses_a_removed_forms_keys_and_addresses_and_refuses_an_unknown_variant() {
       let removed = removed_store();
       let svc = removed_service(&removed);
       assert_eq!(svc.store_content(&own()), Some(&StoreContent::Removed(removed.clone())));

       // A recipient key that is no curve point (y = 2 has no x on edwards25519): refused naming the field.
       let mut no_point = [0u8; 32];
       no_point[0] = 2;
       let mut plaintext = removed_plaintext(&removed);
       let recipient = device_key(0x21);
       let at = plaintext.windows(32).position(|window| window == recipient.as_bytes()).unwrap();
       plaintext[at..at + 32].copy_from_slice(&no_point);
       assert!(matches!(
           PersonaStore::unseal(&sealed(&plaintext), own(), own_secret()),
           Err(OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field, .. }) if field.starts_with("removed.")
       ));
       // Addresses its parse refuses (seventeen entries): refused naming the removed field.
       let mut over = removed.clone();
       over.acknowledgements[0].recipient_addresses = None;
       let mut plaintext = removed_plaintext(&over);
       let tag = plaintext.len() - postcard::to_allocvec(&over.acknowledgements[1]).unwrap().len() - 1;
       assert_eq!(plaintext[tag], 0, "fixture: the first recipient_addresses is None");
       let seventeen: Vec<String> = (0..17).map(|port| format!("192.0.2.1:{port}")).collect();
       let mut some = vec![1u8];
       some.extend(postcard::to_allocvec(&seventeen).unwrap());
       plaintext.splice(tag..tag + 1, some);
       assert!(matches!(
           PersonaStore::unseal(&sealed(&plaintext), own(), own_secret()),
           Err(OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field, .. }) if field.starts_with("removed.")
       ));
       // An unknown variant index.
       let mut plaintext = removed_plaintext(&removed);
       plaintext[0] = 2;
       assert!(matches!(
           PersonaStore::unseal(&sealed(&plaintext), own(), own_secret()),
           Err(OrgNodeError::InvalidField { field: "store", .. })
       ));
   }
