   ```rust
   /// org-node's left-out changes, unchanged and in its order, each with the names the still-kept
   /// admission request gives and the Handle the adopted record gives a revoked Member (LLR-gaanm2).
   fn discarded_summaries(
       service: &org_node::service::OrgService,
       device_key: DevicePublicKey,
       org_id: OrgId,
       discarded: &[org_node::verify_org::DiscardedChange],
   ) -> Vec<DiscardedChangeSummary> {
       let requests = service.admission_requests(&device_key).unwrap_or_default();
       let members = service.list_orgs().into_iter().find(|record| record.org_id == org_id).map(|record| record.trie_members.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
       discarded
           .iter()
           .map(|change| match change {
               org_node::verify_org::DiscardedChange::Admit { invite_id, handle } => {
                   let request = requests.iter().find(|(request, _)| request.invite_id == *invite_id).map(|(request, _)| *request);
                   DiscardedChangeSummary::Admission {
                       invite_id: *invite_id,
                       name: request.map(|request| request.name.clone()),
                       surname: request.map(|request| request.surname.clone()),
                       handle: handle.clone(),
                   }
               }
               org_node::verify_org::DiscardedChange::Revoke { member_id } => DiscardedChangeSummary::Revocation {
                   member_id: *member_id,
                   handle: members.iter().find(|member| member.id == *member_id).map(|member| member.handle.clone()),
               },
           })
           .collect()
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   //! The demo journey's steps over the handle's own surface (T37 of
   //! docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md, extended by T38, T40 and
   //! T42): a founding written and adopted, an admission request kept by
   //! org-node's check, the next epoch proposed, written and adopted, and a
   //! chain write left unknown. No helper installs a keychain: the test does,
   //! before its first call.
   #![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]

   use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;

   use org_io::test_support::FakeChain;
   use org_io::{HeldTarget, OrgIo, Verified, WriteReport};
   use org_node::{DevicePublicKey, Epoch, InviteId, MemberId, OrgId, OrgPublicKey, OrgPrivateKey, OrgState, RootHash};
   use rand::rngs::OsRng;

   use super::handles::handle;

   /// A handle whose founding was written and adopted: its chain, the
   /// Organisation and the founder's Device key.
   pub struct Admin {
       pub io: OrgIo,
       pub chain: FakeChain,
       pub org: OrgId,
       pub device: DevicePublicKey,
   }

   /// A joiner's handle whose provisional Member was proposed from an Invite of
   /// `org`: its Device key and the invite identifier.
   pub struct Joining {
       pub io: OrgIo,
       pub chain: FakeChain,
       pub device: DevicePublicKey,
       pub invite_id: InviteId,
   }

   /// Propose a founding on `io`; its founder Device key.
   pub async fn propose_founding(io: &OrgIo, handle_text: &str) -> DevicePublicKey {
       io.propose_founding_organisation("Alice", "Admin", handle_text, "Acme").await.unwrap().founder
   }

   /// Party `a` of test `tag`: a founding proposed, written in its two steps
   /// and adopted by its verification.
   pub async fn founded(tag: &str) -> Admin {
       let chain = FakeChain::new();
       let io = handle(tag, "a", &chain);
       let device = propose_founding(&io, "alice").await;
       let written = io.write_organisation_to_chain(HeldTarget::Founding(device)).await.unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(written, WriteReport::Included { .. }), "{written:?}");
       let verified = io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Founding(device)).await;
       assert!(matches!(verified, Verified::Adopted { .. }), "{verified:?}");
       let org = io.organisations().await[0].org_id;
       Admin { io, chain, org, device }
   }

   /// Party `party` of test `tag` takes an Invite `admin` issues and proposes
   /// its provisional Member from it.
   pub async fn invited(admin: &Admin, tag: &str, party: &str, handle_text: &str) -> Joining {
       let invite = admin.io.issue_invite(admin.org, "Bob").await.unwrap();
       let chain = FakeChain::sharing_slots_with(&admin.chain);
       let io = handle(tag, party, &chain);
       let proposed = io.propose_member(&invite, "Bob", "Builder", &[handle_text]).await.unwrap();
       Joining { io, chain, device: proposed.member_device, invite_id: proposed.invite_id }
   }

   /// `joining`'s admission request, carrying `addresses`, kept by `admin`'s
   /// org-node through its own check, as the receive step would keep it.
   pub fn keep_request(admin: &Admin, joining: &Joining, addresses: Vec<String>) {
       let request = joining.io.node_for_test().build_admission_request(&joining.device, addresses).unwrap();
       let mut node = admin.io.node_for_test();
       let (checked, change) = node.check_received(&mut OsRng, &admin.device, joining.device, &request.body).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(checked, org_node::Checked::AdmissionRequest { .. }), "{checked:?}");
       assert!(change.is_some(), "the first request is kept");
   }

   /// `admin` proposes the admission of `joining` and the updated
   /// Organisation; the epoch proposed.
   pub async fn propose_admission(admin: &Admin, joining: &Joining) -> Epoch {
       admin.io.propose_admission(admin.org, joining.invite_id, None).await.unwrap();
       admin.io.propose_updated_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap().epoch
   }

   /// Write `admin`'s proposed epoch and adopt it by verification.
   pub async fn write_and_adopt(admin: &Admin) {
       let written = admin.io.write_organisation_to_chain(HeldTarget::Organisation(admin.org)).await.unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(written, WriteReport::Included { .. }), "{written:?}");
       let verified = admin.io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Organisation(admin.org)).await;
       assert!(matches!(verified, Verified::Adopted { .. }), "{verified:?}");
   }

   /// `joining` admitted at `admin`'s next epoch, its request carrying
   /// `addresses`: kept, proposed, written, adopted.
   pub async fn admit(admin: &Admin, joining: &Joining, addresses: Vec<String>) {
       keep_request(admin, joining, addresses);
       propose_admission(admin, joining).await;
       write_and_adopt(admin).await;
   }

   /// The MemberId `admin`'s current record gives the Device `device`.
   pub async fn member_id_of(admin: &Admin, device: DevicePublicKey) -> MemberId {
       let record = admin.io.organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
       record.members.iter().find(|member| member.device_keys.contains(&device)).unwrap().id
   }

   /// Write `target`'s provisional organisation while the chain never
   /// answers, crossing the 90-second bound on a paused clock (current-thread
   /// runtime only): with `lands`, the write moves the chain first. The
   /// report is `Unknown`.
   pub async fn unknown_write(io: &OrgIo, chain: &FakeChain, target: HeldTarget, lands: bool) {
       let switch = if lands { &chain.write_lands_then_hangs } else { &chain.write_hanging };
       switch.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
       tokio::time::pause();
       let report = io.write_organisation_to_chain(target).await.unwrap();
       tokio::time::resume();
       switch.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
       assert!(matches!(report, WriteReport::Unknown { .. }), "{report:?}");
   }

   /// An Organisation public key no handle holds the private half of.
   pub fn stranger_key(seed: u8) -> OrgPublicKey {
       OrgPrivateKey::from([seed; 32]).x25519_keypair().org_public_key().unwrap()
   }

   /// Put `org` on the chain at `epoch` with a root and key no handle
   /// proposed: another Admin's write.
   pub fn chain_moved_elsewhere(chain: &FakeChain, org: OrgId, epoch: u64) {
       let state = OrgState { root_hash: RootHash::new([0x77; 32]), org_pub_key: stranger_key(0x78), epoch: Epoch::new(epoch) };
       chain.slots().set(org, state);
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   use org_io::test_support::{FakeChain, MemoryKeychain, Refusal};
   use org_io::{HeldTarget, Verified, WriteOutcome, WriteReport};
   use org_node::Epoch;
   use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;

   use common::handles::{fresh_keychain, handle, store_bytes};
   use common::journey::{
       admit, chain_moved_elsewhere, founded, invited, keep_request, member_id_of, propose_admission, propose_founding,
       unknown_write, Admin,
   };

   /// The outcome and the settled write of a verification that found an
   /// unknown write recorded; anything else fails the test.
   fn settle_parts(verified: Verified) -> (Verified, WriteOutcome) {
       match verified {
           Verified::Settled { outcome, write } => (*outcome, write),
           other => panic!("no unknown write settled: {other:?}"),
       }
   }

   /// `tag`'s Admin with an epoch-2 admission proposed and its write left
   /// unknown (`lands`: the chain moved before the bound elapsed).
   async fn settle_unknown_update(tag: &str, lands: bool) -> Admin {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let admin = founded(tag).await;
       let bob = invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       keep_request(&admin, &bob, vec![]);
       assert_eq!(propose_admission(&admin, &bob).await, Epoch::new(2));
       unknown_write(&admin.io, &admin.chain, HeldTarget::Organisation(admin.org), lands).await;
       admin
   }

   /// The Admin's provisional changes and provisional organisations, counted.
   fn settle_held(admin: &Admin) -> (usize, usize) {
       let node = admin.io.node_for_test();
       (node.provisional_changes(&admin.device).unwrap().len(), node.provisional_organisations(&admin.device).unwrap().len())
   }

   // Normal and abnormal, one target each: an unknown write the chain shows
   // executed is reported adopted and cleared; one past its window at the base
   // epoch is not executed; one overtaken by another root is deprecated with the
   // Organisation behind; one still within its window stays unknown and kept, so
   // the next write is still refused.
   // verifies: LLR-zey4mg
   #[tokio::test]
   async fn an_unknown_write_is_settled_adopted_not_executed_deprecated_or_still_unknown() {
       let landed = settle_unknown_update("settle-all-adopted", true).await;
       let (outcome, write) = settle_parts(landed.io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Organisation(landed.org)).await);
       assert!(matches!(outcome, Verified::Adopted { .. }), "{outcome:?}");
       assert_eq!(write, WriteOutcome::Adopted);
       let again = landed.io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Organisation(landed.org)).await;
       assert!(matches!(again, Verified::InStep { .. }), "cleared: {again:?}");

       let lapsed = settle_unknown_update("settle-all-not-executed", false).await;
       lapsed.chain.advance_finalised(65);
       let (outcome, write) = settle_parts(lapsed.io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Organisation(lapsed.org)).await);
       assert!(matches!(outcome, Verified::InStep { .. }), "{outcome:?}");
       assert_eq!(write, WriteOutcome::NotExecuted);

       let overtaken = settle_unknown_update("settle-all-deprecated", false).await;
       chain_moved_elsewhere(&overtaken.chain, overtaken.org, 2);
       let (outcome, write) = settle_parts(overtaken.io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Organisation(overtaken.org)).await);
       assert!(matches!(outcome, Verified::Behind { .. }), "{outcome:?}");
       assert_eq!(write, WriteOutcome::Deprecated);

       let pending = settle_unknown_update("settle-all-still", false).await;
       for _ in 0..2 {
           let (outcome, write) = settle_parts(pending.io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Organisation(pending.org)).await);
           assert!(matches!(outcome, Verified::InStep { .. }), "{outcome:?}");
           assert_eq!(write, WriteOutcome::StillUnknown, "kept, and reported again");
       }
       let refused = pending.io.write_organisation_to_chain(HeldTarget::Organisation(pending.org)).await;
       assert!(matches!(refused, Err(org_io::WriteRefused::OutcomeUnknown { .. })), "{refused:?}");
   }

   // Boundary: a founding's unknown write has no window — far past any block
   // count it stays unknown while the chain holds no genesis, and is adopted
   // once the chain shows it.
   // verifies: LLR-zey4mg
   #[tokio::test]
   async fn a_foundings_unknown_write_is_settled_only_adopted_or_still_unknown() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let chain = FakeChain::new();
       let io = handle("settle-founding-still", "a", &chain);
       let founder = propose_founding(&io, "alice").await;
       unknown_write(&io, &chain, HeldTarget::Founding(founder), false).await;
       chain.advance_finalised(10_000);
       let (outcome, write) = settle_parts(io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Founding(founder)).await);
       assert!(matches!(outcome, Verified::Unverified { .. }), "no genesis on the chain: {outcome:?}");
       assert_eq!(write, WriteOutcome::StillUnknown, "a founding is never not-executed");

       let chain = FakeChain::new();
       let io = handle("settle-founding-adopted", "a", &chain);
       let founder = propose_founding(&io, "alice").await;
       unknown_write(&io, &chain, HeldTarget::Founding(founder), true).await;
       let (outcome, write) = settle_parts(io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Founding(founder)).await);
       assert!(matches!(outcome, Verified::Adopted { .. }), "{outcome:?}");

   }

   // Abnormal, one cause after another on one Admin holding a provisional change
   // and a provisional organisation: a refused write, an unreadable chain, a
   // chain ahead on another root (Behind) and a chain at the record's epoch on
   // another root (Inconsistent) each leave both held and the store file's
   // bytes unchanged.
   // verifies: LLR-pbng7d
   #[tokio::test]
   async fn nothing_is_discarded_on_behind_inconsistent_unverified_or_a_refused_write() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "settle-no-discard";
       let admin = founded(tag).await;
       let bob = invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       keep_request(&admin, &bob, vec![]);
       propose_admission(&admin, &bob).await;
       let (held, files) = (settle_held(&admin), store_bytes(tag, "a"));
       assert_eq!(held, (1, 1));
       let target = HeldTarget::Organisation(admin.org);

       admin.chain.write_failing.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
       let refused = admin.io.write_organisation_to_chain(target).await.unwrap();
       admin.chain.write_failing.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
       assert!(matches!(refused, WriteReport::Refused { .. }), "{refused:?}");
       assert_eq!((settle_held(&admin), store_bytes(tag, "a")), (held, files.clone()), "a refused write");

       admin.chain.read_failing.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
       let unverified = admin.io.verify_organisation(target).await;
       admin.chain.read_failing.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
       assert!(matches!(unverified, Verified::Unverified { .. }), "{unverified:?}");
       assert_eq!((settle_held(&admin), store_bytes(tag, "a")), (held, files.clone()), "unverified");

       let on_chain = admin.chain.slots().get(&admin.org).unwrap();
       chain_moved_elsewhere(&admin.chain, admin.org, 3);
       let behind = admin.io.verify_organisation(target).await;
       assert!(matches!(behind, Verified::Behind { .. }), "{behind:?}");
       assert_eq!((settle_held(&admin), store_bytes(tag, "a")), (held, files.clone()), "behind");

       chain_moved_elsewhere(&admin.chain, admin.org, 1);
       let inconsistent = admin.io.verify_organisation(target).await;
       assert!(matches!(inconsistent, Verified::Inconsistent { .. }), "{inconsistent:?}");
       assert_eq!((settle_held(&admin), store_bytes(tag, "a")), (held, files), "inconsistent");
       admin.chain.slots().set(admin.org, on_chain);
   }

   // The closure is called only on this node's removal and reads the keychain
   // item of the Device org-node names, once: an in-step verification reads
   // the keychain not at all. A locked keychain at the removal is
   // `Verified::Keychain`, nothing written; unlocked, the next verification
   // removes.
   // verifies: LLR-8w2z64
   #[tokio::test]
   async fn the_secrets_closure_reads_the_keychain_only_to_sign_and_a_refusal_is_verified_keychain() {
       let (_guard, keychain) = fresh_keychain();
       let tag = "settle-secrets";
       let admin = founded(tag).await;
       let bob = invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       admit(&admin, &bob, vec![]).await;
       settle_deliver_by_node(&admin, &bob);
       let adopted = bob.io.verify_all().await;
       assert!(matches!(adopted.as_slice(), [(_, Verified::Adopted { .. })]), "{adopted:?}");

       let calls = keychain.calls();
       let in_step = bob.io.verify_all().await;
       assert!(matches!(in_step.as_slice(), [(_, Verified::InStep { .. })]), "{in_step:?}");
       assert_eq!(keychain.calls(), calls, "no keychain read without a removal");

       let member = member_id_of(&admin, bob.device).await;
       admin.io.propose_revocation(admin.org, member).await.unwrap();
       admin.io.propose_updated_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
       common::journey::write_and_adopt(&admin).await;
       settle_deliver_by_node(&admin, &bob);
       let files = store_bytes(tag, "b");

       keychain.refuse_as(Some(Refusal::Locked));
       let refused = bob.io.verify_all().await;
       keychain.refuse_as(None);
       assert!(matches!(refused.as_slice(), [(_, Verified::Keychain { .. })]), "{refused:?}");
       assert_eq!(store_bytes(tag, "b"), files, "nothing written");

       let calls = keychain.calls();
       let removed = bob.io.verify_all().await;
       assert!(matches!(removed.as_slice(), [(_, Verified::Removed { .. })]), "{removed:?}");
       assert_eq!(keychain.calls(), calls + 1, "one read: the Persona's item, to sign");
   }

   /// `admin`'s messages for its current epoch addressed to `joining`'s
   /// Device, handed to `joining`'s org-node check as the receive step would.
   fn settle_deliver_by_node(admin: &Admin, joining: &common::journey::Joining) {
       let bodies: Vec<Vec<u8>> = admin
           .io
           .node_for_test()
           .messages_for_current_epoch(&admin.device)
           .unwrap()
           .into_iter()
           .filter(|message| message.recipient == joining.device)
           .map(|message| message.body)
           .collect();
       assert!(!bodies.is_empty(), "a message for the joining Device");
       let mut node = joining.io.node_for_test();
       for body in bodies {
           node.check_received(&mut rand::rngs::OsRng, &joining.device, admin.device, &body).unwrap();
       }
   }
   ```

   `org-io/tests/chain_read_rule.rs` (append): a scan of `org-io/src`.
   ```rust
   /// Every `.rs` file under `org-io/src`, relative path and code lines (line
   /// comments dropped).
   fn org_io_code() -> Vec<(String, Vec<String>)> {
       fn walk(dir: &std::path::Path, root: &std::path::Path, out: &mut Vec<(String, Vec<String>)>) {
           for entry in std::fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap() {
               let path = entry.unwrap().path();
               if path.is_dir() {
                   walk(&path, root, out);
               } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "rs") {
                   let relative = path.strip_prefix(root).unwrap().to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
                   let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
                   let code = text.lines().map(|line| line.split("//").next().unwrap_or("").to_string()).collect();
                   out.push((relative, code));
               }
           }
       }
       let root = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("src");
       let mut files = vec![];
       walk(&root, &root, &mut files);
       files
   }

   // The chain's state is read only by verification (and the operator's
   // preflight): `read_state` and `finalised_block` are called only in
   // `verify.rs` and `preflight.rs` (their seam, `chain_read.rs`, and the
   // test substitute define them), and the receive, send, write, proposal,
   // invitation, Person, Persona and acknowledgement files name no
   // `StateReader` at all.
   // verifies: LLR-k3zmqb
   #[test]
   fn the_state_reader_is_named_only_in_verify_and_preflight() {
       let callers = ["verify.rs", "preflight.rs"];
       let defining = ["chain_read.rs", "connect.rs", "test_support.rs"];
       let silent = ["receiver.rs", "send.rs", "write.rs", "propose.rs", "exchange.rs", "person.rs", "persona.rs", "acknowledge.rs"];
       let mut found = vec![];
       let mut verify_calls = 0;
       for (file, code) in org_io_code() {
           for (index, line) in code.iter().enumerate() {
               let calls = line.contains(".read_state(") || line.contains(".finalised_block(");
               if calls && file == "verify.rs" {
                   verify_calls += 1;
               }
               if calls && !callers.contains(&file.as_str()) && !defining.contains(&file.as_str()) {
                   found.push(format!("{file}:{}: reads the chain: {}", index + 1, line.trim()));
               }
               if line.contains("StateReader") && silent.contains(&file.as_str()) {
                   found.push(format!("{file}:{}: names the state reader: {}", index + 1, line.trim()));
               }
           }
       }
       assert!(verify_calls >= 2, "the scan finds verification's two reads ({verify_calls})");
       assert!(found.is_empty(), "the chain read outside verification:\n{}", found.join("\n"));
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   /// What verification found of a chain write whose outcome was unknown
   /// (LLR-zey4mg). Public data only.
   #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub enum WriteOutcome {
       /// The verification adopted that provisional organisation.
       Adopted,
       /// Past its window, with the chain still at the epoch it was based on:
       /// it can no longer execute.
       NotExecuted,
       /// The chain is at or past the epoch it would have made, on another
       /// root.
       Deprecated,
       /// Nothing settles it yet; it stays recorded.
       StillUnknown,
   }
   ```
   New variant of `Verified` (appended to T35's list):
   ```rust
       /// `outcome`, and what it settled of the target's unknown write
       /// (LLR-zey4mg); returned only when one was recorded.
       Settled { outcome: Box<Verified>, write: WriteOutcome },
   ```
   The read verification made, kept beside the outcome (new private type), and the settlement rule (new private
   function):
   ```rust
   /// What one verification read of the chain, when both reads answered.
   #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
   pub(crate) struct ChainRead {
       pub(crate) finalised_block: u64,
       pub(crate) state: Option<org_node::OrgState>,
   }

   /// The settlement of `unknown` given the read and the outcome
   /// (LLR-zey4mg): adopted when the chain holds exactly that write and the
   /// outcome adopted it (or found it already in step); deprecated when the
   /// chain is at or past the write's epoch on another root; not executed
   /// only for an update past its window with the chain at the base epoch;
   /// otherwise, and on a failed read, still unknown. A founding has no window.
   pub(crate) fn settle(unknown: &UnknownWrite, read: Option<&ChainRead>, outcome: &Verified) -> WriteOutcome {
       let Some(ChainRead { finalised_block, state: Some(state) }) = read else { return WriteOutcome::StillUnknown };
       let at_its_epoch = state.epoch == unknown.epoch;
       let its_identity = state.root_hash == unknown.root && state.org_pub_key == unknown.org_pub_key;
       if at_its_epoch && its_identity && matches!(outcome, Verified::Adopted { .. } | Verified::InStep { .. }) {
           return WriteOutcome::Adopted;
       }
       if state.epoch.get() >= unknown.epoch.get() && !(at_its_epoch && its_identity) {
           return WriteOutcome::Deprecated;
       }
       match unknown.last_valid_block {
           Some(last_valid) if *finalised_block > last_valid && state.epoch.get() + 1 == unknown.epoch.get() => {
               WriteOutcome::NotExecuted
           }
           _ => WriteOutcome::StillUnknown,
       }
   }
   ```
   `verify_organisation` becomes the composition below. T36's body moves, unchanged in its judgement and store writes,
   into the private `verify_once(&self, target: HeldTarget) -> (Verified, Option<ChainRead>)`, whose only edit is that it
   returns, beside the outcome, `Some(ChainRead { finalised_block, state })` once both reads answered (`None` on a failed
   read, a refused parse, `NoProxyYet` and `ClockBeforeEpoch`); every other path of T36 is kept as written.
   ```rust
   impl OrgIo {
       /// Verify `target` (LLR-t2pve7), then settle its unknown write, if one
       /// is recorded, against the same read (LLR-zey4mg); the settlement
       /// changes no store and is reported with the outcome.
       pub async fn verify_organisation(&self, target: HeldTarget) -> Verified {
           let (outcome, read) = self.verify_once(target).await;
           let mut publish = self.publish.lock().await;
           publish.verifications.insert(target, outcome.clone());
           let Some(unknown) = publish.unknown_write(&target) else { return outcome };
           let write = settle(&unknown, read.as_ref(), &outcome);
           if write != WriteOutcome::StillUnknown {
               publish.clear_unknown_write(&target);
           }
           Verified::Settled { outcome: Box::new(outcome), write }
       }
   }
   ```
   (The `verifications.insert` line is T35's keeping of the last outcome for `verification(target)`, moved here out of
   the body that became `verify_once`; `verification(target)` returns the plain outcome, never `Settled`.) `Verified`
   is `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` (T35) and its `Settled` arm is added to any `match` T35/T36 wrote over it (the
   app's matches come in T51/T54).

   The secrets closure (LLR-8w2z64) is the one T35's body passes to org-node's `verify`, now inside `verify_once`; its
   error mapping returns the read beside the outcome:
   ```rust
   let mut refused: Option<KeychainError> = None;
   let keychain = &self.local.keychain;
   let judged = {
       let mut rng = self.local.rng.lock();
       service.verify(&mut *rng, &device_key, state, VerificationTime(now), |device_keys| {
           keychain.for_signing_noting_refusal(device_keys, &mut refused)
       })
   };
   let (judged, change) = match judged {
       Ok(judged) => judged,
       Err(OrgNodeError::OrgNotOnChain) => return (Verified::Unverified { reason: UnverifiedReason::OrgNotOnChain }, read),
       Err(OrgNodeError::FoundingNotWritten) => return (Verified::Unverified { reason: UnverifiedReason::FoundingNotWritten }, read),
       Err(error @ OrgNodeError::DeviceSecretNotSupplied { .. }) => {
           return match refused {
               Some(error) => (Verified::Keychain { error }, read),
               None => (Verified::Refused { reason: error.to_string() }, read),
           }
       }
       Err(error) => return (Verified::Refused { reason: error.to_string() }, read),
   };
   ```
   (`now` is the handle clock's reading, `state` the parsed `Option<OrgState>`, `read` the `Some(ChainRead { .. })` the
   two reads gave — all T35's.)

   `org-io/tests/common/journey.rs` (append): receivers that stand for a Member's Device without a handle — an endpoint

   ```rust
   use std::sync::Arc;

   use org_io::transport::{BindPlan, OrgEndpoint, Verdict};
   use tokio::sync::mpsc;

   /// The addresses `endpoint` holds, as the text org-io keeps for a Device
   /// key: `<64 lower-case hex endpoint id>@<socket address>`, one per bound
   /// socket.
   pub fn kept_addresses(endpoint: &OrgEndpoint) -> Vec<String> {
       let id = hex::encode(endpoint.device_key().as_bytes());
       endpoint.bound_sockets().into_iter().map(|socket| format!("{id}@{socket}")).collect()
   }

   /// Bodies a receiver got, each with the sender its handshake authenticated.
   pub type Arrivals = mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<(DevicePublicKey, Vec<u8>)>;

   /// An endpoint of `device` (its keychain item must exist) bound for `plan`,
   /// answering the n-th body with `verdicts[n]` — `None` drops the reply, so
   /// nothing is written back — and every later body with `Accepted`. Its kept
   /// addresses, its arrivals, and the endpoint (held open by its task too).
   pub async fn answering(device: DevicePublicKey, plan: BindPlan, verdicts: Vec<Option<Verdict>>) -> (Vec<String>, Arrivals, Arc<OrgEndpoint>) {
       let endpoint = Arc::new(OrgEndpoint::bind_from_keychain(&device, plan).await.unwrap());
       let addresses = kept_addresses(&endpoint);
       let (forward, arrivals) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
       let serving = endpoint.clone();
       tokio::spawn(async move {
           let mut verdicts = verdicts.into_iter();
           while let Ok((sender, body, reply)) = serving.recv_answerable().await {
               let _ = forward.send((sender, body));
               match verdicts.next().unwrap_or(Some(Verdict::Accepted)) {
                   Some(verdict) => {
                       tokio::spawn(reply.answer(verdict));
                   }
                   None => drop(reply),
               }
           }
       });
       (addresses, arrivals, endpoint)
   }

   /// Addresses of `device` at which nothing listens: an endpoint bound,
   /// read and closed.
   pub async fn dead_addresses(device: DevicePublicKey) -> Vec<String> {
       let endpoint = OrgEndpoint::bind_from_keychain(&device, BindPlan::Loopback).await.unwrap();
       let addresses = kept_addresses(&endpoint);
       endpoint.inner().close().await;
       addresses
   }

   /// The next body `arrivals` holds within `limit`, or `None`.
   pub async fn next_arrival(arrivals: &mut Arrivals, limit: std::time::Duration) -> Option<(DevicePublicKey, Vec<u8>)> {
       tokio::time::timeout(limit, arrivals.recv()).await.ok().flatten()
   }

   /// `admin` revokes the Member whose Device is `device`, and writes and
   /// adopts the epoch that removes it.
   pub async fn revoke(admin: &Admin, device: DevicePublicKey) {
       let member = member_id_of(admin, device).await;
       admin.io.propose_revocation(admin.org, member).await.unwrap();
       admin.io.propose_updated_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
       write_and_adopt(admin).await;
   }

   /// `admin`'s current epoch's messages, as org-node gives them: recipient
   /// and body, in org-node's order.
   pub fn current_messages(admin: &Admin) -> Vec<(DevicePublicKey, Vec<u8>)> {
       let node = admin.io.node_for_test();
       node.messages_for_current_epoch(&admin.device).unwrap().into_iter().map(|message| (message.recipient, message.body)).collect()
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   use std::time::Duration;

   use iroh::address_lookup::MemoryLookup;
   use org_io::send::{Delivery, SendError, SendRefused};
   use org_io::test_support::{FakeChain, MemoryKeychain};
   use org_io::transport::{BindPlan, Verdict};
   use org_io::{HeldTarget, Verified, WriteReport};
   use org_node::{Epoch, OrgId};

   use common::handles::{handle, keep_device_seed, store_bytes, NET};
   use common::journey;

   /// How long a receiver waits before it concludes nothing was sent to it.
   const QUIET: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);

   // Normal: two Members, each at its own kept addresses. One call sends
   // org-node's messages for the adopted epoch, in org-node's order, each body
   // to its recipient from the Admin's Device; every recipient is reported
   // Delivered; no store byte changes; a second call sends the same bodies.
   // verifies: LLR-pxqdy4
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn send_organisation_sends_org_nodes_messages_in_order_to_every_recipient_and_writes_no_store() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "send-in-order";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let (bob_at, mut bob_gets, _bob) = journey::answering(bob.device, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &bob, bob_at).await;
       let carol = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "c", "carol").await;
       let (carol_at, mut carol_gets, _carol) = journey::answering(carol.device, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &carol, carol_at).await;
       let expected = journey::current_messages(&admin);
       let files = store_bytes(tag, "a");

       for round in 0..2 {
           let report = admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
           let order: Vec<_> = report.per_device.iter().map(|(device, _)| *device).collect();
           assert_eq!(order, expected.iter().map(|(device, _)| *device).collect::<Vec<_>>(), "org-node's order");
           assert!(report.per_device.iter().all(|(_, sent)| matches!(sent, Delivery::Delivered)), "{report:?}");
           for (recipient, body) in &expected {
               let arrivals = if *recipient == bob.device { &mut bob_gets } else { &mut carol_gets };
               let (from, got) = journey::next_arrival(arrivals, NET).await.unwrap();
               assert_eq!((from, &got), (admin.device, body), "round {round}: org-node's body, from the Admin's Device");
           }
       }
       assert_eq!(store_bytes(tag, "a"), files, "the send writes no store");
   }

   // Abnormal, per recipient, in one Loopback send: no address kept (Bob), only
   // an address whose identity is another Device (Carol's), and a proper one
   // (Dave's). The first two are refused with nothing sent to them; Dave is
   // still sent to.
   // verifies: LLR-34tfm8
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn loopback_refuses_no_address_and_no_address_of_the_recipient_per_recipient() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "send-loopback-refusals";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &bob, vec![]).await;
       let rogue = keep_device_seed([0x5c; 32]);
       let (rogue_at, mut rogue_gets, _rogue) = journey::answering(rogue, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       let carol = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "c", "carol").await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &carol, rogue_at).await;
       let dave = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "d", "dave").await;
       let (dave_at, mut dave_gets, _dave) = journey::answering(dave.device, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &dave, dave_at).await;

       let report = admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
       let outcome = |device| &report.per_device.iter().find(|(recipient, _)| *recipient == device).unwrap().1;
       assert!(matches!(outcome(bob.device), Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::NoLoopbackAddress }), "{report:?}");
       assert!(matches!(outcome(carol.device), Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::AddressNotARecipient }), "{report:?}");
       assert!(matches!(outcome(dave.device), Delivery::Delivered), "{report:?}");
       assert!(journey::next_arrival(&mut dave_gets, NET).await.is_some());
       assert!(journey::next_arrival(&mut rogue_gets, QUIET).await.is_none(), "nothing reaches another Device's address");
   }

   // Networked (the in-process relay and address lookup): a recipient whose
   // kept addresses are none is dialled by its Device key and reached; one
   // whose kept addresses are its own is reached with them as the hint.
   // verifies: LLR-34tfm8
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn networked_dials_the_recipients_key_with_its_kept_addresses_as_a_hint() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let (relay_map, _relay_url, _relay_server) = iroh::test_utils::run_relay_server().await.unwrap();
       let lookup = MemoryLookup::new();
       let plan = BindPlan::Relay(relay_map, lookup.clone());
       let tag = "send-networked";
       let chain = FakeChain::new();
       let io = handle(tag, "a", &chain).with_bind_plan_for_test(plan.clone());
       let device = journey::propose_founding(&io, "alice").await;
       assert!(matches!(io.write_organisation_to_chain(HeldTarget::Founding(device)).await.unwrap(), WriteReport::Included { .. }));
       assert!(matches!(io.verify_organisation(HeldTarget::Founding(device)).await, Verified::Adopted { .. }));
       let org = io.organisations().await[0].org_id;
       let admin = journey::Admin { io, chain, org, device };
       let pid = admin.io.personas().await[0].persona_id.clone();
       let sender = admin.io.endpoint_for_test(&pid).await.unwrap();
       tokio::time::timeout(NET, sender.online()).await.unwrap();
       lookup.add_endpoint_info(sender.inner().addr());

       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let (_, mut bob_gets, bob_end) = journey::answering(bob.device, plan.clone(), vec![]).await;
       tokio::time::timeout(NET, bob_end.online()).await.unwrap();
       lookup.add_endpoint_info(bob_end.inner().addr());
       journey::admit(&admin, &bob, vec![]).await;
       let carol = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "c", "carol").await;
       let (carol_at, mut carol_gets, carol_end) = journey::answering(carol.device, plan.clone(), vec![]).await;
       tokio::time::timeout(NET, carol_end.online()).await.unwrap();
       lookup.add_endpoint_info(carol_end.inner().addr());
       journey::admit(&admin, &carol, carol_at).await;

       let report = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(120), admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org)).await.unwrap().unwrap();
       assert!(report.per_device.iter().all(|(_, sent)| matches!(sent, Delivery::Delivered)), "{report:?}");
       assert_eq!(journey::next_arrival(&mut bob_gets, NET).await.unwrap().0, admin.device, "no address kept: dialled by key");
       assert_eq!(journey::next_arrival(&mut carol_gets, NET).await.unwrap().0, admin.device, "kept addresses as the hint");
   }

   // Every body comes from the endpoint of the Persona holding the
   // Organisation; when that endpoint cannot be had (closed, and its keychain
   // item locked, so it cannot be bound again) every recipient reports
   // `SenderEndpoint` and nothing is sent.
   // verifies: LLR-hx5c2y
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn every_send_is_from_the_sending_personas_endpoint() {
       let (_guard, keychain) = common::handles::fresh_keychain();
       let tag = "send-from-persona";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let (bob_at, mut bob_gets, _bob) = journey::answering(bob.device, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &bob, bob_at).await;

       assert_eq!(journey::next_arrival(&mut bob_gets, NET).await.unwrap().0, admin.device, "the Admin Persona's Device");

       let pid = admin.io.personas().await[0].persona_id.clone();
       admin.io.endpoint_for_test(&pid).await.unwrap().inner().close().await;

       keychain.refuse_as(None);

           "{report:?}"

   // Abnormal: an Organisation no Persona here holds is `NotHeld`; boundary: a

   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn an_organisation_no_persona_holds_is_not_held_and_no_recipient_is_an_empty_report() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();

   // Each verdict byte the recipient writes is reported as itself; silence (the
   // reply dropped) is `NotDelivered`; a byte outside the four is no verdict.
   // verifies: LLR-fwz3tb
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn the_verdict_byte_maps_to_delivered_refused_already_received_invite_used_or_not_delivered() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "send-verdicts";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let script = vec![
           Some(Verdict::Accepted),
           Some(Verdict::Refused),
           Some(Verdict::AlreadyReceived),
           Some(Verdict::InviteUsedByAnotherDevice),
           None,
       ];
       let (bob_at, _bob_gets, _bob) = journey::answering(bob.device, BindPlan::Loopback, script).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &bob, bob_at).await;
       let mut seen = vec![];
       for _ in 0..5 {
           let report = admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
           seen.push(format!("{:?}", report.per_device[0].1));
       }
       assert!(seen[0].starts_with("Delivered"), "{seen:?}");
       assert!(seen[1].starts_with("Refused"), "{seen:?}");
       assert!(seen[2].starts_with("AlreadyReceived"), "{seen:?}");
       assert!(seen[3].starts_with("InviteUsedByAnotherDevice"), "{seen:?}");
       assert!(seen[4].starts_with("NotDelivered"), "{seen:?}");
       for byte in 0x00..=0x03u8 {
           assert_eq!(Verdict::from_byte(byte).map(Verdict::as_byte), Some(byte));
       }
       assert_eq!(Verdict::from_byte(0x07), None, "any other byte is no verdict");
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   use org_io::send::Delivery;
   use org_io::transport::BindPlan;

   // Networked semantics aside (Loopback here): A revokes Bob from {Alice, Bob,
   // Carol} and sends the adopted epoch. The report names Bob and Carol, never
   // A's own Device; Carol, still listed, receives the Organisation's
   // information and Bob, removed, the revocation — each from A's Device.
   // verifies: REQ-u894ty
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn each_recipient_receives_the_body_org_node_built_for_the_adopted_epoch() {
       org_io::test_support::MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "expect-per-recipient";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let (bob_at, mut bob_gets, _bob) = journey::answering(bob.device, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &bob, bob_at).await;
       let carol = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "c", "carol").await;
       let (carol_at, mut carol_gets, _carol) = journey::answering(carol.device, BindPlan::Loopback, vec![]).await;
       journey::admit(&admin, &carol, carol_at).await;
       journey::revoke(&admin, bob.device).await;

       let report = admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();
       let mut reported: Vec<_> = report.per_device.iter().map(|(device, _)| *device.as_bytes()).collect();
       reported.sort();
       let mut expected = vec![*bob.device.as_bytes(), *carol.device.as_bytes()];
       expected.sort();
       assert_eq!(reported, expected, "Bob and Carol, never the sender's own Device");
       assert!(report.per_device.iter().all(|(_, sent)| matches!(sent, Delivery::Delivered)), "{report:?}");
       let (from, to_carol) = journey::next_arrival(&mut carol_gets, NET).await.unwrap();
       assert_eq!(from, admin.device);
       assert!(matches!(decode_message(&to_carol).unwrap(), WireMessage::OrgInformation { .. }), "Carol gets the information");
       let (from, to_bob) = journey::next_arrival(&mut bob_gets, NET).await.unwrap();
       assert_eq!(from, admin.device);
       assert!(matches!(decode_message(&to_bob).unwrap(), WireMessage::Revocation(_)), "Bob gets the revocation");
   }

       let report = admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org).await.unwrap();

       let (from, to_bob) = journey::next_arrival(&mut bob_gets, NET).await.unwrap();
   ```

   ```rust
   /// The one byte the receive side writes back on an inbound stream, after
   /// the body (LLR-hhgdk7): whether the message was acted on, and for an
   /// admission request, which of org-node's verdicts it got.
   #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
   pub enum Verdict {
       /// Acted on, and its store change (if any) written.
       Accepted,
       /// Refused, or failed, at any step.
       Refused,
       /// An admission request this store already keeps from the sender.
       AlreadyReceived,
       /// An admission request for an invite another Device already used.
       InviteUsedByAnotherDevice,
   }

   impl Verdict {
       /// The byte on the stream: `0x00` accepted, `0x01` refused, `0x02`
       /// already received, `0x03` invite used by another Device.
       pub fn as_byte(self) -> u8 {
           match self {
               Self::Accepted => 0x00,
               Self::Refused => 0x01,
               Self::AlreadyReceived => 0x02,
               Self::InviteUsedByAnotherDevice => 0x03,
           }
       }

       /// The verdict a byte read back is, or `None` for any other byte
       /// (LLR-fwz3tb).
       pub fn from_byte(byte: u8) -> Option<Self> {
           match byte {
               0x00 => Some(Self::Accepted),
               0x01 => Some(Self::Refused),
               0x02 => Some(Self::AlreadyReceived),
               0x03 => Some(Self::InviteUsedByAnotherDevice),
               _ => None,
           }
       }
   }

   /// How long a send waits for the verdict byte after finishing its stream
   /// (LLR-fwz3tb).
   pub const VERDICT_TIME_LIMIT: std::time::Duration = std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);

   /// The endpoint identity and socket a kept address names — the form
   /// `OrgEndpoint::addresses` emits (T31): the endpoint identity as 64
   /// lower-case hex, `@`, the socket address — or `None` for text of any
   /// other form (the disk and the wire are edges: parsed).
   pub(crate) fn parse_kept_address(text: &str) -> Option<([u8; 32], std::net::SocketAddr)> {
       let (id, socket) = text.split_once('@')?;
       if id.len() != 64 || !id.chars().all(|character| character.is_ascii_digit() || ('a'..='f').contains(&character)) {
           return None;
       }
       let id: [u8; 32] = hex::decode(id).ok()?.try_into().ok()?;
       Some((id, socket.parse().ok()?))
   }
   ```
   The re-export line gains `VERDICT_TIME_LIMIT`'s use in `endpoint.rs` through `super::VERDICT_TIME_LIMIT`.

   `org-io/src/transport/endpoint.rs` (PLAN DELTA): the dial that reads the verdict (new method of `OrgEndpoint`).
   ```rust
       /// Dial `recipient` — by the endpoint identity equal to its Device key,
       /// at `sockets` (Loopback: only those; Networked: a hint ahead of
       /// discovery) — send one framed body, finish the stream, and read back
       /// what the receiver writes, at most two bytes, within
       /// `VERDICT_TIME_LIMIT` (LLR-fwz3tb): an empty vector for silence or a
       /// timeout. The connection is closed after the read.
       pub async fn send_for_verdict(
           &self,
           recipient: &DevicePublicKey,
           sockets: &[std::net::SocketAddr],
           body: &[u8],
       ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, TransportError> {
           let stream_error = |error: &dyn std::fmt::Display| TransportError::Stream(error.to_string());
           let id = EndpointId::from_bytes(recipient.as_bytes()).map_err(|_| TransportError::Malformed)?;
           let addr = EndpointAddr::from_parts(id, sockets.iter().copied().map(iroh::TransportAddr::Ip));
           let framed = frame_body(body)?;
           let conn = self.inner.connect(addr, ALPN).await.map_err(|error| TransportError::Connect(error.to_string()))?;
           let (mut send, mut recv) = conn.open_bi().await.map_err(|error| stream_error(&error))?;
           send.write_all(&framed).await.map_err(|error| stream_error(&error))?;
           send.finish().map_err(|error| stream_error(&error))?;
           let read = tokio::time::timeout(super::VERDICT_TIME_LIMIT, recv.read_to_end(2)).await;
           conn.close(0u32.into(), b"done");
           match read {
               Err(_elapsed) => Ok(Vec::new()),
               Ok(read) => read.map_err(|error| stream_error(&error)),
           }
       }
   ```

   `org-io/src/send.rs`: replaced whole (no address parameter; the addresses kept per Device key).
   ```rust
   //! The send path (SDD-2bzgtp): every message org-io sends goes from the
   //! sending Persona's endpoint, on a new connection, to a Device key, at the
   //! endpoint addresses org-node keeps for that key; one recipient after
   //! another, each reported with the verdict byte it wrote back
   //! (LLR-pxqdy4, LLR-34tfm8, LLR-hx5c2y, LLR-fwz3tb). A send writes no store
   //! and reads no chain.

   use std::net::SocketAddr;
   use std::sync::Arc;

   use org_node::service::OrgService;
   use org_node::{DevicePublicKey, OrgId, OrgNodeError};

   use crate::endpoints::Endpoints;
   use crate::transport::{parse_kept_address, OrgEndpoint, TransportError, TransportMode, Verdict};
   use crate::OrgIo;

   /// What became of one recipient's message (LLR-fwz3tb). Public data only.
   #[derive(Debug)]
   pub enum Delivery {
       /// `0x00`.
       Delivered,
       /// `0x01`.
       Refused,
       /// `0x02`.
       AlreadyReceived,
       /// `0x03`.
       InviteUsedByAnotherDevice,
       /// Not sent, or no verdict came back.
       NotDelivered { reason: SendError },
   }

   /// What a request of admission reports: the one Device's outcome.
   pub type AdmissionOutcome = Delivery;

   /// Each recipient's outcome, in org-node's order: Device public keys and
   /// typed outcomes, public data only.
   #[derive(Debug, Default)]
   pub struct SendReport {
       pub per_device: Vec<(DevicePublicKey, Delivery)>,
   }

   impl SendReport {
       /// Each recipient not `Delivered`, as `<DevicePublicKey hex>: <outcome>`,
       /// joined by `; `; `None` when every one was delivered.
       pub fn failure_summary(&self) -> Option<String> {
           let failed: Vec<String> = self
               .per_device
               .iter()
               .filter(|(_, delivery)| !matches!(delivery, Delivery::Delivered))
               .map(|(device_key, delivery)| format!("{}: {delivery:?}", hex::encode(device_key.as_bytes())))
               .collect();
           if failed.is_empty() { None } else { Some(failed.join("; ")) }
       }
   }

   /// Why one recipient's message was not delivered.
   #[derive(Debug)]
   pub enum SendError {
       /// Loopback mode and no address kept for the recipient.
       NoLoopbackAddress,
       /// Loopback mode and no kept address's identity is the recipient's key.
       AddressNotARecipient,
       /// Loopback mode and no Invite address's identity is the issuer's key.
       AddressNotTheIssuer,
       /// No address may be dialled (the acknowledgement delivery).
       NoAddress,
       /// The sending Persona's endpoint could not be had; nothing was sent.
       SenderEndpoint(String),
       /// The stream ended, or the time limit passed, with no byte written back.
       NoVerdict,
       /// A byte that is none of the four verdicts.
       UnknownVerdict(u8),
       /// The dial or the stream failed.
       Transport(TransportError),
   }

   impl std::fmt::Display for SendError {
       fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
           match self {
               Self::NoLoopbackAddress => write!(formatter, "Loopback: no address kept for the recipient; nothing sent"),
               Self::AddressNotARecipient => write!(formatter, "Loopback: no kept address is the recipient's; nothing sent"),
               Self::AddressNotTheIssuer => write!(formatter, "Loopback: no Invite address is the issuer's; nothing sent"),
               Self::NoAddress => write!(formatter, "no address may be dialled"),
               Self::SenderEndpoint(reason) => write!(formatter, "the sender's endpoint: {reason}"),
               Self::NoVerdict => write!(formatter, "no verdict within the time limit"),
               Self::UnknownVerdict(byte) => write!(formatter, "verdict byte 0x{byte:02x} is none of the four"),
               Self::Transport(error) => write!(formatter, "{error}"),
           }
       }
   }

   impl std::error::Error for SendError {}

   /// Why a whole send was refused before anything was sent.
   #[derive(Debug)]
   pub enum SendRefused {
       /// No Persona here holds the Organisation (LLR-zrgj8z).
       NotHeld { org_id: OrgId },
       /// The sending Persona's endpoint could not be bound (a request's).
       Bind(TransportError),
       /// org-node refused to give the messages.
       Node(OrgNodeError),
   }

   impl std::fmt::Display for SendRefused {
       fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
           match self {
               Self::NotHeld { org_id } => write!(formatter, "no Persona here holds Organisation {}", hex::encode(org_id.as_bytes())),
               Self::Bind(error) => write!(formatter, "the sender's endpoint could not be bound: {error}"),
               Self::Node(error) => write!(formatter, "{error}"),
           }
       }
   }

   impl std::error::Error for SendRefused {}

   /// One message to send, with the addresses kept for its recipient.
   pub(crate) struct Outgoing {
       pub(crate) recipient: DevicePublicKey,
       pub(crate) body: Vec<u8>,
       pub(crate) addresses: Option<Vec<String>>,
   }

   /// The Persona holding `org_id` (a current record, a founding or a
   /// provisional Member), by its Device key.
   pub(crate) fn holder_of(service: &OrgService, org_id: OrgId) -> Option<DevicePublicKey> {
       service.list_personas().into_iter().find(|persona| persona.org_id == Some(org_id)).map(|persona| persona.device_key)
   }

   /// The addresses org-node keeps for `peer` in `device_key`'s store, as text.
   pub(crate) fn kept_for(service: &OrgService, device_key: &DevicePublicKey, peer: DevicePublicKey) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
       service.addresses_for(device_key, peer).ok().flatten().map(|addresses| addresses.as_slice().to_vec())
   }

   /// The sockets to dial `recipient` at (LLR-34tfm8): in Networked mode
   /// every parsed kept address, as a hint (none is fine: discovery finds the
   /// key); in Loopback mode those whose identity is the recipient's key,
   /// refusing with `NoLoopbackAddress` when none is kept and
   /// `AddressNotARecipient` when none is the recipient's. Pure.
   pub(crate) fn sockets_for(mode: TransportMode, recipient: &DevicePublicKey, addresses: Option<&[String]>) -> Result<Vec<SocketAddr>, SendError> {
       let addresses = addresses.unwrap_or(&[]);
       let parsed = addresses.iter().filter_map(|text| parse_kept_address(text));
       match mode {
           TransportMode::Networked => Ok(parsed.map(|(_, socket)| socket).collect()),
           TransportMode::Loopback => {
               if addresses.is_empty() {
                   return Err(SendError::NoLoopbackAddress);
               }
               let own: Vec<SocketAddr> = parsed.filter(|(id, _)| id == recipient.as_bytes()).map(|(_, socket)| socket).collect();
               if own.is_empty() { Err(SendError::AddressNotARecipient) } else { Ok(own) }
           }
       }
   }

   /// What a dial's read-back is (LLR-fwz3tb).
   pub(crate) fn delivery_of(read: Result<Vec<u8>, TransportError>) -> Delivery {
       match read {
           Err(error) => Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::Transport(error) },
           Ok(bytes) => match bytes.as_slice() {
               [] => Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::NoVerdict },
               [byte] => match Verdict::from_byte(*byte) {
                   Some(Verdict::Accepted) => Delivery::Delivered,
                   Some(Verdict::Refused) => Delivery::Refused,
                   Some(Verdict::AlreadyReceived) => Delivery::AlreadyReceived,
                   Some(Verdict::InviteUsedByAnotherDevice) => Delivery::InviteUsedByAnotherDevice,
                   None => Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::UnknownVerdict(*byte) },
               },
               [byte, ..] => Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::UnknownVerdict(*byte) },
           },
       }
   }

   /// Send `body` to `recipient` at `sockets` from `endpoint`, and read its verdict.
   pub(crate) async fn send_one(endpoint: &OrgEndpoint, recipient: &DevicePublicKey, sockets: &[SocketAddr], body: &[u8]) -> Delivery {
       delivery_of(endpoint.send_for_verdict(recipient, sockets, body).await)
   }

   /// Send every message of `outgoing`, in order, from `sender`'s endpoint
   /// (LLR-hx5c2y), each recipient judged on its own addresses (LLR-34tfm8);
   /// every recipient is attempted whatever happened to the others. When the
   /// endpoint cannot be had, every recipient reports `SenderEndpoint`.
   pub(crate) async fn send_all(endpoints: &Endpoints, sender: DevicePublicKey, outgoing: Vec<Outgoing>) -> SendReport {
       if outgoing.is_empty() {
           return SendReport::default();
       }
       let endpoint: Result<Arc<OrgEndpoint>, String> = endpoints.endpoint(&sender).await.map_err(|error| error.to_string());
       let mode = endpoints.transport_mode();
       let mut per_device = Vec::with_capacity(outgoing.len());
       for Outgoing { recipient, body, addresses } in outgoing {
           let delivery = match (&endpoint, sockets_for(mode, &recipient, addresses.as_deref())) {
               (Err(reason), _) => Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::SenderEndpoint(reason.clone()) },
               (Ok(_), Err(refused)) => Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: refused },
               (Ok(endpoint), Ok(sockets)) => send_one(endpoint, &recipient, &sockets, &body).await,
           };
           per_device.push((recipient, delivery));
       }
       SendReport { per_device }
   }

   impl OrgIo {
       /// Send the adopted current epoch of `org_id` (LLR-pxqdy4): under the
       /// node's lock, org-node's messages for it and the addresses kept for
       /// each recipient; with the lock released, each sent in org-node's
       /// order. No store write, no later send of its own; a repeated call
       /// sends the same messages.
       pub async fn send_organisation(&self, org_id: OrgId) -> Result<SendReport, SendRefused> {
           let (sender, outgoing) = {
               let service = self.service.lock().await;
               let sender = holder_of(&service, org_id).ok_or(SendRefused::NotHeld { org_id })?;
               let messages = service.messages_for_current_epoch(&sender).map_err(|error| match error {
                   OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { .. } => SendRefused::NotHeld { org_id },
                   other => SendRefused::Node(other),
               })?;
               let outgoing: Vec<Outgoing> = messages
                   .into_iter()
                   .map(|message| {
                       let addresses = kept_for(&service, &sender, message.recipient);
                       Outgoing { recipient: message.recipient, body: message.body, addresses }
                   })
                   .collect();
               (sender, outgoing)
           };
           Ok(send_all(&self.local.endpoints, sender, outgoing).await)
       }
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   #![allow(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used, clippy::panic)]
   //! The requests a Device sends (SDD-dhh3pw; T39 of
   //! docs/plans/2026-10-21-org-io-domain-api.md): the admission request to
   //! the Invite's issuer at the Invite's addresses, and the organisation

   use std::sync::Arc;
   use std::time::Duration;

   use org_io::send::{Delivery, SendError, SendRefused};
   use org_io::test_support::{FakeChain, MemoryKeychain};
   use org_io::transport::{BindPlan, OrgEndpoint, Verdict};

   /// The Admin's endpoint, as `issue_invite` bound it.
   async fn issuer_endpoint(admin: &journey::Admin) -> Arc<OrgEndpoint> {
       let pid = admin.io.personas().await[0].persona_id.clone();
       admin.io.endpoint_for_test(&pid).await.unwrap()
   }

   /// Accept one body on `endpoint` and answer it with `verdict` (`None`
   /// writes nothing); the authenticated sender and the body.
   async fn answer_one(endpoint: &OrgEndpoint, verdict: Option<Verdict>) -> (DevicePublicKey, Vec<u8>) {
       let (sender, body, reply) = tokio::time::timeout(NET, endpoint.recv_answerable()).await.unwrap().unwrap();
       if let Some(verdict) = verdict {
           reply.answer(verdict).await;
       }
       (sender, body)
   }

   // Normal: the provisional Member's endpoint is bound by the request, the
   // request carries that endpoint's addresses and the Invite's identifiers, and
   // it goes to the issuing Device, which the connection authenticates as the
   // Member's Device.
   // verifies: LLR-adgk9z
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn request_admission_binds_builds_with_its_own_addresses_and_sends_to_the_issuer() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "request-admission-sends";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let issuer = issuer_endpoint(&admin).await;
       assert_eq!(bob.io.bound_endpoints_for_test().await, 0, "nothing bound before the request");

       let (requested, (sender, body)) =
           tokio::join!(bob.io.request_admission(admin.org), answer_one(&issuer, Some(Verdict::Accepted)));
       assert!(matches!(requested, Ok(Delivery::Delivered)), "{requested:?}");
       assert_eq!(sender, bob.device, "from the provisional Member's Device");
       assert_eq!(bob.io.bound_endpoints_for_test().await, 1, "its endpoint bound");
       let pid = bob.io.personas().await[0].persona_id.clone();
       let own = journey::kept_addresses(&bob.io.bound_endpoint_for_test(&pid).await.unwrap());
       match decode_message(&body).unwrap() {
           WireMessage::AdmissionRequest { org_id, invite_id, device_key, addresses, .. } => {
               assert_eq!((org_id, invite_id, device_key), (admin.org, bob.invite_id, bob.device));
               assert_eq!(addresses.as_slice(), own.as_slice(), "the endpoint's own addresses");
           }
           other => panic!("not an admission request: {other:?}"),
       }
   }

   // Each verdict is reported as itself, silence as `NotDelivered`; the same
   // body goes out each time; nothing is written; a Persona holding no
   // provisional Member is refused with nothing sent.
   // verifies: LLR-adgk9z
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn request_admission_reports_each_outcome_and_writes_nothing() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "request-admission-outcomes";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       let issuer = issuer_endpoint(&admin).await;
       let files = store_bytes(tag, "b");
       let mut bodies = vec![];
       let mut outcomes = vec![];
       for verdict in [Some(Verdict::Accepted), Some(Verdict::AlreadyReceived), Some(Verdict::InviteUsedByAnotherDevice), Some(Verdict::Refused), None] {
           let (requested, (_, body)) = tokio::join!(bob.io.request_admission(admin.org), answer_one(&issuer, verdict));
           outcomes.push(format!("{:?}", requested.unwrap()));
           bodies.push(body);
       }
       for (outcome, expected) in outcomes.iter().zip(["Delivered", "AlreadyReceived", "InviteUsedByAnotherDevice", "Refused", "NotDelivered"]) {
           assert!(outcome.starts_with(expected), "{outcomes:?}");
       }
       assert!(bodies.windows(2).all(|pair| pair[0] == pair[1]), "the same body on every call");
       assert_eq!(store_bytes(tag, "b"), files, "nothing written");
       let refused = admin.io.request_admission(admin.org).await;
       assert!(matches!(refused, Err(RequestError::NoProvisionalMember { .. })), "{refused:?}");
   }

   // Loopback: an Invite whose addresses are another Device's is not dialled

       assert_eq!(asked, vec![carol.device, dave.device], "every other Device of the record, in record order");

               other => panic!("not an organisation request: {other:?}"),
           }
       }
       let elsewhere = OrgId::new([0x98; 20]);
       assert!(matches!(admin.io.request_organisation(elsewhere).await, Err(SendRefused::NotHeld { .. })));
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   /// Why `request_admission` sent nothing. Public data only.
   #[derive(Debug)]
   pub enum RequestError {
       /// No Persona here holds a provisional Member for `org_id`.
       NoProvisionalMember { org_id: OrgId },
       /// The provisional Member's endpoint could not be bound.
       Bind(TransportError),
       /// org-node refused to build the request.
       Node(OrgNodeError),
   }

   impl std::fmt::Display for RequestError {
       fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
           match self {
               Self::NoProvisionalMember { org_id } => {
                   write!(formatter, "no provisional Member for Organisation {}", hex::encode(org_id.as_bytes()))
               }
               Self::Bind(error) => write!(formatter, "the endpoint could not be bound: {error}"),
               Self::Node(error) => write!(formatter, "{error}"),
           }
       }
   }

   impl std::error::Error for RequestError {}

   impl OrgIo {
       /// Ask the Invite's issuer for admission (LLR-adgk9z, LLR-qa4nrt): the
       /// provisional Member's endpoint bound, the request built by org-node
       /// with that endpoint's addresses, sent to the issuer at the Invite's
       /// addresses; writes nothing.
       pub async fn request_admission(&self, org_id: OrgId) -> Result<AdmissionOutcome, RequestError> {
           let device = {
               let service = self.service.lock().await;
               holder_of(&service, org_id).ok_or(RequestError::NoProvisionalMember { org_id })?
           };
           let endpoint = self.local.endpoints.endpoint(&device).await.map_err(RequestError::Bind)?;
           let mode = self.local.endpoints.transport_mode();
           let own = endpoint.addresses(mode);
           let (request, issuer_addresses) = {
               let service = self.service.lock().await;
               let request = service.build_admission_request(&device, own).map_err(|error| match error {
                   OrgNodeError::NoProvisionalMember { .. } => RequestError::NoProvisionalMember { org_id },
                   other => RequestError::Node(other),
               })?;
               let issuer_addresses = kept_for(&service, &device, request.recipient);
               (request, issuer_addresses)
           };
           let sockets = match sockets_for(mode, &request.recipient, issuer_addresses.as_deref()) {
               Ok(sockets) => sockets,
               Err(SendError::AddressNotARecipient) => return Ok(Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: SendError::AddressNotTheIssuer }),
               Err(refused) => return Ok(Delivery::NotDelivered { reason: refused }),
           };
           Ok(send_one(&endpoint, &request.recipient, &sockets, &request.body).await)
       }

       /// Ask for `org_id` (LLR-uf5cyy): every other Device of the current
       /// record, or the Invite's issuer for a provisional Member, each at the
       /// addresses kept for it; the request carries the sender's own
       /// addresses; writes nothing and sends again on every call.
       pub async fn request_organisation(&self, org_id: OrgId) -> Result<SendReport, SendRefused> {
           let device = {
               let service = self.service.lock().await;
               holder_of(&service, org_id).ok_or(SendRefused::NotHeld { org_id })?
           };
           let endpoint = self.local.endpoints.endpoint(&device).await.map_err(SendRefused::Bind)?;
           let own = endpoint.addresses(self.local.endpoints.transport_mode());
           let outgoing = {
               let service = self.service.lock().await;
               let requests = service.build_organisation_request(&device, own).map_err(|error| match error {
                   OrgNodeError::OrgNotHeld { .. } => SendRefused::NotHeld { org_id },
                   other => SendRefused::Node(other),
               })?;
               requests
                   .into_iter()
                   .map(|message| {
                       let addresses = kept_for(&service, &device, message.recipient);
                       Outgoing { recipient: message.recipient, body: message.body, addresses }
                   })
                   .collect::<Vec<_>>()
           };
           Ok(send_all(&self.local.endpoints, device, outgoing).await)
       }
   }
   ```

   ```rust
   use org_io::send::{AdmissionOutcome, Delivery, SendReport};
   use org_io::{ReceiveError, Received};

   use super::handles::NET;

   /// `io`'s next received result, within `NET`.
   pub async fn next(io: &OrgIo) -> Result<Received, ReceiveError> {
       tokio::time::timeout(NET, io.next_received()).await.unwrap()
   }

   /// `joining` asks for admission while `admin`'s receive step takes it.
   pub async fn request_over_transport(admin: &Admin, joining: &Joining) -> (Result<Received, ReceiveError>, AdmissionOutcome) {
       let (received, requested) = tokio::join!(next(&admin.io), joining.io.request_admission(admin.org));
       (received, requested.unwrap())
   }

   /// `admin` sends its current epoch while `to` receives one message.
   pub async fn deliver_epoch(admin: &Admin, to: &OrgIo) -> (Result<Received, ReceiveError>, SendReport) {
       let (received, sent) = tokio::join!(next(to), admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org));
       (received, sent.unwrap())
   }

   /// `joining` admitted over the transport: it receives, asks, is kept,
   /// proposed, written and adopted by `admin`, is sent the epoch, keeps it,
   /// and adopts it by its own verification. `admin` must be receiving.
   pub async fn admit_over_transport(admin: &Admin, joining: &Joining) {
       joining.io.start_receiving().await.unwrap();
       let (kept, requested) = request_over_transport(admin, joining).await;
       assert!(matches!(kept, Ok(Received::AdmissionRequestKept { .. })), "{kept:?}");

       let verified = joining.io.verify_all().await;
       assert!(matches!(verified.as_slice(), [(_, Verified::Adopted { .. })]), "{verified:?}");

   /// `member` (adopted, receiving, the only other Device) revoked by `admin`,

   pub async fn removed_over_transport(admin: &Admin, member: &Joining) -> Vec<(DevicePublicKey, Vec<u8>)> {

       kept.acknowledgements.into_iter().map(|(message, _)| (message.recipient, message.body)).collect()
   ```

   ```rust
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       admin.io.start_receiving().await.unwrap();
       admin
   }

   /// `body` dialled directly to `to` from `device` while `to` receives; what
   /// `to` reported and the bytes written back.
   async fn dialled(to: &org_io::OrgIo, device: &org_node::DevicePublicKey, body: &[u8]) -> (Result<Arrived, org_io::ReceiveError>, Vec<u8>) {
       let addr = journey::address_of(to).await;
       let (received, read_back) = tokio::join!(journey::next(to), dial_direct_as(device, addr, body));
       (received, read_back.unwrap())
   }
   ```

   ```rust
       let listed = admin.io.admission_requests().await;
       assert_eq!(listed.len(), 1);
       match kept {

               assert_eq!((org_id, invite_id, from), (admin.org, bob.invite_id, bob.device));

       assert!(matches!(first, Ok(Arrived::ProvisionalOrganisationReceived { .. })), "{first:?}");
       let (silent, sent) = tokio::join!(
   ```

   `org-io/tests/acknowledgement_inbound.rs` (append; the T28-era tests stay; a file-private `ack_` prefix keeps the
   helpers apart from T28's):
   ```rust
   use org_io::test_support::{dial_direct_as, FakeChain, MemoryKeychain};
   use org_io::{ReceiveError, Received};
   use org_node::wire::{decode_message, WireMessage};

   use common::handles::keep_device_seed;
   use common::journey;

   /// Admin `a` receiving, Member `b` admitted over the transport and then
   /// removed; `b`'s one kept acknowledgement's body.
   async fn ack_removed(tag: &str) -> (journey::Admin, journey::Joining, Vec<u8>) {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       admin.io.start_receiving().await.unwrap();
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       journey::admit_over_transport(&admin, &bob).await;
       let mut kept = journey::removed_over_transport(&admin, &bob).await;
       assert_eq!(kept.len(), 1, "one recipient for one other Device");
       let (recipient, body) = kept.remove(0);
       assert_eq!(recipient, admin.device);
       (admin, bob, body)
   }

   /// `body` dialled directly from `device` to `to` while `to` receives.
   async fn ack_dialled(to: &org_io::OrgIo, device: &org_node::DevicePublicKey, body: &[u8]) -> (Result<Received, ReceiveError>, Vec<u8>) {
       let addr = journey::address_of(to).await;
       let (received, read_back) = tokio::join!(journey::next(to), dial_direct_as(device, addr, body));
       (received, read_back.unwrap())
   }

   // Inherited (from LLR-wvgec4, LLR-unqfj5).
   // verifies: LLR-j467e9, LLR-hhgdk7
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn a_revoked_devices_acknowledgement_over_a_direct_connection_is_accepted_and_answered_accepted() {
       let (admin, bob, body) = ack_removed("ack-in-accepted").await;
       let (received, read_back) = ack_dialled(&admin.io, &bob.device, &body).await;
       assert!(matches!(received, Ok(Received::Acknowledged(_))), "{received:?}");
       assert_eq!(read_back, vec![0x00]);
   }

   // Rewritten from acknowledgement_inbound.rs:195 (LLR-wvgec4, LLR-unqfj5):
   // from a Device no record lists any more, Organisation information and an
   // admission request for an invite already settled are refused with one
   // `0x01` each, and nothing is kept.
   // verifies: LLR-j467e9, LLR-hhgdk7
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn a_revoked_device_sending_anything_but_an_acknowledgement_or_an_organisation_request_is_refused() {
       let tag = "ack-in-anything-else";
       let (admin, bob, _) = ack_removed(tag).await;
       let information = journey::current_messages(&admin).into_iter().next().map(|(_, body)| body);
       let stale_request = {
           let other = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "c", "carol").await;
           other.io.node_for_test().build_admission_request(&other.device, vec![]).unwrap().body
       };
       let files = common::handles::store_bytes(tag, "a");
       for body in information.into_iter().chain([stale_request]) {
           let (received, read_back) = ack_dialled(&admin.io, &bob.device, &body).await;
           assert!(matches!(received, Err(ReceiveError::Refused(_))), "{received:?}");
           assert_eq!(read_back, vec![0x01]);
       }
       assert_eq!(common::handles::store_bytes(tag, "a"), files, "nothing kept");
   }

   // Inherited (from LLR-wvgec4, LLR-unqfj5): a Member that has not adopted the
   // removing epoch still lists the Device, and refuses its acknowledgement.
   // verifies: LLR-j467e9, LLR-hhgdk7
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn an_acknowledgement_a_member_still_listing_the_device_refuses_is_answered_refused() {
       MemoryKeychain::shared().install();
       let tag = "ack-in-still-listed";
       let admin = journey::founded(tag).await;
       admin.io.start_receiving().await.unwrap();
       let bob = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "b", "bob").await;
       journey::admit_over_transport(&admin, &bob).await;
       let carol = journey::invited(&admin, tag, "c", "carol").await;
       carol.io.start_receiving().await.unwrap();
       journey::request_over_transport(&admin, &carol).await;
       journey::propose_admission(&admin, &carol).await;
       journey::write_and_adopt(&admin).await;
       let (to_bob, to_carol, _) =
           tokio::join!(journey::next(&bob.io), journey::next(&carol.io), admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org));
       assert!(matches!((&to_bob, &to_carol), (Ok(Received::ProvisionalOrganisationReceived { .. }), Ok(Received::ProvisionalOrganisationReceived { .. }))));
       assert!(matches!(bob.io.verify_all().await.as_slice(), [(_, org_io::Verified::Adopted { .. })]));
       assert!(matches!(carol.io.verify_all().await.as_slice(), [(_, org_io::Verified::Adopted { .. })]));
       journey::revoke(&admin, bob.device).await;
       let (notice, information, _) =
           tokio::join!(journey::next(&bob.io), journey::next(&carol.io), admin.io.send_organisation(admin.org));
       assert!(matches!(notice, Ok(Received::RevocationNoticeKept { .. })), "{notice:?}");
       assert!(matches!(information, Ok(Received::ProvisionalOrganisationReceived { .. })), "kept by Carol, not adopted");
       assert!(matches!(bob.io.verify_all().await.as_slice(), [(_, org_io::Verified::Removed { .. })]));
       let (_, body) = journey::kept_acknowledgement_bodies(&bob).into_iter().next().unwrap();
       let (received, read_back) = ack_dialled(&carol.io, &bob.device, &body).await;
       assert!(matches!(received, Err(ReceiveError::Refused(_))), "Carol's record still lists Bob: {received:?}");
       assert_eq!(read_back, vec![0x01]);
   }

   // Inherited (from LLR-wvgec4).

       let (admin, _bob, body) = ack_removed("ack-in-relayed").await;
       let (received, read_back) = ack_dialled(&admin.io, &keep_device_seed([0x63; 32]), &body).await;
       assert!(matches!(received, Err(ReceiveError::Refused(_))), "{received:?}");
       assert_eq!(read_back, vec![0x01]);

   // Inherited (from LLR-unqfj5): a body taken off the channel and never
   // answered (its responder dropped) gets no byte back.
   // verifies: LLR-hhgdk7
   #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
   async fn a_dropped_responder_writes_nothing() {
       let (admin, bob, body) = ack_removed("ack-in-dropped").await;
       let addr = journey::address_of(&admin.io).await;
       let (taken, read_back) = tokio::join!(admin.io.next_inbound_for_test(), dial_direct_as(&bob.device, addr, &body));

   /// The code lines (comments dropped) of `org-io/src/<relative>`.
   fn ack_code_of(relative: &str) -> Vec<String> {
       let text = std::fs::read_to_string(std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("src").join(relative)).unwrap();
       text.lines().map(|line| line.split("//").next().unwrap_or("").to_string()).collect()
   }

   // Inherited (from LLR-wvgec4): no code on the accept path compares a
   // remote id with a list — the endpoints, the endpoint and the receive step
   // name no allow-list and read the remote id only to hand it on.
   // verifies: LLR-j467e9
   #[test]
   fn the_accept_path_has_no_allow_list() {
       let mut found = vec![];
       for file in ["endpoints.rs", "transport/endpoint.rs", "receiver.rs"] {

       let writes: Vec<&String> = code.iter().filter(|line| line.contains(".write_all(") || line.contains(".write(")).collect();
       let answer = code.iter().position(|line| line.contains("pub async fn answer(")).unwrap();
       let answer_end = answer + code[answer..].iter().position(|line| line.trim() == "}").unwrap();
       let in_answer: Vec<&String> = code[answer..answer_end].iter().filter(|line| line.contains(".write_all(")).collect();
       assert_eq!(in_answer.len(), 1, "answer writes once");
       assert!(in_answer[0].contains("&[verdict.as_byte()]"), "and only the verdict byte: {}", in_answer[0]);
       let outbound = writes.iter().filter(|line| line.contains("&framed") || line.contains("framed)")).count();
       assert_eq!(writes.len(), outbound + 1, "every other write is a dial's framed body: {writes:?}");
   ```
